title: 2027 Finance Degree Apprenticeship
descriptionHtml:
Company Description

We’reCheckout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth.

Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership.

You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities.

  • Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements.

  • Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines.

  • Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data.

  • Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time.

Eligibility Requirements

This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care.

This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here.

  • Academic Qualifications: You will have either:

  • A degree qualification

    OR

  • You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date

+ 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths

Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway.

  • Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail.

  • Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you!

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: ABM Operations Manager, AI & Automation
descriptionHtml:
About the role 

Our ABM team runs highly targeted programs for the accounts that matter most to RELEX. We want those programs to be even more personalized, more interactive, and faster to launch across channels, without adding manual effort for every new account. 

That's where you come in. You'll advise how the ABM team runs and develops five operational areas: paid media, landing page creation, content personalization, targeted direct mail, and analytics. You'll review how each area works today, then design and build the AI-based workflows, templates, and quality guardrails that let the team focus on account strategy, creativity and stakeholder alignment over manual work. 

What you'll do 

Across all five operational areas 

  • Map how each area works today, find where time and quality can be improved, and agree a prioritized automation roadmap with the Head of ABM
  • Build and maintain the AI workflows the ABM team uses day to day, with tools such as Claude, n8n, Folloze and HubSpot
  • Partner with Marketing Operations, who own our martech platforms, data, and integrations: build ABM workflows on top of the shared stack, follow its standards, and hand over anything that should become a cross-team capability
  • Agree brand and quality guardrails with Brand & Creative so AI-produced assets can go live with light review
  • Document every workflow and train the team so it runs without you 

Ad operations (LinkedIn, Influ2) 

  • Own the setup and execution model for ABM account and contact level campaigns
  • Build workflows and guardrails that cut the time spent on campaign setup
  • Build workflows that generate on-brand ad variants by account, segment, and buying group role
  • Run channel and tactic experiments to find the right mix of reach, engagement, and conversion activity
  • Close the data feedback loop, so account and contact level engagement flows back to the account team and into ABM planning automatically 

Landing page operations 

  • Build a template and component library the team can use to generate account and segment pages with AI
  • Set standards for personalization depth, and work with ABM designers on a tailored look and feel per account
  • Find opportunities to build deeper, more interactive experiences for prospects 

Content build operations 

  • Build and fine-tune workflows that turn existing RELEX content (research, customer stories, point of view pieces) into account-tailored assets such as one-pagers, guides, and sales follow-up material 

Direct mail operations 

  • Design a direct mail program framework that delivers personalized mailers at scale
  • Own the operating model behind them: vendor setup, address data quality, GDPR compliance, budget, and cost per account
  • Connect every send to a defined sales follow-up, and measure what it contributes 

Analytics and reporting 

  • Define how ABM programs are measured, together with the Head of ABM and Marketing Operations: account reach, engagement, buying group coverage, and pipeline contribution
  • Build and maintain reporting that shows what's working by account, channel, and tactic, so channel and budget decisions rest on evidence rather than assumption
  • Keep campaign data clean and comparable across platforms, including naming conventions, UTM standards, and campaign taxonomy
  • Measure the impact of the AI workflows themselves: time saved, cost per asset, and speed from brief to launch 

What we're looking for 

  • 4+ years in B2B ABM, demand generation, growth marketing, GTM engineering, or marketing operations
  • A working understanding of how B2B paid media runs, ideally on LinkedIn: campaign structure, account and contact list targeting, bidding and budget pacing, and which platform metrics you can and can’t trust
  • A proven track record of designing and shipping AI and automation workflows that other people use, with examples you can walk us through
  • Practical experience working with LLMs: prompt design, structured outputs, connecting models to business data and tools, and evaluating output quality
  • Hands-on experience building automations in n8n, Make, Zapier, Workato, or similar, including APIs, webhooks, JSON, and error handling
  • A process mindset: you can map a workflow, see where it breaks, and design a repeatable replacement
  • Good judgment on quality: you know when AI output is ready to be rolled out and when it isn't 

Nice to have 

  • Enough Python or JavaScript to write, read, and debug automation scripts and API calls
  • Experience with intent and engagement platforms such as 6sense, or contact-level advertising such as Influ2
  • Experience running direct mail or gifting programs in B2B
  • Working knowledge of SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (for example Power BI, Looker, or Tableau)
  • Background in global enterprise B2B software with long, multi-stakeholder buying cycles 

About RELEX 

RELEX Solutions creates cutting-edge supply chain and retail planning software. Within our platforms, we have the power and potential to increase adaptability, efficiency, and sustainability in the consumer goods and retail value chain. Our impact is tangible; from sustainability and eliminating waste to delighting customers and delivering great tailored tech solutions, we’re curious and passionate challenge-seekers creating the future of retail today.

We’re currently a global team of 2000+ employees working from offices in the US (Atlanta), UK, Germany, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Singapore, Australia, and our headquarters in Helsinki, Finland. We work in small teams where everyone’s input is valued. We’re passionate about what we do, we like putting our skills to the test, and we make sure we have fun during the process — because life is supposed to be fun.

RELEX Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Account Director (Life Science)
descriptionHtml:
Experience Without Limits
Come shape the future of brand experience.

At Jack Morton, we design and build head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients unlock the full value of experiences by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one. We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what’s next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

The Account Director is responsible for leading a portfolio of client accounts, acting as the senior strategic partner and primary point of contact. This role drives the overall client relationship, ensuring delivery excellence, commercial performance, and long-term growth. The Account Director will translate client objectives into innovative event strategies, lead cross-functional teams, and maintain the highest standards of service, promote creativity, and profitability.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship & Strategic Leadership

  • Own, develop, and execute strategic relationship plans for Executive Leadership, C-Suite, and key stakeholders across assigned accounts.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic counsel, insight, and creative innovation that supports their business objectives and elevates partnership value.
  • Lead the creation and execution of robust client retention and growth strategies, ensuring year-on-year account stability and expansion.
  • Develop and implement tailored business development plans within existing client portfolios, identifying opportunities for new services and revenue streams.
  • Champion the agency’s full-service offering, ensuring amplification services (digital, creative, production, engagement, etc.) are effectively positioned and integrated into client solutions.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Own the financial performance of allocated accounts, including revenue forecasting, gross margin delivery, and profitability targets.
  • Lead the commercial review process, ensuring accurate pricing models, transparent financial tracking, and proactive margin management.
  • Drive commercial excellence through regular analysis of client profitability, resource utilisation, and pricing initiatives.
  • Ensure internal CRMs, budgets, and commercial documentation are accurate, complete, and aligned with internal governance standards.

Client Delivery & Quality Assurance

  • Oversee delivery of all client Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring standards of excellence across all programs.
  • Provide senior oversight of project/account management teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest compliance and quality standards.
  • Partner with internal operations, compliance, and delivery teams to maintain robust governance frameworks.
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to evaluate performance against KPIs, identify areas for improvement, and shape future strategies

New Business & RFP Management

  • In partnership with New Business Development, lead the strategic response and delivery of RFPs, proposals, and pitch presentations for assigned accounts and support new opportunities that IXM receive.
  • Contribute to the development of thought leadership, case studies, and credentials that reinforce the agency’s expertise within the LifeSciences sector.

People Management 

  • Develop, mentor and coach all direct reports ensuring monthly meetings to discuss progress and review development plans.
  • Oversee the development, mentoring and coaching of the wider team.
  • Working with the Associate Director Talent Management, monitor development plans for all team members considering:
  • Current skills analysis
  • Training needs analysis
  • Individual’s needs and desires
  • Development planning strategies
  • Lead on recruitment process, interviewing and selecting new team members.
  • Provide consistent leadership, motivation and direction to all team members.
  • Work with Executive Leadership to ensure all teams are consistently sharing best practice and delivering to Impact-XM standards at all times.
  • Management of direct report holidays and lieu days.
  • Oversee the management of wider team holidays and lieu days.

General

  • Monitor and review timesheet activity in Company time sheet system
  • Prepare monthly client project analysis to ensure team and recruitment costs are assessed against client budget.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 8–10 years’ experience in client services, account management, or event strategy
  • Proven track record of managing global or multi-market client portfolios and developing long-term senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with demonstrable experience in budget management, margin optimisation, and pricing strategy.
  • In-depth understanding of industry compliance and regulatory frameworks.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams and fostering collaboration across operations, creative, digital, and production functions.
  • Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and communication skills with the ability to influence at senior levels.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for growth, innovation, and service excellence.

Last but not least, we believe in diversity, equity and inclusion.

Jack Morton is an equal opportunity employer; we strongly value diversity at our companies. We do not discriminate on race, religion, color, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Director, Public Sector (DACH) based in Switzerland.

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Director to lead public sector sales initiatives across the DACH region. In this role, you will drive the adoption of innovative AI-powered intelligence solutions that help government agencies investigate financial crime, disrupt illicit activities, and strengthen security. You will manage the entire sales cycle, from identifying new opportunities and building strategic relationships to negotiating and closing complex, high-value deals. Working with public sector stakeholders, senior executives, and internal teams, you will develop tailored commercial strategies that address customer needs and deliver measurable value. You will also strengthen existing accounts, drive renewals and expansions, and build a strong network of customer advocates. This is an opportunity to contribute to a meaningful mission at the intersection of AI, cryptocurrency, and national security within a fast-paced, international environment.


Accountabilities:

As an Account Director, Public Sector, you will own the development and execution of sales strategies across your assigned territory, building trusted relationships with government customers and driving sustainable revenue growth. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Map and develop relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers across public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Identify and engage new prospects to expand market presence and generate qualified business opportunities.

  • Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial prospecting and relationship development to negotiations and closing high-value deals.

  • Develop and execute strategic account and territory plans aligned with commercial objectives and customer priorities.

  • Lead customer engagement initiatives, including relationship nurturing, feedback collection, referrals, renewals, upselling, cross-selling, and account expansion.

  • Build strong product and industry expertise to communicate the value of AI-powered intelligence solutions and address the specific needs of public sector customers.

  • Act as a customer advocate by gathering feedback, identifying customer needs, and communicating insights to relevant internal teams.

  • Develop a network of satisfied customers who can provide referrals, champion the solutions, and contribute valuable product feedback.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to coordinate sales activities and deliver a consistent customer experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience selling SaaS products to public sector accounts in the DACH region.

  • Strong customer-facing presentation and active listening skills, with the ability to establish credibility and build relationships with senior executives.

You’ll report to Adrien Cannet, who leads the Account Executive team for the accountant channel. title: Account Executive  - DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We're building the sales engine for Tellent HR in the DACH market, and we're looking for an Account Executive to help us do it. Think of it as joining a startup inside a scale-up.

First and foremost, this is a hands-on selling role. You'll own the full sales cycle for Tellent HR (Manage and/or Grow), split roughly 80/20 between new business and expansion into our existing customer base. Inbound isn't going to be your main pipeline driver, so expect to spend around 50% of your time prospecting, against ambitious daily and weekly activity targets. Alongside that, you'll help us work out how we win in DACH: testing motions fast and doubling down on what drives revenue.

You'll work with a dedicated Product Marketing Manager and Customer Success Manager in the Tellent HR squad. CS capacity is limited, though, so you'll run deals independently, including demos and follow-through.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • First 3 months: Learn Tellent HR, our ideal customers and the competitive landscape in DACH. Build your first pipeline through outbound, establish a consistent daily activity rhythm, and close your first deals.

  • Within 6 months: Consistently hit your activity, pipeline and revenue targets, understand which sales motions work best in the DACH market, and feed insights back to Product Marketing and Product.

  • After 1 year: Be the go-to expert on selling Tellent HR in DACH, with a repeatable, data-backed playbook that others can pick up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle, independently: Run 1–3 month, multi-stakeholder deals involving HR leaders, founders/CEOs and Finance, from first touch through to close and follow-through.

  • Languages: Fluent English and native or fluent German are required. You'll be responsible for engaging customers and building relationships across the DACH market.

This role probably isn't for you if you want a structured environment with large support teams and steady inbound, or you're more excited by GTM strategy than by picking up the phone every day.

How We Measure Success

  • Closed-won revenue against target (primary KPI)

  • Daily and weekly outbound activity targets (key leading indicator, especially early on)

  • Self-generated pipeline and coverage

  • Win rate, deal velocity and forecast accuracy

  • Contributions to the playbook

What We Offer

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

title: Account Executive Nordics
descriptionHtml:
Who is Litmus

Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.

AI doesn’t work without real-world, contextualized data - Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.

We’re a growth-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.

Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software-defined manufacturing.

Why join Litmus

Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible

AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.

Work on problems where software meets the real world

Most AI systems fail without access to real-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non-negotiable.

Have real impact, fast

You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.

Join a high-performance team

We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.

Our culture

At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.

We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.

About the role

Litmus is hiring an Account Executive to own and grow new business with industrial manufacturers across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Iceland and Finland.

Litmus is an industrial DataOps and edge AI platform. We help manufacturers connect, normalize and use data from their plants, from shop-floor assets up to the cloud. Our customers use Litmus to break down OT data silos and scale analytics and AI across sites.

You will be the face of Litmus in the Nordics. You will build pipeline, run complex enterprise sales cycles end to end, and work closely with our pre-sales team, hyperscaler partners (Microsoft, AWS, Google, Databricks) and system integrators. You will report in to the VP EMEA.

What you will do

• Own a Nordic territory and its revenue target, from prospecting to signed contract and expansion.

• Build and qualify pipeline through outbound, events, partners and inbound leads.

• Run discovery with plant, operations, OT and IT stakeholders up to C-level, and map their business case for change.

• Lead structured, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, including proofs of value, commercial proposals and negotiation.

• Work hand in hand with pre-sales on demos, solution design and technical validation.

• Co-sell with hyperscalers and system integrators, and develop partner-sourced opportunities in your region.

• Keep forecasts and opportunity data accurate in Salesforce.

• Expand existing accounts from first site to multi-site and global rollouts.

• Bring market feedback back to product, marketing and leadership.

What you bring

Segment experience (required)

• 5+ years of B2B enterprise software sales, with a proven record of meeting or beating quota.

• Direct sales experience in industrial software: IIoT, industrial DataOps, data historians, MES, SCADA, edge computing or manufacturing analytics.

• A solid grasp of the OT/IT landscape in manufacturing, and of how plant data flows from machines to the cloud.

• Experience selling into manufacturing, process industries, energy or similar industrial sectors.

Nordic market knowledge (required)

• An established network among industrial manufacturers in the Nordics.

• A working understanding of Nordic buying culture, decision-making and procurement.

• Familiarity with the regional partner and system integrator landscape.

• Fluency in English and at least one Nordic language (Swedish, Norwegian, Danish or Finnish).

How you work

• Comfortable running long, complex deals with many stakeholders.

• Disciplined in qualification and forecasting (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or similar).

title: AI Applied Scientist
descriptionHtml:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

 

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

Travailler à ses côtés, c’est intégrer une équipe d’experts passionnés, être challengé sur le plan technique et méthodologique, et contribuer à des projets à fort impact pour les clients.

Vos missions

Nous recherchons actuellement un AI Engineer spécialisé en AI4Code pour accompagner la transformation de l’ingénierie logicielle chez nos clients. Vous intégrerez notre Practice IA afin de redéfinir l’expérience développeur (DevEx) en combinant l’usage des meilleurs outils du marché et la conception d’agents intelligents sur-mesure.

Vous interviendrez sur trois volets majeurs :

Déploiement & Optimisation des AI Assistants

  • Intégration, configuration et optimisation des solutions leaders (Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor IDE) au sein des environnements de développement.

  • Définition des stratégies d’usage pour la génération de code, la mise en place de pratiques TDD assistées par l’IA et la documentation automatisée.

  • Accompagnement des équipes de développement : pair-programming avec l’IA, création de guidelines et diffusion des bonnes pratiques pour une adoption efficace et sécurisée.

Ingénierie d’Agents IA & AI4Code

  • Conception et développement d’agents autonomes capables d’analyser, générer et transformer du code pour des cas d’usage métiers spécifiques.

  • Mise en œuvre de pipelines agentiques pour la refactorisation à grande échelle : détection de dette technique, proposition d’architectures cibles, modernisation de systèmes legacy et migration de frameworks.

  • Développement de solutions sur-mesure lorsque les outils du marché atteignent leurs limites.

Industrialisation & LLMOps

  • Gestion du cycle de vie des solutions IA appliquées au code : versioning des prompts, sécurisation des flux de données et gouvernance des usages.

  • Mise en place de mécanismes d’observabilité pour évaluer la qualité, la fiabilité et la pertinence du code généré.

  • Intégration des solutions dans des environnements de production avec des exigences fortes en matière de sécurité et de scalabilité.

Votre rôle inclura également :

  • Veille technologique active : Suivi des évolutions rapides des outils AI4Code, des modèles et des pratiques émergentes autour du développement assisté par l’IA.

  • Cadrage technique : Accompagnement des équipes clients dans l’identification et la priorisation des cas d’usage à forte valeur ajoutée.

  • Best Practices : Contribution à la structuration des standards, méthodes et retours d’expérience au sein de la Practice IA.

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons des ingénieurs passionnés par l'ingénierie logicielle appliquée à l'IA, souhaitant évoluer dans des environnements où la robustesse du code est aussi importante que la performance du modèle.

  • Formation (Prérequis strict) : Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 (Grande École d'Ingénieur ou Master 2 Universitaire en Informatique, Mathématiques Appliquées ou Intelligence Artificielle).

  • Background Software Engineer : Vous avez une expérience solide en développement (Python, TypeScript, et/ou langages typés comme Java/C#). Vous maîtrisez les principes du Clean Code, du SOLID et de l'architecture logicielle.

  • Expertise AI4Code : Vous connaissez les limites, les capacités de raisonnement et les risques d'hallucination des LLMs actuels (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, etc.), et vous savez comment en tirer le meilleur parti.

  • Mindset & Pédagogie : Vous êtes capable d'analyser un environnement technique, de concevoir une stratégie claire d'intégration de l'IA et de vulgariser ces concepts auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Des missions ambitieuses et variées, toujours sélectionnées pour leur valeur ajoutée ;

Un accompagnement de proximité par des experts reconnus ;

  • Une communauté d’ingénieurs passionnés, avec workshops, conférences et échanges réguliers ;

  • Une culture d’exigence technique, de partage des connaissances et de développement continu.

Entretien de Motivation : Rencontrez un membre du comité de direction

descriptionHtml:

Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.

You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

  • Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

    • Requirements

    • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

    • Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences.

    • Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance.

    • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning.

    • Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

    • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI.

    • Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

    • Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability.

    • Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance.

    • Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV.

    • Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions.

      • Benefits

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral AI is looking for AI Scientists with deep machine learning expertise and hands-on engineering experience to expand what Mistral's agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle across CAE (CFD, FEA etc) and EDA/Semi..

Within AI4Engineering Science, your core work is building the pre and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harness that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

What You Will Do

  • Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

  • Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

  • Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

  • Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

  • Collaborate with domain experts across CAEand EDA (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

  • Contribute to Mistral's broader pre and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences

  • Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development

  • Demonstrated experience running, debugging, and validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA.

  • You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments

  • Self-directed, you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress

  • Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML

It would be great if you

  • Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks)

  • Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training

  • Have industrial or academic experience with CAE, or EDA tools (e.g. SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools)

  • Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase

  • Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.)

title: Associate Director, Data, Tech & Analytics, Global Client Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

3726 - Associate Director, Data, Tech & Analytics, Global Client Solutions

Role Summary and Impact

ABOUT WPP & OPENDOOR

At WPP, we’re constantly reinventing the future of creativity on an ever-broader canvas, bringing together unrivalled talent, resources and skills to provide an integrated offer of communications, experience, commerce and technology.

Over the last decade, we have developed a dedicated global client practice with the mission of accelerating WPP’s impact for our largest clients by bringing them the best of WPP. Each team is custom-built around a client’s specific needs and challenges, providing easy access to the right capabilities. And that’s why we’ve built OpenDoor for Amazon.

OpenDoor is a unique integration of the best of WPP and Amazon – building on their respective strengths and visions. Whether at WPP or at Amazon, every project is an OpenDoor on new possibilities. Anything and everything can be an opportunity for our people to drive impact – for them to innovate, learn, thrive, and occasionally fail too.

The unique OpenDoor partnership model is built to deliver next level Productivity, fueled by our industry-leading approach to People, Platforms, and Process. OpenDoor spans across all WPP agencies and disciplines such as media, business consultancy, communications and brand strategy, tech and commerce, public relations, and production.

OpenDoor’s values are built from Amazon’s own 16 Leadership Principles, and WPP’s core values of Open, Optimistic and Extraordinary. Together, when WPP’s Creative Transformation meets Amazon’s next-level customer centricity, our people come together to challenge and impact what’s done today and build a better future.

By joining OpenDoor, not only are you joining a cross-function team partnering with one of WPP’s top five global clients, but you are also taking a step to challenge yourself and the world around you every day, working in the most unusual way on some of Earth’s most ambitious opportunities in marketing, tech, media, business, and creativity.

About the Role

We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as a Data Governance Director. This is a full-time, senior leadership position. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best-in-class service for Amazon in every country across its MGM and CDS business lines.

In this role will act as the key operational bridge across internal WPP teams, client leadership, local market contacts, offshore delivery teams, external creative agencies, and third-party partners. By establishing robust workflows, owning platform integrations, and managing data governance compliance, you will ensure campaigns are executed accurately, on time, and in strict alignment with global standards.

As a Data Excellence Associate Director, you will be a strategic leader, focused on taxonomy compliance and responsible for championing a customer-centric data excellence strategy, fostering strong relationships with senior stakeholders, and significantly investing in the growth and development of the Data Governance team. You will drive adoption of data quality standards, ensuring OpenDoor's data assets provide maximum business impact for Amazon. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Account Operations: Partner closely with Activation and Client Leadership to ensure the day-to-day operations of the line of business run seamlessly. Collaborate with relevant eternal stakeholders (e.g. DoubleVerify) to ensure accurate account configuration and tracking integrity, while coordinating team training sessions for newly released features.
  • Process Documentation: Design, implement, and brief teams on essential operational infrastructure, including live/pre-live status documents, proof of posting (PoP) trackers, Wrike workflows, workback schedules, and other tracking templates.
  • GOC Management: Ensure clear delegation and structured briefings to remotely based Global Operations Centre ad ops teams delivery teams to guarantee flawless campaign tracking and execution.

Campaign Trafficking & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Trafficking Execution Support: Partner with activation and GOC delivery teams to ensure campaigns are accurately trafficked, tags are correctly implemented, and delivery issues are resolved rapidly.
  • Partner & Local Market Alignment: Act as an operational bridge between DoubleVerify and local market teams during onboarding to align platform setups with upcoming advertising activity.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Activation, Client Leadership, and platform teams on daily operational workflows and feature training.

Taxonomy, Governance & PBR Compliance

  • PBR Score Ownership: Take full accountability for meeting and exceeding the target 97.5%+ Taxonomy PBR (Performance-Based Reward) compliance score for this line of business.
  • Quality Control (QA): Process oversight (including QA) of trafficking sheets, delivery documents, and briefing templates prior to offloading to offshore execution teams to guarantee taxonomy compliance at setup.
  • Training & Enablement: Schedule, design, and facilitate regular "Taxonomy & Workflow" refresher sessions throughout the year to keep the team aligned on platforms, processes, and requirements.
  • Issue Resolution: Act swiftly to address taxonomy discrepancies, collaborating directly with relevant teams to ensure urgent amendments are understood and executed.
  • Industry & Tech Alignment: Stay ahead of product developments from Choreograph (specifically around Campaign Governance) and monitor updates to the PBR

Advanced Governance & Adoption: 

  • Lead in the implementation of data pipelines, quality policies and best practices, designing and building frameworks rather than just executing. 
  • Define and approve data standards, policies, business rules, and tools, ensuring they align with overarching WPP and Amazon strategies. 
  • Deploy the metadata management framework to cover data lineage, access control, and data catalogue requirements across the region. 
  • Drive adoption in data quality methodologies and tooling for the region, simplifying complex data governance frameworks into actionable strategies that can be broadly adopted and understood. 
  • Optimize resource allocation for regional data excellence initiatives, demonstrating creativity and resourcefulness to achieve maximum impact with efficient use of budget and headcount. 

Creative Management & Production Planning

  • Production Oversight: Own and manage the highly detailed RMI campaign spec sheet (production plan), ensuring the template remains fit for purpose for both internal WPP teams and external client/agency partners.
  • Agency Liaison: Lead regular calls with external creative agencies, ensuring all technical, creative, and operational queries are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Quality Assurance: Maintain meticulous attention to detail to ensure the RMI spec sheet is populated correctly and accounts for all nuanced creative agency requirements.
  • Continuous Improvement: Create post-campaign narratives and lead "Wash Up" (post-mortem) sessions for complex campaigns (such as Enhanced Engagement initiatives) to optimize future creative management processes.

Skills and Experience

  • Strategic Leadership: Proven ability to define and execute a regional data excellence strategy, aligning with broader organizational goals. 
  • People Leadership and Development: Extensive experience in leading, guiding, evaluating, and developing junior team members and potentially managers for both current success and future growth. 
  • Executive Communication: Exceptional presentation, communication, and negotiation skills, capable of simplifying complex technical concepts for executive audiences and managing cross-team and client dialogues at the highest level. 
  • Data Governance & Architecture: Deep expertise in building and deploying data governance frameworks, including metadata management, data lineage, and access control. 
  • Technical Full-Funnel Media Capability: Strong understanding of technical full-funnel media capabilities, coupled with advanced data and analytics literacy. 
  • Stakeholder Influence: Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and influence senior leaders and client stakeholders across diverse markets. 
  • Change Management: Experience in driving organizational change related to data quality and data literacy across large, complex organizations. 
  • Problem Solving: A reputation as a responsible, accountable leader with the willingness to dive deep into complex data issues. 
  • Operational Excellence: Proven experience in a senior operations role within a media, creative, or digital agency network (experience within WPP is a strong plus).
  • Platform & Ad Ops Proficiency: Hands-on experience creating CM360 accounts, linking DV360 profiles, and integrating DoubleVerify setups.
  • International media management experience.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits 

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.  

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.  

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.  Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country. 

Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

title: (Associate) Product Manager - Customer Lifecycle (f/m/x)
descriptionHtml:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: we enable anyone to be an investor by making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission

As an Associate Product Manager in the Customer Lifecycle domain, you will support the engine which makes sure our already onboarded customers have a positive experience on lifecycle events like re-KYC, account termination and customer service. Furthermore, you will be responsible for making sure lemon.markets delivers on its ongoing regulatory commitments. Your remit also covers owning the tooling which our operations colleagues use every day and making sure these evolve in sync with evolving regulatory landscape as well as business growth.

Reporting to the domain's Senior PM, you'll drive complex, multi-stakeholder commitments end-to-end. You'll work cross-functionally at lemon.markets and regularly interface with stakeholders from varying functional backgrounds. To be successful in this role, you should be able to bring stakeholders on the same page and drive a coherent product strategy aimed at improving the efficiency of processes which kick-in during the lifecycle of a customer with lemon.markets while making sure lemon.markets adheres to its regulatory obligations.

In this role you will:

  • Own the roadmap for the problem space end-to-end - i.e. from problem framing through to release, adoption and iteration.

  • Be embedded in a cross-functional team including operations and engineering, while engaging with other product teams, solutions engineering, and your colleagues in functions such as finance, risk and compliance.

  • Prioritise commitments against the domain strategy using quantitative and qualitative evidence, and share your trade-offs.

  • Propose forward-looking solutions that outlive the immediate ask, rather than one-off tactical fixes.

  • Interface regularly with your immediate customers and stakeholders to understand their pain points, capture feedback and use this information to shape your roadmap and product strategy.

  • Track market and regulatory developments in your problem space, and bring the insights back to the team and introduce informed iterations of your product strategy.

  • Write clearly and often - decision records, partner-facing specs, internal narratives. Writing is how decisions get made here.

You’ll be successful in this role if:

  • You have at least 1-2 years of product experience, including independently shipping complex products. You take ownership of outcomes, not just features.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity. You can define an unclear problem space, structure it, and move forward without waiting for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You are comfortable working through legal text. You form your own preliminary view on a legal or regulatory question before discussing it with experts, and you know which questions to bring to them.

  • You argue your position based on data and evidence, and you iterate when the evidence changes.

  • You write clearly. Decisions, specs, and partner communication are a core part of this job, and you can make complex topics easy to follow on paper.

  • You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and actively explore how far they can take your output.

  • You are professionally fluent in English. However, German speakers would be preferred.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributor lemoneers work 4 or more days per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like Polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day and our monthly new-joiner breakfasts. But also in the bigger things, like celebrating the onboarding of new partners or our annual offsites, where the whole company comes together to connect, reflect, and celebrate.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: Wechoose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

title: Associate Product Manager | London
descriptionHtml:
We Are

Breaking The Law

LawAdvisor was founded in 2015 in Melbourne, Australia with a fearless and ambitious belief: that everybody should have access to justice.

We hypothesised that the high costs, inefficiencies, and difficulties of obtaining legal help could be overcome simply by providing greater access to legal information, and by providing everybody with real-time access to high-quality, affordable lawyers online.

Our mission has since been supported by thousands of lawyers and has allowed us to expand and set up offices across the globe. We've also attracted high-profile investors and partners who have shared our mission to transform legal service delivery.


We're still not satisfied. The potential exists to completely revolutionise the practice of law. The start of this decade has delivered LawAdvisor with a new mandate: to overhaul and transform how lawyers work, and how people interact with and consume legal services, with state-of-the-art legal practise management technology to (i) increase efficiencies; (ii) automate routine processes; (iii) increase transparency; (iv) bring the legal practice to the 21st century.

We Need

A Novice Juggler
Our Associate Product Manager relishes in the idea of being a part of a team that moves mountains. They know better than to falter when opportunities aren’t handed to them because they know that nothing good will ever come easy. Remaining steadfast and diligent, they’re prepared to get their hands dirty and navigate through the variety of tasks that they’ll take ownership over.

Teaming up with our Product Managers, you’ll solve problems and facilitate communication across our cross-functional team and align them in order to shape, influence, and refine our products. An intimate understanding of our market and product suite helps us surmount any obstacle facing us whether it may be competitors, client and stakeholder feedback, or the creation of new products and features. You’ll be ready to learn from the best and continuously supercharge your professional growth and knowledge through our resources, tools, and first-hand experience.

You Will

  • Be the professor of our users’ “pain points”. You empathise with our clients and can describe the problems we are trying to solve.

  • Collaborate with and manage the product development team alongside the Product Manager.

  • Gather, analyse, and apply our quantitative and qualitative data and feedback to elevate our products.

  • Ideate new solutions and opportunities as well as analyse research with the product team to determine how it can align with our product goals.

  • Help facilitate communication within cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from conceptualisation to launch day and beyond.

  • Use your in-depth understanding of our products to deliver training to our internal teams and external stakeholders to promote optimal product knowledge.

  • Learn and grow: gain knowledge and experience through watching and/or participating in the creation of product roadmaps, product strategy, and product plans as they happen.

  • Become a leader: you gain first-hand experience through the Product Manager on how to delegate, manage and lead cross-functional teams to product success.


You Should Have

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Marketing, a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience as an Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Scrum Master, or practical experience in the development and/or launch of a product.

title: Audit Methodology Lead
descriptionHtml:
We build AI agents that perform audit procedures for audit firms. We need an experienced auditor to decide what correct output from those agents looks like, and whether our agents meet that bar.

You'll join one of our product groups as its audit expert. You'll write the criteria and reference cases our agents are tested against, review agent output the way you'd review a file, and tell the team plainly when something isn't ready for a live engagement. You'll use AI to create realistic test material, and you'll review all of it yourself.

About DataSnipper

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.

 

What you'll own

  • Define the correct answer, and the reasoning behind it, for the procedures our agents perform

  • Interpret ISAs and NV COS (IFRS for reporting matters; US GAAS and PCAOB where relevant) into requirements engineers can build against

  • Create realistic audit cases with AI tools, including documents, workpapers, exceptions and judgement calls, and review every one

  • Review agent output against those cases, and find misapplied standards, weak reasoning and conclusions that wouldn't pass partner review

  • Turn recurring errors into findings product and engineering can fix

  • Give a clear, evidenced view on whether a capability is ready for live engagements

  • Review methodology content from partners and our own teams, with versioning, approval and documented changes

  • Track changes in standards and inspection findings, and explain what they mean for the product

  • Teach product and engineering how audit work is actually done, including how firms differ

  • Work with customers and content partners when the work requires it

What you'll bring

  • A professional qualification: RA, AA, CPA, CA, ACA, ACCA or equivalent

  • Experience as an Audit Manager: setting the approach, reviewing others' work, clearing review notes and defending conclusions

  • Recent experience across several clients and industries

  • Working knowledge of ISQM 1 and how firms document and review audit work

  • Regular use of AI tools, and a clear sense of how they fail

  • Precise writing: people without your training will build from what you write

  • Patience for detail: line-by-line review, and real time spent on a single conclusion

Nice to have:

  • You want to use your audit expertise on hard problems in AI: judgement, evidence and review

  • You'd rather change how audit work is done than automate how it's done today

  • You've built something yourself, such as a tool, prototype or workflow, to fix a slow process

  • You stay with open-ended problems until the answer holds up

What this role is not

  • Not product management. You shape what ships, but you don't own the roadmap

  • Not implementation or customer success

  • Not volume work. AI produces the volume; you decide what's right

Recruitment steps

  • Recruiter screen

  • Interview with an Audit Expert

  • Assessment interview

  • Final conversations with the people you would work alongside

 

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit-based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper. 🚀

title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.

Deine Chance

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität.

Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften.

  • Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und stellst eine korrekte buchhalterische Abbildung sicher.

  • Du wirkst bei der Optimierung von Bilanzierungs- und Reportingprozessen mit.

Finanzreporting & Steuern

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte sowie interner Reportings

  • Du kümmerst dich um umsatz- und ertragssteuerliche Fragestellungen und deren Umsetzung.

  • Du trägst zur Einhaltung steuerlicher Vorschriften und zur Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern bei.

Treasury & Zahlungsverkehr

  • Du unterstützt bei treasury-relevanten Aufgaben wie Zahlungsverkehr, Liquiditätsplanung und Bankabstimmungen.

  • Du stellst eine strukturierte und termingerechte Abwicklung sicher.

Tools & Prozessverbesserung

  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit ERP-Systemen (z. B. SAP, Lexware) sowie Google Workspace.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen ein und sicherst eine hohe Datenqualität.
    Du unterstützt bei der Vorbereitung auf zukünftige Reporting- und Digitalisierungsvorhaben.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 3–5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung oder Bilanzierung, idealerweise mit Verantwortung für Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB

  • Fundiertes Verständnis buchhalterischer und steuerlicher Prozesse – von der Geschäftsvorfallbewertung über die Bilanzierung bis zur Erstellung von Abschlussdokumenten
