title: GTM Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

We're looking for a GTM Engineer to build and run the systems behind 9fin's next-generation go-to-market engine. You will own Clay and Gong end to end and use them, together with Claude and our CRM, to move 9fin towards a world where reps don't decide who to contact: they open a curated list of to-dos with hyper-personalised messages, review, and approve.

This is a new, high-impact role in Revenue Operations. You will report to the Head of Revenue Operations and work closely with Marketing Operations and the Director of GTM Transformation. You will own the architecture, the workflows and the adoption, and have real influence on how our GTM stack evolves, including newer tools such as an AI inbound agent.

Key Responsibilities:

Clay and AI GTM orchestration

  • Own Clay end to end: design, build, document and maintain workflows, Functions and Audiences across our prioritised use cases, such as inbound enrichment, scoring and routing, job change, closed-lost re-engagement, signal-based pipeline generation, TAM sourcing, CRM enrichment and hygiene, event prep, and renewal risk signals.

  • Deep expertise in Clay-native building. Strong examples of using judgment and creativity underneath your Clay builds. Show us your waterfall design, credit economics, signal selection, data modeling, and clean CRM handoff.

  • Build and run Clay workflows from Claude (via the Clay CLI or MCP), and help shape the Claude-based command centre that gives reps and AMs on-demand research, briefs and messaging.

    • Agentic extension examples: Ability to build Clay workflows using Claude Code with the Clay MCP or API.

  • Help define the long-term architecture and roadmap: which system holds which data, how signals flow between Clay, Salesforce, Gong and Claude, and how Clay can become our AI GTM orchestration layer.

  • Deliver the end state for reps: a prioritised daily list of actions with hyper-personalised messages they only need to review and approve. Start with AI that assists, then automate as confidence in data and output grows.

  • Manage enrichment credits, data providers and cost per workflow, and measure each workflow against pipeline and revenue outcomes.

Gong ownership

  • Be the product owner of Gong: configuration, integrations, permissions, trackers, scorecards and dashboards, plus the sequencing and outreach workflows (Gong Engage).

  • Drive adoption across Sales, SDR, AM and CS teams through onboarding, training, office hours and usage reporting, and help resolve user issues.

  • Turn Gong data into insight: win/loss analysis, competitor mentions and knowledge gaps, objection and messaging trends, and product feedback for Product and Sales leadership.

  • Feed Gong insights back into Clay and Salesforce, for example call-derived competitor renewal dates and closed-lost reasons that trigger re-engagement plays or Gong generated MEDDPICC.

  • Track new Gong features and releases, and recommend and roll out the ones that improve how we sell.

Wider GTM funnel and systems

  • Participate in evolving the end-to-end GTM flow, from lead capture through MQL, SQL and closed-won, working with Marketing Ops on lead management, scoring, routing and attribution.

  • Help build the next-generation GTM engine. This includes evaluating and implementing complementary tools, such as evolving Qualified into an inbound AI agent.

  • Protect data quality in Salesforce and across the stack, because AI amplifies both good and bad data.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing Ops and the Director of GTM Transformation on priorities, and collaborate with Sales, SDR, CS, Product and Engineering teams.

  • Document processes and train the GTM teams on new workflows and tools.

Skills & Experience

Requirements

  • 4+ years in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, growth operations or GTM engineering at a B2B SaaS company building GTM systems across a modern GTM stack that includes CRM, enrichment, sequencing, marketing tools, and data pipelines.

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience building and running Clay in production (workflows, enrichment, scoring, CRM sync), ideally in a B2B SaaS GTM team.

  • 1+ year of hands-on experience administering Gong or an equivalent conversation intelligence tool, including AI trackers, dashboards, AI analysis, Engage/Sequences and driving team adoption.

  • Hands-on configuration experience with Salesforce or HubSpot (objects, fields, flows, data model, integrations).

  • Practical experience implementing AI in GTM workflows: prompt design, LLM-based research and messaging, and tools such as Claude, MCP or agents. We would like to hear what you have built and what you learned.

  • AI quality control: experience with human-in-the-loop design and measuring AI output quality (testing prompts, tracking approval and edit rates).

  • Analytical mindset: able to turn call and pipeline data into clear findings, such as win/loss, competitive gaps and product feedback.

  • Strong communicator who can train non-technical users, document what you build and work across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance.

  • Self-starter who is happy owning an area that is still being defined, and who ships, measures and iterates.

Nice to have

  • Experience rolling out GTM tools from scratch at a scaling B2B SaaS company.

  • Experience with sales engagement, intent and enrichment tools (Apollo, 6sense, Bombora, Zapier, Qualified or similar).

  • Experience with lead scoring, routing and funnel reporting (MQL to SQL to Won).

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and JSON, and able to debug integrations. Light scripting (JavaScript or Python) is helpful.

  • Account-based, finite-TAM experience: multi-threading named accounts where quality is more important than volume and strong sense of brand reputation in everything that goes out.

  • Custom signal sourcing: experience building signals from niche sources (fund moves, deal activity, regulatory filings).

  • First-party data as signal: Ability to leverage 9fin’s own product usage and content engagement. Experience piping product data into GTM plays.

  • Expansion and renewal plays: Previous experience finding renewal risk and creating AM/CSM workflows to prevent churn.

  • UK/EU outbound compliance: Working knowledge of GDPR and/or PECR.

Our benefits

We're a scaling start up and we enjoy sharing our success. When the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Hybrid Policy

Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. title: GTM Talent Strategist (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Lio just raised a $30M Series A, and our Go-to-Market team is at the heart of what comes next.

As our Talent Strategist for GTM, you'll embed in our commercial organization, learn what exceptional looks like in enterprise sales, and hire the people who meet that bar, from high-potential early-career talent to Account Executives and sales leaders across Munich and New York. You'll work directly with our founders and GTM leadership.

What you'll do

  • Own GTM hiring end to end. You'll run every search, from the first kickoff with the hiring manager to the signed offer.

  • Shape our sales team. You'll define what world-class looks like for every role and turn that into confident hiring decisions.

  • Go after the best. You'll seek out top sellers and rising stars wherever they are, and give them a reason to choose Lio.

  • Design a hiring engine that's rigorous and fast. That means interviews, case studies and scorecards that spot top performers early.

  • Win the people who matter. We don’t hire everyone, and we don’t lose the ones we want.

  • Make Lio unforgettable. You'll create a candidate experience people talk about, whether or not they join.

  • Hire with data. You'll use funnel insights to get faster, sharper and better with every search.

  • Put Lio on the map. You'll make Lio the name top sales talent knows, and bring in external partners when a search needs extra firepower.

What you bring

  • Experience owning full-cycle GTM recruiting, ideally at a B2B SaaS company, startup or agency

  • A track record of hiring Account Executives and other quota-carrying roles; sales leadership searches are a plus

  • The ability to tell real performers from great talkers

  • Own sales experience is a bonus

  • A structured, data-informed approach and high ownership

  • Fluent German and English

Why Lio

  • Real impact: The people you hire drive our revenue and growth.

  • Proximity: You'll work side by side with our founders and sales leadership.

  • Builder mode: You'll shape the hiring standards behind our next stage of growth.

  • International scope: You'll build sales teams across Munich and New York.

Our bar is high, and this role is how we keep it there. If you want to build a world-class sales team, let's talk.

title: hbo-stage Social Media & Content Creatie
descriptionHtml:
hbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027

Ben jij creatief, nieuwsgierig en krijg je energie van social media die écht impact maakt?
Grijp de kans om jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen en zichtbaar te maken voor een groot publiek.

Dit is jouw uitdaging

Tijdens jouw stage bij het CBS duik je in de wereld van social media en ga je actief bijdragen aan het zichtbaar en begrijpelijk maken van belangrijke maatschappelijke cijfers.
Je krijgt de kans om jouw creativiteit in te zetten en verder te ontwikkelen. Je bedenkt nieuwe formats, werkt bestaande concepten uit en vertaalt complexe informatie naar content die mensen echt bereikt. Samen met het socialmediateam werk je aan sterke, herkenbare en aansprekende content.

Dit is wat je gaat doen:

  • Je ontwikkelt creatieve socialmediaformats die aansluiten bij de doelgroep en strategie van het CBS.

  • Je maakt content die daadwerkelijk wordt gepubliceerd op de socialmediakanalen van het CBS. Daarmee lever je een directe bijdrage aan de communicatie van een maatschappelijke organisatie.

  • Je vertaalt statistische informatie naar heldere en toegankelijke verhalen voor een breed publiek.

  • Je denkt actief mee over hoe het CBS zich creatief en onderscheidend kan positioneren op social media.

  • Je draagt bij aan content die impact heeft: jouw werk wordt gezien door een groot publiek en helpt mensen Nederland en de cijfers beter te begrijpen.

Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag

Je komt terecht in het socialmediateam van het CBS: een klein, hecht team waarin we in een informele sfeer samenwerken. De lijnen zijn kort en er is volop ruimte om ideeën te delen en initiatief te nemen.
We zijn continu op zoek naar manieren om onze content beter, creatiever en relevanter te maken. Dat betekent dat we graag experimenteren met formats, inspelen op trends en openstaan voor frisse perspectieven.

Dit breng jij mee

Je volgt een creatieve hbo-opleiding, zoals Communication & Multimedia Design, Creative Business of een vergelijkbare opleiding.

Je hebt kennis van en wellicht ervaring met:

  • Canva;

  • Adobe Creative Cloud;

  • het monteren van short-formcontent;

  • de nieuwste trends op social media.

Je denkt in mogelijkheden en krijgt energie van samenwerken.

Je hebt een ondernemende instelling en komt met innovatieve ideeën.

Dit kun je van ons verwachten

Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je:

  • jouw creatieve en socialmediaskills verder ontwikkelt in een professionele en informele werkomgeving;

  • leert om complexe statistische informatie te vertalen naar begrijpelijke en toegankelijke content voor een breed publiek;

  • effectief samenwerkt met betrokken collega's in een professioneel team.

Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week).

Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken.

Dit zijn onze voorwaarden

Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
Deze stageopdracht is bedoeld voor studenten die momenteel staan ingeschreven bij een onderwijsinstelling; afgestudeerden komen niet in aanmerking.

title: Head of Applied Research
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken is building the next generation of AI technologies for the energy sector, and we're looking for an exceptional Head of Applied Research to help lead that ambition.

As the advanced technology platform powering some of the world's largest energy utilities, Kraken has a unique combination of deep energy domain expertise along with technological rigor in AI and optimisation, offering a unique opportunity to develop AI technologies that shape how energy systems operate.

Kraken has been investing in the development of energy-specific AI models and intelligent decision-making systems to power products that can understand, predict and ultimately help shape how energy is consumed, managed and distributed.

This isn't a traditional research lab. Our focus is on building technically ambitious, commercially valuable AI systems that solve real-world problems. We want to push the boundaries of what's technically possible while ensuring that the technology we develop translates into meaningful products, measurable impact and lasting competitive advantage.

Reporting into and working closely with our Chief AI Officer, you'll help define Kraken's applied research strategy, establish the technical foundations for our next generation products and cultivate an exceptional team capable of delivering them.

This is an opportunity for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ambition to build something genuinely new - someone who is equally comfortable with the latest literature in the field, making difficult technical decisions and turning breakthrough ideas into implementable products.

🏡 What you'll own

Shape Kraken's next generation of AI technology

  • Partner with our Chief AI Officer to define and execute Kraken's applied research strategy and roadmap, identifying the foundational capabilities and proprietary technologies that will create lasting competitive advantage.

  • Lead the development of advanced AI models and architectures designed to understand and model complex energy systems, behavior, and decision-making.

  • Explore and develop approaches using foundation models, deep learning, transformer architectures, representation learning as well as emerging techniques to unlock new capabilities.

  • Develop generalisable models capable of supporting multiple products and applications per client.

  • Establish a technical roadmap that balances ambitious innovation with practical development, scalability and commercial outcomes.

Develop and lead an exceptional technical team

  • Develop, lead a high-performing team of AI researchers, research engineers and data scientists.

  • Establish a culture of technological excellence, intellectual curiosity, experimentation and strong execution.

  • Remain close to the technology, providing hands-on technical direction, challenging data modeling and architectural decisions and helping solve complex modelling problems.

  • Attract and develop exceptional technical talent, creating an environment where highly capable individuals can do the best work of their careers.

  • Set clear technical priorities, development standards and measures of success while giving the team the autonomy to explore ambitious ideas.

Develop proprietary AI models and intelligent systems

  • Lead the design, development, training and evaluation of advanced AI models.

  • Develop models capable of learning underlying patterns in energy demand and system behaviour, with the potential to generalise across different applications and environments.

  • Advance intelligent decision-making capabilities that move beyond prediction towards sophisticated reasoning, control and optimisation.

  • Evaluate new architectures and modelling approaches against existing methods, with the ambition to achieve state-of-the-art performance in strategically important areas.

  • Ensure models are technically robust, scalable and capable of being integrated into real-world production environments.

Drive AI research that turns into meaningful products

  • Work closely with engineering, product and commercial teams to ensure Kraken’s technological research addresses core client needs, with the potential to translate into products that deliver measurable value for Kraken and its clients.

  • Help establish the infrastructure, tooling and development practices required to build, evaluate, deploy and continuously improve sophisticated AI systems.

  • Define clear measures of model performance and commercial success, ensuring technical development remains connected to meaningful outcomes.

  • Apply advanced AI models to realtime multi-modal agentic workflows in demanding production environments

  • Build reusable AI capabilities that can support multiple products and business opportunities rather than isolated, one-off solutions.

Influence Kraken's broader AI direction

  • Act as a senior technical authority, helping shape strategic decisions around AI technologies, architectures and investment priorities.

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to AI, machine learning and engineering teams across Kraken.

  • Establish high standards for experimentation, model evaluation and responsible deployment.

  • Stay at the forefront literature, developments inAI research, identifying emerging capabilities that could transform software products that underpin the energy industry.

  • Support technical assessments of potential AI partnerships and acquisitions, helping inform build, buy and partner decisions.

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party

We're looking for an exceptional technical leader who has demonstrated the ability to develop advanced AI technology and turn it into real-world impact.

We're more interested in what you've built, the problems you've solved and the technical depth you bring than a particular job title.


Essential experience

  • Deep expertise in modern machine learning and deep learning, with a strong understanding of foundation models, model architectures, and data pipelines.

  • A proven track record of designing, developing or leading the creation of advanced AI models that have delivered measurable technical or commercial outcomes.

  • Strong technical knowledge of several areas such as transformer architectures, foundation-model training and adaptation, representation learning, time-series modelling, reinforcement learning and related machine learning techniques.

  • Experience working with large, complex datasets and developing models capable of identifying meaningful patterns, generalising across problems and operating at scale.

  • A strong understanding of the end-to-end model development lifecycle, including data preparation, training, evaluation, experimentation, inference and production deployment.

  • Experience building, leading or technically guiding high-performing teams of machine learning engineers, research engineers or applied AI specialists.

  • The ability to translate ambitious technical ideas into clear strategies, practical roadmaps and systems that create meaningful business value.

  • Strong technical judgement, including the ability to evaluate emerging approaches, challenge assumptions and make pragmatic decisions about where to invest.

  • The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and influence senior engineering, product and executive stakeholders.

Technical expertise

You'll bring significant depth in some of the following areas:

  • Foundation models, large language models and transformer-based architectures.

  • Large-scale pre-training, fine-tuning, distillation and model evaluation.

  • Time-series foundation models, representation learning and alternative approaches to structuring and tokenising complex data.

  • Reinforcement learning, decision-making models and learning-based optimisation.

  • Distributed model training and modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX.

  • Scalable data pipelines, training infrastructure, inference systems and production ML engineering.

  • Model evaluation, experimentation and techniques for improving performance, reliability and generalisation.

We don't expect you to be an expert in every area. What matters most is deep technical expertise, the ability to recognise promising approaches and the judgement to build the right capabilities around you.

⭐️ Bonus Points

  • PhD Machine Learning, neuroscience, Computer Science, Physics or a related discipline.

  • Experience developing foundation models or advanced AI systems using large-scale data.

  • Nice to have: experience with energy systems, electricity markets, demand forecasting, grid flexibility or other complex physical systems.

  • Experience applying AI to scientific, industrial or real-world decision-making problems.

  • Experience developing novel model architectures or achieving state-of-the-art results in a commercially relevant domain.

  • Experience establishing a new technical team, capability or product area from an early stage.

title: Head of HR / People & Culture (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest die People-Organisation eines echten Marktführers maßgeblich mitgestalten, bringst strategischen Weitblick mit und packst im operativen Tagesgeschäft weiterhin gerne selbst an?

Bei enua übernimmst Du die Gesamtverantwortung für den Personalbereich: Du entwickelst unsere HR-Organisation strategisch weiter, professionalisierst gruppenweite Standards und führst Dein Team (Junior HR Managerin & Office Managerin), während Du mitten im operativen Geschehen bleibst.

Über enua

enua ist ein ganzheitlicher Hersteller von medizinischem Cannabis mit der Mission, Patientinnen und Patienten einen sicheren und verlässlichen Zugang zu ermöglichen. Als zweitgrößter Anbieter im deutschen Markt und dynamisch wachsende internationale Unternehmensgruppe steuern wir 2026 auf rund 100 Mio. € Gruppenumsatz bei zweistelliger EBITDA-Marge zu. Nach einer Phase rasanter Skalierung verbinden wir unternehmerischen Pioniergeist mit wirtschaftlicher Exzellenz und legen den Fokus auf nachhaltige Professionalisierung, klare Standards und organisatorische Reife.

Das gestaltest Du mit uns

  • Ganzheitliche HR-Verantwortung: Du steuerst sämtliche Personalthemen, setzt gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung Prioritäten und übersetzt strategische Ziele in wirksame operative Maßnahmen.

  • Teamführung & Hands-on-Operations: Du führst und förderst Dein Team. Gleichzeitig erstellst Du Arbeitsverträge, Zeugnisse und personalrelevante Dokumente zuverlässig auch selbst und steuerst Payroll-Schnittstellen.

  • Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Du verantwortest das gesamte Recruiting - von Active Sourcing und Interviews bis zum Offer-Management - und sicherst ein persönliches, professionelles Onboarding.

  • Gruppenweite Standards & Digitalisierung: Du etablierst einheitliche Prozesse, Guidelines und Kennzahlen, optimierst unsere HR-Tools und nutzt moderne Workflows inklusive KI.

  • Kultur & Führung: Du berätst Führungskräfte auf Augenhöhe, etablierst praxisnahe Feedback- und Entwicklungsformate und stärkst eine leistungsorientierte, wertschätzende Kultur.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Erfahrung & Track Record: Mindestens 7+ Jahre fundierte, generalistische HR-Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem dynamischen Scale-up, einem stark wachsenden Mittelständler oder einem professionellen Unternehmensumfeld.

  • Führungskompetenz: Nachweisbare Führungserfahrung und die Fähigkeit, Mitarbeitende zu fordern, zu fördern und klare Prioritäten zu setzen.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Strategischer Gestaltungsanspruch kombiniert mit der Bereitschaft, im operativen Tagesgeschäft selbst anzupacken.

  • Fachkompetenz: Sehr fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen Arbeitsrecht und Sicherheit in der operativen HR-Praxis - von Vertragserstellung bis Offboarding.

  • Kommunikation & Sparring: Souveränes, verbindliches Auftreten gegenüber Geschäftsführung und Führungskräften; verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.

  • Arbeitsweise: Pragmatisch, analytisch, strukturiert und technologieoffen. Du bleibst flexibel, positiv und lösungsorientiert, auch wenn sich Prioritäten kurzfristig ändern oder Tempo gefragt ist.

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Volle Verantwortung, direkte Berichterstattung an die Geschäftsführung, kurze Entscheidungswege und spürbarer Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum.

Stabilität & Dynamik: Die Agilität eines Scale-ups kombiniert mit der Sicherheit und Schlagkraft eines hochprofitablen Marktführers.

Modernes Office in Köln: Ein moderner Office-Komplex in Köln mit bezuschusster Kantine, warmen Gerichten, Salatbar und Bowls. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Zusammenarbeit vor Ort, ergänzt durch einen Tag Homeoffice pro Woche.

Monatliche, individuell wählbare Gutscheine über hrmony, zum Beispiel für Urban Sports, die Deutsche Bahn, IKEA oder REWE.

Dein Start bei uns

Du möchtest Deine HR-Erfahrung einbringen, gemeinsam mit uns wachsen und dabei weiterhin selbst mit anpacken? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung und darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

title: Head of Legal
descriptionHtml:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth.

This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. You won't need to be an expert in every area, but you'll know when to answer yourself and when to orchestrate external support.

Reporting into our COO, you’ll become a trusted business partner to our leadership team and decision makers across Vio, pragmatically solving any problems and helping us think creatively about how we manage and mitigate our risk.

What you will do:

  • Write, review and negotiate our commercial contracts, starting with our affiliate and supply agreements

  • Be Vio's legal point of contact – orchestrating external counsel if required across all areas of the business, including but not limited to: Product and Consumer regulation (pricing transparency, DSA, GDPR, AI regulations), marketing and advertising rules, Employment (including hiring abroad and our Stock Appreciation Rights plan)

  • Corporate housekeeping and investment/transaction readiness

  • Baseline our current legal status and exposure and drive a plan to reduce legal debt

  • Get involved early alongside commercial and analytical leaders in contract and solution design, so what we build stands up to future legal scrutiny

  • Lead our outsourced legal work, including navigating the challenges of local jurisdictions

  • Drive projects that make Vio 'enterprise ready' and prepared for investment due diligence

  • Advise and educate leadership on legal risk, presenting clear options and recommendations

Who you are:

  • A technology / data oriented lawyer with significant commercial law experience

  • A legal generalist comfortable owning a broad legal portfolio and managing external specialists

  • Experienced in taking a legal function from 0 to 1, ideally in a founder-led, fast-growing company

  • Hands-on and motivated to drive projects yourself – you roll up your sleeves and get things done

  • Pragmatic, creative and a critical thinker – you don't just follow frameworks, you find solutions

  • Flexible – comfortable jumping across multiple topics in a single day

  • A concise, factual communicator who can break down complex topics and present business cases with multiple options. Able to push back when required.

  • Based in or able to relocate to the Netherlands, able to work from our Amsterdam office 3 days a week

Why join us now?

  • We’re one of the fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms in the world today, having grown our bookings 30x between 2017 and 2025, and catering to the needs of millions of travelers each year. We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

  • In 2026, we underwent a company-wide rebrand and launched our first StoryTelling marketing campaign in the UK. This was the next step in our commitment to help travelers book like insiders, and to establish Vio as a consumer-facing, creative brand.

  • The mobile applications (iOS and Android) we launched in 2023 have been a big success, reaching 5 million installs and earning strong customer reviews.

  • We’re a passionate and diverse team of tech enthusiasts and creatives, with a commitment to the traveler above all else.

  • We reward our employees for the value they create by granting Stock Appreciation Rights to all employees.

Do you want to know if Vio is the right place for you? Find out by reading about the attitude that thrives at Vio.

What we offer:

  • Plenty of chances to learn and grow within an open, diverse culture that promotes knowledge sharing, trust, and transparency.

  • A great compensation package, perks, and benefits – including significant stock appreciation rights.

  • Flexible time off, with as many holidays as you need, and a chance to work remotely.

  • You’ll be part of an international team in one of the best office locations in Amsterdam

  • We value good food and offer catered lunches from various cuisines, great coffee, and the occasional barbecue in our garden.

  • We enjoy getting together to celebrate our wins, with company events in Amsterdam and abroad.

  • A budget for your home office

  • Access to free mental health support via OpenUp

We encourage people from all ethnic groups, genders, sexualities, ages, and abilities to apply. If this job description resonates with you, we’d love to hear from you.

Please note: This role is based in Amsterdam – we're looking for candidates in the Amsterdam / Randstad area who can be in our office 3 days a week.

title: Head of People Tech, Data & AI
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne.

In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave.

As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care.

Role Purpose

Our members' experience in the clinic is delivered by our people, so people systems and people data are core to how Neko runs, not a back-office report. This role brings People technology, people data and the AI tools our People function builds under one leader. You'll own the architecture of how it all fits together: our HRIS, applicant tracking system, a new ticketing system, identity and access, integrations, automation and analytics, across HQ, our clinics and several countries, and how all of it connects to the rest of Neko.

You'll lead a small team of HR technology engineers, people data specialists and product builders who already design and ship AI tools and automations used across the company. You'll work very closely with Corporate Engineering, People Operations and Payroll. Your team builds and runs the systems; you decide what good looks like and stay close enough to the work to tell.

Most of this is being built now, and the scope grows with every clinic we open. It also comes with something very few people in this field get to do: connecting people data to member experience, so we can see how staffing, training and performance in our clinics show up in member feedback and NPS, and act on it.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

• Set one architecture for people systems, data and workflows, with clear ownership, shared definitions and build-versus-buy decisions

• Build scalable workflows inside and outside Workday, including our new ticketing system, together with Corporate Engineering

• Create a trusted source of truth for people data, with self-serve analytics that leaders actually use and clear rules on who can see what

• Bring people data into executive and board decisions, from what we measure and why to how it is presented (Impact, not activity)

• Connect workforce data to the headcount planning Finance and Operations run for clinic openings

• Put a shared AI foundation in place, with privacy and GDPR built in, that teams outside People build their own tools on (Chase 10X, not 10%)

• Ship the first data products behind performance, progression and feedback, and the first measured link between people data and member experience (Member-first, always)

Minimum Qualifications

• Senior experience shaping people technology, people data or internal platforms in a complex, multi-country organisation, at a level where you set the direction, not only run the systems

• A technical foundation, from engineering, data or systems integration: you understand how data flows, how integrations work and how systems talk to each other

• You know HR systems such as Workday well enough to design around them and to direct the people who configure them. You don't need to have led an HRIS team or configured Workday yourself

• You are AI-forward in practice: you use AI in your own work every day and have put AI tools, automations or agents into real use for other people, and you can explain where they helped and where they didn't

• Judgement on data models, metrics and definitions, and on which decisions are hard to reverse

• You can take a technical picture or a data story to executives and turn it into a decision

• You have led specialists or engineers, and you measure yourself by what other teams can do without you

• Able to work from our London or Stockholm office 2–3 days a week

Preferred Qualifications

• AI in production, not only prototypes: agents, knowledge integrations, evaluation and access control for agents

• Led complex migrations or integrations across systems and countries

• A background in data or people analytics

• Experience with large shift-based or frontline workforces

• Built privacy and access rules for employee data from the start

Organization and Way of Working

You'll report to our Director of Rewards and Enablement, and your closest partner outside People will be Corporate Engineering. The team works on European time and meets in our London and Stockholm hubs.

About titles at Neko

We use a simplified internal title framework that prioritises clarity over hierarchy, so the title on this posting may differ from your internal title. We’ll be open about the scope and level of the role throughout the process, so you know exactly what you’d be taking on.

title: Head of Product Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering leadership myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means an engineering leader who can still ship. Someone who owns the engineering end-to-end — the technical decisions, the pace, and the people who will lead the teams —and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.


What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.

Month 3: Own hiring and the team shape. Take over engineering hiring and build a process that runs without my oversight. Decide how the team is organised as it grows, and which lead roles we hire or grow into first. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.


What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?

After the first quarter, the job is running engineering: the organisation and the technical direction. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.

You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.

Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:

  • Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

  • Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

  • Organisation and leadership. Team structure, performance reviews, the hiring plan, and the managers and tech leads who will run the teams.

  • AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.

What success looks like

At 6 months: You have shown you can be one of the top performers in the team and coached others to perform better. The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality.

At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've hired and grown the first engineering /tech leads, and the structure will hold through the next doubling.


How we work

We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

  • AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here.

  • Zero-bugs. We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product.

  • We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us.

This role is for you if:

  • You've led an engineering org and made it ship faster. You've hired great senior engineers and helped them grow into leaders before, run the hard conversations, and know what breaks as a team grows from 10 to 20 in the AI era — and you can point to where cycle time dropped because of you.

  • You know what great engineers look like. You've thought deeply about what makes them productive, what holds them back, and how to move them forward — and you can spot one in a single interview.

  • You have an exceptional IC track record before becoming a manager. You were a senior/principal engineer before you started managing — you didn't skip into management early because coding wasn't working out.

  • You have product taste. You notice when a feature ships on time but isn't good enough, and you say so.

  • You hold people to a high standard. You're comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations about performance.

  • You're hands-on with AI-assisted development. You've used Cursor and Claude Code in real production work, not just toy projects. You have opinions about how AI changes the engineering workflow from ideation to release, and you want to push a team to keep getting faster.

  • You've worked in startups. You know what it feels like when there's low process, and the answer is "figure it out and ship it."

  • You think engineering culture can stay startup-like at scale. You're optimistic that a small, high-performing team can stay that way as it grows, with little process.

  • You communicate proactively in writing. In a remote team, written communication is how decisions get made and context gets shared. But you're not scared of jumping into a pair programming session either.


What we're looking for

Required

  • 10+ years as a software engineer, including 6+ years leading engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers or tech leads

  • You've grown an engineering team to 15+ at a VC-funded startup and hired most of it yourself. You've been through the messy middle, not just read about it

  • You've built what a growing team needs from scratch — hiring process, levels, performance reviews, salary bands — and kept it lightweight

  • You've shipped AI features to production — retrieval, RAG, agentic workflows — and you know the difference between a demo that works and one that holds up on real customer data

  • Product taste: a keen sense for what makes a product feel great, and the habit of saying so when it doesn't

  • You've built and shipped with Claude Code and Cursor in real production work, and you have opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debt

  • You're an engineer at heart. You were senior or principal before you managed, and you can still hold your own in a design review, a debugging session, or building a feature

  • You've built something zero to one at a startup, or scaled a team through the messy middle. You know what it feels like when there's no playbook

  • Able to work in European timezone (CET/CEST). EMEA-based, ideally Germany or UK

Nice to have

  • You've grown an engineering org past 20 in the AI era

  • You've taken an engineering team through an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit, so you know our customers' side of the product

  • You've led engineering for a B2B SaaS product moving from SMB into mid-market

Interview process

We want to see how you think, build, and lead — not test you on algorithms. Here's the process:

  • 30 min — Intro call with our talent team

  • 45 min — Interview with Grigory

  • 60 min — Technical interview

  • 1.5 hr — AI-assisted build session: system design for a real feature, then building part of it with AI

  • 2 hr — Leadership session with the founders

Then you’ll get the offer! If we don't make an offer, we'll tell you why.


What Secfix gives you

  • Remote: 100% remote with a real virtual office in Gather

  • Salary: Competitive, benchmarked to European market rates (we'll share specifics once we talk)

  • Equity: Generous package — we're all owners here

  • Development budget: €1,000/year — yours to spend on whatever makes you better

  • Workspace: Remote workspace support + co-working access

  • Holidays: 26 days + local public holidays

  • Health insurance: Comprehensive coverage

  • Annual retreat: Last time we went to Alicante 🇪🇸 — before that, the Austrian Alps, Portugal, Italy, and the Spanish Islands

  • Tech: MacBook, monitors, headphones — the latest

title: Head of SEO
descriptionHtml:
Our Company
At Quantum, we connect global brands with high-intent consumers. We turn intent into action and complexity into clarity.

Our Mission is clear, to help smarter, faster buying decisions. Our vision, to be the world’s most used digital comparison service, delivering value and simplicity to millions.

We drive growth through data-driven affiliate marketing built for performance from day one. Every campaign is measurable, optimised in real time, and designed to scale.

With in-house tech, full-stack analytics, and a compliance-first mindset, we give our partners an edge. We drive confident decisions and growth in regulated and high-growth sectors. We’ve helped ambitious brands grow faster, smarter, and globally.

The Role

We're hiring for a Head of SEO to own organic search presence across our iGaming and Rewards propositions in the UK and US. This is a build role: you'll set the strategy, hire the team and put the tooling and processes in place to execute.

You'll turn organic search into a predictable, compliant growth channel measured on commercial outcomes, not just rankings. That means registrations, purchases and revenue for iGaming, and sign-ups and active members for Rewards.

You'll look after four sites: cashback.co.uk, joincustard.co.uk, strikewild.co.uk and slotswise.com.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and ownership

  • Set and own the organic search strategy for iGaming and Rewards across the UK and US, with clear targets and a 12-month roadmap

  • Prioritise by commercial value: focus effort on the verticals, states, merchants and page types that drive purchases, revenue and member growth

  • Own the SEO budget and make the case for investment in people, tools, content and links

  • Work closely with commercial, paid, CRM, brand and compliance teams so SEO priorities match merchant deals and launch plans

Building the team

  • Hire and lead a team from scratch, starting with the roles the roadmap needs most (for example, technical SEO, content SEO, outreach)

  • Decide what to build in-house and what to outsource, and manage agencies and freelancers where it makes sense

  • Set the processes, playbooks and tooling the team runs on

Technical SEO

  • Own site health across our properties: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data and internal linking

  • Work with product and engineering to put SEO into templates, releases and migrations from the start

  • Build scalable page frameworks for reviews, comparisons, offers and state or market landing pages

Content and authority

  • Set the content strategy and editorial standards, with E-E-A-T and YMYL expectations built in

  • Lead a safe, sustainable approach to digital PR and link acquisition in competitive, closely watched SERPs

  • Shape our approach to AI-powered search, AI Overviews and generative engine optimisation (GEO) so our brands are cited and trusted

Markets and compliance

  • Run distinct UK and US plans that reflect each market's regulation, search behaviour and competition

  • Plan US state launches so content and authority are ready ahead of go-live

  • Make sure every page meets UKGC, ASA/CAP, US state and responsible gambling requirements

Measurement

  • Build reporting that links organic traffic to clickouts, registrations, purchases and revenue

  • Track rankings, share of voice and competitor movement, and act on what the data shows

  • Report performance and forecasts to the leadership team

About You

Essential

  • 8+ years in SEO, with at least 3 years leading SEO strategy and people

  • A track record of growing organic revenue in iGaming, affiliate or another highly competitive, regulated vertical

  • Hands-on depth in technical SEO, and the credibility to work as a peer with engineering

  • Experience hiring and building a team, or a clear plan for how you'd do it

  • Working knowledge of UK and US gambling regulation and what it means for content and marketing

  • Deep understanding and practical application of AI, GEO and the impact on organic search visibility

  • Commercial sense: you can forecast, build a business case and tie your work to revenue

  • Strong command of the core toolset, for example Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, Screaming Frog, and BigQuery or SQL

  • Clear communication with senior, commercial and technical audiences

Nice to have

  • Experience launching in newly regulated US states

  • Background in rewards, cashback, loyalty or comparison sites

  • Experience with programmatic or templated SEO at scale

  • Experience running site migrations or consolidations

What You’ll Get

  • Private Health Care (Vitality)

  • Hybrid Working (3 days in office)

  • Travel Insurance

  • Competitive Base Salary

  • Company Bonus Scheme

  • Paid for AI Subscription (Claude / ChatGPT / Gemini)

  • Market-Leading Training Programme

  • Recognition & Reward Scheme

  • Annual Company Conference

  • Regular Happy Hours & Team Lunches

  • Free Coffee, Drinks & Snacks

What’s the next step?

Our hiring process ensures we're recruiting the right people for the role. We ensure that people are as suitable for us as we are for them.

title: HR-Manager*in / Personalreferent*in (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Gestalte unseren Personalbereich – mit Verantwortung, Freiraum und echten Menschen.

RiNiBo GmbH | Gastronomie & Events | 30–40 Stunden/Woche | Teilweise Homeoffice möglich

Über Uns

Die RiNiBo GmbH betreibt mehrere Gastronomieobjekte in Köln, darunter das Johann Schäfer Brauhaus & Biergarten, die Taqueria Los Carnales sowie das Marie & Johann in Kooperation mit Kasalla. Unser Ziel ist es, unseren Gästen das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten. Für unser Team in Köln suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine Verstärkung als HR-Manager*in / Personalreferent*in (m/w/d) im Rahmen eines erstmal auf 12-24 Monate befristeten Arbeitsvertrags mit 30-40 Stunden pro Woche.

Deine Mission

Du übernimmst die eigenständige Betreuung und Organisation unseres Personalbereichs. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung und unseren Betriebsleitungen zusammen.

Du bist nicht einfach nur für Personalakten zuständig. Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Personalprozesse funktionieren, unsere Führungskräfte gut unterstützt werden und unsere Mitarbeitenden eine verlässliche Ansprechperson haben.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Recruiting: Du organisierst unsere Personalsuche – von der Stellenanzeige über das Bewerbermanagement bis zur Begleitung von Vorstellungsgesprächen.

  • Personaladministration: Du erstellst Arbeitsverträge, pflegst Personalakten und kümmerst dich um Bescheinigungen und weitere personalrelevante Dokumente.

  • Vorbereitende Lohnabrechnung: Du bereitest alle relevanten Daten auf und arbeitest eng mit unserem externen Steuerbüro zusammen.

  • Arbeitszeitmanagement: Du kontrollierst und betreust unsere digitale Zeiterfassung, Urlaubs- und Krankmeldungen und sorgst für eine verlässliche Datenbasis.

  • Onboarding & Offboarding: Du begleitest Mitarbeitende vom ersten bis zum letzten Arbeitstag und sorgst für strukturierte Abläufe.

  • Mitarbeiterbetreuung: Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden und unterstützt Führungskräfte bei Personalfragen und Konflikten.

  • Arbeitsrecht: Du behältst gesetzliche und tarifliche Vorgaben im Blick, unterstützt die Geschäftsführung bei arbeitsrechtlichen Fragestellungen und begleitest deren praktische Umsetzung.

  • Personalentwicklung: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Ideen für Schulungen, Mitarbeiterbindung und eine gute Zusammenarbeit.

Wir arbeiten bereits mit digitalen Lösungen für Zeiterfassung, Dienstplanung und Personalverwaltung, unter anderem mit Gastromatic, Lohnmanager & Ordio. Du musst also nicht bei null anfangen – hast aber viel Raum, bestehende Abläufe zu verbessern und weiterzuentwickeln.

Wen wir suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der Personal nicht nur verwalten, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge voranbringen möchte.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Personalwesen mitbringst und die wesentlichen HR-Prozesse sicher beherrschst.

  • Eine kaufmännische Ausbildung mit HR-Schwerpunkt, eine Weiterbildung im Personalbereich, ein passendes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation hast.

  • Dich im deutschen Arbeitsrecht auskennst und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit unterschiedlichen Beschäftigungsformen gesammelt hast.

  • Selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig arbeitest.

  • Sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen umgehst und Freude daran hast, Arbeitsabläufe effizienter zu gestalten.

  • Empathie, Kommunikationsstärke und ein gutes Gespür für unterschiedliche Menschen mitbringst.

  • Vertraulich und verantwortungsbewusst mit sensiblen Personalinformationen umgehst.

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse besitzt. Englischkenntnisse sind aufgrund unserer internationalen Teams von Vorteil.

Erfahrung in der Gastronomie ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass Du die Besonderheiten unserer Branche kennenlernen möchtest und Freude an einer abwechslungsreichen, praxisnahen Personalarbeit hast.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die unseren Personalbereich eigenständig betreuen kann und Lust hat, neue Strukturen mit aufzubauen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine neu geschaffene Position mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum: Du kannst unseren Personalbereich aktiv mitgestalten und eigene Ideen umsetzen.

  • 30–40 Stunden pro Woche mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Teilweise Homeoffice: Eine Kombination aus Büroarbeit und mobilem Arbeiten ist möglich.

  • Eigenverantwortung statt Konzernbürokratie: Du arbeitest selbstständig, mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direktem Austausch mit der Geschäftsführung.

  • Eine attraktive und faire Vergütung, die deiner Erfahrung und Verantwortung entspricht.

  • Personalessen und Getränke in unseren Betrieben.

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte in unseren Gastronomiekonzepten.

  • Weiterbildungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln kannst.

  • Abwechslung statt Routine: Unterschiedliche Betriebe, internationale Teams und vielfältige Beschäftigungsmodelle sorgen für spannende Aufgaben.

  • Ein persönliches Miteinander: Wir legen Wert auf gute Beziehungen zu unseren Mitarbeitenden, offene Kommunikation und gegenseitigen Respekt.

Lust, unseren Personalbereich mit uns zu gestalten?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Wir suchen jemanden, der nicht nur die organisatorische Seite von HR beherrscht, sondern auch versteht, dass hinter jedem Arbeitsvertrag ein Mensch steht.

Der Einstieg ist ab sofort beziehungsweise zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt möglich.

Erzähl uns, wer du bist, welche Erfahrungen du mitbringst und warum du Lust hast, die Personalarbeit bei RiNiBo mitzugestalten.

Dein Team der RiNiBo GmbH

title: Innovation Quant Developer Intern (DeFi/Corporate Development) - London
descriptionHtml:
Innovation Quant Developer: Intern - DeFi/Corporate Development

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Linear Market Making, DeFi trading , Credit/curation and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge

  

The role

About Corporate Development
In our Corporate Development team, we identify, evaluate, prototype, and build strategic innovations across digital asset markets and Web3 ecosystems. Operating at the intersection of quantitative analysis, technology due diligence, and venture/strategic growth, the Corp Dev team works on evaluating emerging crypto primitives, building data-driven systems to track market trends, and assessing the technical viability of potential deals, partnerships, and new business lines. As an Innovation Quant Developer Intern, you will work directly with quant developers and Corp Dev strategists to prototype new technologies, conduct technical due diligence, and support strategic growth initiatives.

Key Responsibilities of an Innovation Quant Developer Intern in this unit

  • Web3 Primitive & Technology Evaluation: Assist in evaluating new Web3.0 primitives, DeFi protocols, and emerging blockchain infrastructure, analyzing engineering requirements to align with Corporate Development growth goals.

  • Market Intelligence & Data Analytics: Use Python, SQL, and data analytics to track emerging technologies, monitor market trends, and deliver actionable data-driven insights for strategic growth opportunities.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Foundation: Graduating student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related technical field with a solid code-first foundation in Python and SQL (with Git proficiency).

  • Web3 & Digital Asset Passion: Strong understanding of and active, deep interest in Web3.0, digital assets, blockchain primitives, and capital markets.

  • Analytical & Prototyping Mindset: Ability to analyze technical documentation, work with data/on-chain telemetry, evaluate emerging technologies, and build quantitative models or prototype tools.

  • Drive & Ownership: Self-starter with strong communication skills, curiosity to learn rapidly, and an owner mentality to contribute directly to strategic projects.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Hands-on experience prototyping smart contracts or Web3 tools, familiarity with Rust, Solidity, EVM event logs, or previous internship/project experience in crypto or quantitative finance.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

title: Integrity Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
Introduction to Role & Team

Bumble Inc. is looking for an Integrity Operations Specialist to join our Trust Operations team. Trust and safety are central to Bumble’s mission to create a world where all relationships are healthy and equitable, and in this role you’ll help bring that mission to life by supporting members through some of their most sensitive and challenging experiences.

You’ll investigate safety concerns, review accounts and content against Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines, and provide compassionate, trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents. You’ll work across a range of complex and sensitive issues, using established policies, operational guidance, sound judgment, and AI-supported tools to reach fair and consistent outcomes. You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.

This role will be based in the U.K. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.

Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.

  • Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

  • Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.

  • Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.

  • Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.

  • Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.

  • Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.

About you

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.

  • Are comfortable reviewing potentially distressing content, including material relating to child exploitation, sexual or physical violence, suicide and self-harm, while approaching this work with care and professionalism.

  • Communicate clearly and compassionately in writing and verbally, particularly when supporting vulnerable individuals or navigating sensitive situations.

  • Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.

  • Collaborate purposefully with colleagues, take ownership of your work, and maintain an agile mindset as priorities, cases, and operational needs evolve.

  • Proficiency in Spanish, Portuguese, French, or another language in addition to English is welcomed but not required.

About Us

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

AI Fluency

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

Final Compensation

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

Inclusion at Bumble Inc.

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

Fraudulent Candidate Detection

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy.
