title: Interaction Designer, HCI
descriptionHtml:
About Act

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Role

You will design the detailed mechanics of how users interact with A1 - the gestures, states, flows, and micro-decisions that determine whether an AI-driven product feels controlled or confusing.

This role is focused on HCI interaction design: how users give input, receive feedback, supervise AI actions, correct mistakes, and maintain agency over AI-driven workflows.

There are no established playbooks for interaction design in proactive AI products. You will help define new patterns from the ground up.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Design detailed interaction models for AI-driven flows, including how users initiate, monitor, pause, correct, and complete multi-step tasks.

  • Define interaction states for AI interfaces: idle, thinking, acting, waiting, uncertain, interrupted, failed, and recovered.

  • Design human-in-the-loop controls - how users review AI decisions, override actions, and stay informed without micromanaging.

  • Create interaction patterns for delegation, approval, correction, escalation, reversibility, and recovery.

  • Create detailed interaction specifications, annotated flows, and prototypes for engineering handoff.

  • Work with product and ML teams to translate system capabilities and constraints into usable interaction patterns.

  • Test interaction designs with real users to identify where AI behavior creates confusion, distrust, or friction.

  • Contribute to a shared library of HCI interaction patterns that can be reused across the product.

What You Will Need

  • Experience as an interaction designer or senior UX designer with strong interaction design depth.

  • Ability to design at the micro level - states, transitions, edge cases, and failure handling.

  • Strong prototyping skills in Figma or equivalent tools.

  • Systematic thinking - able to map complex AI behavior into coherent user-facing interaction logic.

  • Clear understanding of HCI principles: user control, transparency, feedback, and graceful recovery.

  • Experience working closely with engineers to ensure interactions are implemented as designed.

  • Comfort designing for systems where output is non-deterministic and behavior can vary across sessions.

  • Strong judgment on when users should be guided, interrupted, asked for confirmation, or left alone.

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

For design roles, we expect candidates to submit a portfolio as part of the application process.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2 rounds of interviews and a design assessment.

Applications are evaluated by our team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Junior TechOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Hozah

Hozah makes parking automatic. Our cameras recognise your car when you arrive and payment happens by itself when you leave. No apps, no machines, no tickets. We were named PayTech Company of the Year, we sit in Deloitte's list of the 50 fastest growing tech companies in the UK, and we are expanding our estate of automated car parks across the country.

Every site runs on ANPR cameras, payment kiosks, edge devices and 4G connectivity, and all of it has to work around the clock. The TechOps team keeps that estate healthy, and we are looking for a junior engineer to join it.

The role

You will be hands-on from day one, helping to monitor, maintain and fix the technology running in car parks across the country. When a camera drops offline, a kiosk misbehaves or a site stops reporting data, you will be part of the team that works out why and puts it right, usually remotely.

You will learn a genuinely broad set of skills in one role: networking, IoT devices, monitoring, APIs, databases and cloud systems, all on a live estate where your work has visible impact the same day. You will be coached and supported as you grow, with clear standards, documented processes and experienced engineers around you.

What you'll be doing

  • Monitoring the health of cameras, kiosks and network equipment across 150+ car parks, and acting when something looks wrong.

  • Diagnosing and fixing faults across devices, networks and our backend platform, working through problems methodically.

  • Preparing, configuring and shipping hardware for new sites, and supporting site launches.

  • Keeping inventory, configuration records and documentation accurate and up to date.

  • Managing your tickets in Jira with clear notes, sensible prioritisation and proper follow-through.

  • Learning constantly: from the TechOps team, from our developers, and from the estate itself.

What we're looking for

This is a junior role. We care more about fundamentals, honesty and appetite to learn than years of experience.

  • Around 1–2 years of hands-on experience in IT support, infrastructure or technical operations, or strong fundamentals you can demonstrate from projects, a home lab or study.

  • Networking basics you can explain in plain English: what a switch and a router do, what an IP address is, what a VPN is for.

  • A structured instinct when something goes offline: check power, check the network, check the device, in that order.

  • Some awareness of APIs and SQL. You do not need to be fluent; knowing what they are and wanting to use them is enough.

  • Solid Windows knowledge: event logs, command line, system configuration.

  • Organised, reliable and calm when something breaks on a live site.

What this role isn't

  • Corporate IT support. The users of our systems are cameras and cars, and the work is looking after a distributed technology estate.

  • A narrow role. You will touch hardware, networking, software and data in the same week.

  • A dead end. The team is growing, the estate is growing, and there is a clear path to more senior TechOps work as you develop.

Salary, location and working pattern

  • 4 days a week in our Croydon office, 1 day from home, with occasional site visits.

  • Free breakfast, lunch, drinks and snacks in the office, excellent transport links, and two friendly office dogs.

  • You will need the right to work in the UK. A full UK driving licence is handy for site visits.

title: Labour AI Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Sona

Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment.

We think that's because the problem needed AI, not just better software, before it was solvable. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years.

We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here.

About the Role

Sona's Labour AI team builds the forecasting, rules and scheduling tools that help hospitality and retail businesses get staffing right. This role is about getting that tooling to work for a specific site: its trading patterns, its staff, its quirks. You'll work directly with customers to turn Sona's tools into labour models that are used on site and have a huge impact.

You'll derive labour rules from real trading data, spend time on site with customer teams to learn how the business runs, and build the trust with site managers. You'll present the impact and ROI of that work to customer executives and general managers, and act as the subject matter expert for labour optimisation in sales conversations.

You'll also be the person site managers trust enough to change how they staff, and the person customer executives and General Managers trust enough to back the changes you're proposing. You'll need as much influence as analysis to make that work. You'll report back to customer leadership on the impact, in numbers they can take to their own board.

You'll adapt the same underlying labour model across different business types, from QSR to premium dining to retail.

Responsibilities

  • Derive labour rules from real trading data using Sona's tooling and your own operational knowledge

  • Spend time on site with customer teams, learning practical realities like stock deliveries and close-down procedures

  • Build trust with site managers so workload models actually get followed

  • Present impact and ROI to customer executives and general managers, winning buy-in for operational change

  • Act as the labour optimisation subject matter expert in sales conversations

  • Work across the full portfolio of live customer projects, picking up work as priorities shift between accounts

Requirements

  • An operational background in hospitality, retail, or a similar hourly-workforce, fluctuating-demand business. You understand how the business runs day to day, not just how to analyse it from the outside

  • Confident presenting to and winning buy-in from customer executives, general managers and boards, and comfortable holding your own with competing agendas in the room

  • Comfortable with technology and confident picking up new tools quickly, including using AI tools in your own workflow

  • Able to look into the data yourself and make decisions from what you find

  • Comfortable operating without a fixed playbook

  • Excited about using AI in your day-to-day work to 10x your output

  • Bonus: a retail or workforce-management background where the underlying concepts transfer to hospitality

Bonus: a commercial finance background with genuine credibility in front of operators

We're a hybrid working team you can expect to work 2+ days/week in our London office (Soho), and 2+ days/week on site with customers.

Benefits

  • Salary: £85,000 - £100,000

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days)

  • Extra day of leave for every year of service

  • Pension contributions matched up to 5%

  • Comprehensive health insurance

  • Enhanced parental leave & pay

  • Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery)

  • Annual all expenses paid team retreats

  • The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office

  • Professional development budget

  • Unlimited free books

Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you.

You'll own the methodology that drives successful Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) engagements, accelerating customer adoption, getting high-value workflows into production, and enabling customers to become independent builders.

To achieve this, you'll focus on four key areas:

  • Help define readiness, certification, and quality expectations for partner Deployment Strategists to enable consistent customer experiences at scale.

  • Work closely with FDEs, Product, and Engineering to turn customer feedback, technical gaps, feature requests, and custom integration needs into actionable product insights.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🤝 Enterprise Customer Experience: You have 7+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as professional services, solutions consulting, implementation, or customer success within a software company.

  • 🌟 People Leadership: You have 2+ years of experience leading, coaching, and developing customer-facing teams, with a track record of building high-performing teams.

  • 🚀 0-to-1 Builder Experience: You've built or scaled a deployment, implementation, or professional services function and know how to create structure and repeatable processes in an evolving environment.

  • 💼 Executive Stakeholder Management: You're experienced in leading executive discovery, building compelling ROI cases, and securing buy-in from multiple stakeholders within enterprise organizations.

  • 🛠️ Technical Fluency: You're comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations, and AI use cases with technical stakeholders and collaborating closely with engineers without needing to write code yourself.

Nice-to-haves

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to build a brand-new function at the heart of how we scale enterprise customer adoption. You won't just manage a team — you'll shape how we engage customers, demonstrate the value of automation, and turn high-impact use cases into production workflows that drive lasting business outcomes.

You'll join a supportive, remote-first team that values autonomy, collaboration, and continuous learning, where your impact will be visible from day one.

title: Lead / Principal Engineer - Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
A different kind of organisation

  • High trust, transparency, and autonomy
  • Small teams, high ownership, flat structures
  • Radical compensation transparency
  • Sense of ownership in collective success
  • Work with exceptional people who deeply care about their craft

The role

As a Principal Consultant, you're often the first person a customer meets to brainstorm a business problem. You should be at home debating distributed systems with engineers and framing decisions with leadership. You'll frame the problem with customers, shape the approach with the team, provide technical direction, and stay hands-on through delivery. You will work in self-managing, experienced, small, and high-impact teams, solving hard problems. This is a consulting & tech delivery role  and while you will not have direct reports, you will regularly influence teams, mentor practitioners, manage stakeholders, and guide organisations through complex technology and business decisions.

What the work looks like

We can't promise which problem you'll pick up, but the menu right now looks something like this:

  • Redesign a ClickHouse schema so an ad buyer can query 85 billion rows in under two seconds, and discover that pre-exploding the rows 168x is actually the right answer.
  • Keep a vehicle telemetry platform moving billions of messages a day without the Kafka consumers falling over.
  • Build the engineering spine of a mobile wallet used by more than two billion people across four continents.
  • Ship the data product behind peer-review submissions for one of the world's largest scientific publishers.

The list changes every quarter. The pattern doesn't: data-heavy, distributed, and often sitting on top of something that already exists and isn't perfect.

What you'll do

Frame Problems & Propose Solutions

  • Help customers find the right problem before jumping to a solution.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and technical workshops.
  • Translate business goals into a technology strategy and an execution plan.

Mit einer Präsenz in über 100 Ländern und einem vielfältigen Portfolio von rund 1.500 Tonies in mehreren Sprachen definieren wir weiterhin neu, wie Kinder Geschichten und Lernen erleben. Seit unserem Börsengang im Jahr 2021 ist unser globales Team von mehr als 630+ Kolleg:innen durch eine gemeinsame Mission vereint: die Zukunft des Spielens, Lernens und der Fantasie zu gestalten.

Werde Teil unseres tonies-Teams und der inspirierenden Mission, innovative und großartige Audio-Erlebnisse für Kinder auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen!

 

Lifecycle Marketing Manager DACH (all genders) - Befristet auf 2 Jahre

  

Deine Rolle & Dein Impact

Als Lifecycle Manager DACH (all genders) bist du unsere zentrale Expert:in für die Bindung und Aktivierung unserer Bestandskund:innen in unserer Kernregion. Deine Mission ist es, den kommerziellen Wert unserer Community nachhaltig zu steigern, indem du globale Strategien mit lokalem Fokus zum Leben erweckst.

In dieser Rolle berichtest du an die Teamlead Growth und agierst an der entscheidenden Schnittstelle zwischen Marketing, Sales und Operations, um Trends frühzeitig zu erkennen und Wachstumschancen zu nutzen. Du fungierst als die „Stimme des Marktes“ für die DACH-Region: Du stellst sicher, dass globale Initiativen lokal maximale Resonanz finden, und treibst dabei zentrale Erfolgskennzahlen wie den Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) sowie die Reduzierung der Churn-Rate voran.

Um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein, bringst du ein ausgeprägtes kommerzielles Verständnis und eine hohe Datenaffinität mit. Zudem verstehst du es, Stakeholder über verschiedene Funktionsbereiche hinweg zu steuern und für gemeinsame Ziele zu gewinnen.

Die Stelle ist auf 2 Jahre befristet.

 

Das bewegst Du bei uns

  • Operative Schnittstellenfunktion: Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Global Lifecycle Team und den lokalen Marktteams und stellst sicher, dass globale Initiativen lokal reibungslos implementiert und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.

  • Lokales Performance-Monitoring: Du nutzt globale Daten, um die Retention-Performance im DACH-Markt kontinuierlich zu überwachen, operative Trends zu identifizieren und daraus gezielte Maßnahmen zur Performance-Steigerung abzuleiten.

  • Praxisnaher Austausch: Du spiegelst lokale Markterkenntnisse und Best Practices an das globale Team zurück und lieferst konkrete Impulse, um die Kundenbindung und die User Journey vor Ort operativ zu optimieren.

  • Lokalisierung & Implementierung: Du adaptierst globale Retention-Maßnahmen für deinen Markt und arbeitest eng mit cross-funktionalen Stakeholdern zusammen, um messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

  • Ideengeber für lokale Aktionen: Du entwickelst passende Maßnahmen für den DACH-Markt – zum Beispiel bei Preisen, Angeboten oder am Point of Sale (POS) – und gibst diese Impulse an die umsetzenden Teams weiter. Dabei behältst du den Fortschritt immer im Blick und bist verantwortlich dafür, dass die Themen vorankommen und Ergebnisse liefern.

  • Strukturierte Test-and-Learn-Initiativen: Du führst Pilotprojekte innerhalb des globalen Testing-Frameworks durch, um neue Ansätze zu validieren und eine konsistente, messbare Wirkung sicherzustellen.

  • KPI-Verantwortung & Reporting: Gemeinsam mit den Stakeholdern verantwortest du die Erreichung zentraler Retention-KPIs (z. B. Hördauer, Wiederkaufsrate, Churn, Profitabilität) und stellst ein präzises Tracking sicher.

  • Voice of the Customer: Du fungierst als Sprachrohr unserer Community in der DACH-Region, sorgst für teamübergreifende Transparenz bezüglich ihrer Bedürfnisse und treibst die kontinuierliche Optimierung des gesamten Kundenerlebnisses voran.

 

Das bringst Du mit

  • Fundierte Erfahrung: Du verfügst über mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Retention, Lifecycle oder Growth Marketing, idealerweise in einem DTC-Umfeld oder bei Unternehmen mit wiederkehrenden Umsatzmodellen (z. B. Subscriptions).

  • Kommerzielles & strategisches Mindset: Du denkst unternehmerisch, kannst Wachstumschancen strategisch bewerten und verfügst über ein tiefes Verständnis für kunden- und finanzbezogene Kennzahlen.

  • Datenexpertise: Du bist absolut datengetrieben und sicher im Umgang mit Analysetools wie Tableau oder Amplitude. Es fällt dir leicht, komplexe Daten in einfache, kommerziell relevante Insights zu übersetzen.

  • Umsetzungsstärke: Du verstehst es, Probleme strukturiert anzugehen, Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld richtig zu setzen und Initiativen über verschiedene Teams hinweg erfolgreich ins Ziel zu bringen.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und besitzt die Fähigkeit, cross-funktionale Teams zu steuern, Stakeholder zu überzeugen und eine starke Ausrichtung auf gemeinsame Ziele zu schaffen.

  • Growth-Mindset: Als proaktiver Self-Starter mit hoher Eigenverantwortung fühlst du dich auch in unklaren Situationen wohl und hast den Drive, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

  • Sprachkompetenz: Du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch, um sowohl lokal als auch mit unseren globalen Teams erfolgreich zusammenzuarbeiten.

 

Warum tonies?

  • Globale Teamarbeit: Wir arbeiten gemeinsam über Abteilungs- und Ländergrenzen hinweg an unserer Vision, die Toniebox in alle Kinderzimmer der Welt zu bringen.

  • Come as you are: Das gilt nicht nur für den Dresscode, sondern auch für alles andere. Denn nur wo du dich wirklich wohlfühlst, kannst du auch dein Bestes geben.

  • Mobilität: Wähle das Angebot, das am besten zu dir passt – ein Deutschlandticket Job für uneingeschränkte Mobilität, eine monatliche Zuzahlung von fünfzig Euro für einen Büro-Parkplatz, ein Leasing-Fahrrad oder als Remote Work Zuschuss.

  • Absicherung: Profitiere von Zuschüssen zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und einer Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung.

  • Erholung & Auszeit: Genieße 30 Tage bezahlten Jahresurlaub sowie drei zusätzliche freie Tage wie Rosenmontag, Heiligabend und Silvester. Nach einem Jahr Betriebszugehörigkeit kannst du zudem bis zu 10 "toniecation days" (unbezahlte Urlaubstage) nutzen.

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Profitiere von unseren internen und externen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten sowie einem individuellen Lernbudget, um dein Wissen kontinuierlich zu erweitern.

  • Sprachen lernen und Entspannen leicht gemacht: Verbessere deine kommunikativen Fähigkeiten mit der Sprachlern-App Babbel und finde Entspannung durch unseren Zugang zur Meditations-App Calm.

  • Vergünstigungen: Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten auf unser gesamtes tonies Sortiment.

Zu unseren Grundsätzen gehört es, dass wir uns bei tonies® für Inklusion und Vielfalt einsetzen. Wir feiern die unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten, Herkünfte, Glaubensvorstellungen und geschlechtlichen Identitäten, die sich unter unserem Dach vereinen. Jedes Gesicht ist bei uns willkommen und wird in allen Entwicklungsphasen mit und von uns unterstützt.

title: Machine Learning Data Scientist posting
descriptionHtml:
Role summary:

At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.

We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.

This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.

We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.

How you’ll work

  • You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

  • You’ll own your research projects from scoping to delivery, with support from our modelling lead but with autonomy and independence.

  • You’ll work closely with our wet lab, dry lab and software teams, and identify which data you need to generate from our robotic lab.

Key responsibilities:

Hybrid bioprocess modelling

  • Develop hybrid mechanistic/ML cell response models that predict fermentation outcomes (growth, titer, yield, productivity) from process and sensor data.

  • Fuse time-series signals from process analytical technology (Raman, NIR, dielectric spectroscopy, dissolved oxygen, off-gas) with offline analytics.

  • Build mechanistic backbones (e.g., kinetic/ODE models, genome-scale metabolic models) that constrain learning and generate synthetic training data.

  • Develop machine learning surrogate models for computationally costly mechanistic simulations.

  • Quantify uncertainty so that models can be trusted in high-stakes production settings.

Transfer across organisms and scales

  • Design models that carry over from benchtop to pilot and production scale, and across various microbes including bacteria and yeast.

  • Use transfer learning and representation learning to make good predictions for new strains and processes with little data.

  • Develop scale-transferable reactor characterisations and predictive KPI models for scale-up.

Real-time Model-Predictive Control

  • Build the AI/ML layer for Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC) and reinforcement-learning-based feeding strategies to optimize titer, rate, and yield dynamically.

  • Fuse real-time data from Process Analytical Technology (PAT) and soft sensors (e.g., Raman, NIR) into dynamic state estimators to drive closed-loop bioreactor actuators (feed, air, agitation).

  • Prototype simpler, deployable steps along the way, such as deviation detection and operator alerts

  • Design control frameworks to proactively resolve metabolic bottlenecks and robustly account for model uncertainty, batch-to-batch variability, and inherent bioprocess stochasticity.

Qualifications:

  • PhD in machine learning, bioengineering, computational biology, or a related field, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong research independence; ability to scope and execute novel scientific work from start to finish.

  • Demonstrated evidence of research contributions, including (but not limited to): peer-reviewed journal or conference papers, conference attendance, open-source contributions.

  • Strong Python and modern ML tooling (e.g., PyTorch/JAX, scikit-learn).

  • Hands-on experience building models of dynamical systems or time-series data, ideally combining mechanistic and data-driven approaches.

  • Experience working with frontier coding models, including multi-agent orchestration.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, including with non-ML partners.

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience with bioprocess or fermentation data, ideally from bioreactors at more than one scale

  • Experience with Raman, NIR, or other spectroscopic data and chemometrics (e.g., PLS)

  • Background in model-predictive control, reinforcement learning, or optimal control

  • Experience with transfer learning, domain adaptation, or representation learning on biological data

  • Familiarity with genome-scale metabolic models or kinetic modelling

  • Experience with Bayesian methods, uncertainty quantification, or design of experiments

  • Experience in collaborative or publicly funded research projects (e.g. Horizon Europe, Eurostars)

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation through salary + stock options; we are looking to build a small but mighty team and think about compensation along those lines;

  • Build your research profile: Work on open problems with leading European academic and industrial partners, with the intention to present and publish your work;

  • A beautiful office in the heart of Munich, or remote work option with occasional travel

  • eGym WellPass membership

title: macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a hands-on macOS & Jamf Automation Engineer to engineer, automate and continuously improve the services that support our global Apple device estate. This role is focused on delivering a secure, reliable and consistent macOS experience at scale through Jamf Pro, reusable code, APIs and modern engineering practices.

You will replace repetitive administration and one-off scripts with maintainable automation for device enrolment, configuration, application delivery, patching, compliance and lifecycle management. Working across Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager, identity, security, asset and service-management platforms, you will build integrations and workflows that make Apple device services easier to operate, measure and support.

Engineering mindset
Automation is the product, not an afterthought. We are looking for someone who sees a manual Jamf task, fragile policy or recurring Mac support issue and asks, “How can we make this reliable, reusable and self-service?”

You should be comfortable working from Apple and Jamf documentation, investigating unfamiliar behaviours and translating operational requirements into production-quality automation. Your solutions account for failure, test changes before release, scale to an enterprise environment, provide useful telemetry and favour reusable frameworks over isolated scripts. You take ownership from design through operation, document your work and balance long-term platform improvements with immediate business needs.

What success looks like
You will measurably reduce manual effort, deployment lead time and configuration drift across the macOS estate. Enrollment, configuration, software delivery, patching, security compliance and device lifecycle processes will become increasingly automated, observable, auditable and recoverable.

Over time, you will establish a scalable Apple endpoint automation model based on Jamf Pro, APIs, version-controlled code, release pipelines and shared engineering standards rather than manual platform administration.


What you'll do

macOS Platform & Jamf Automation

  • Design and maintain automation for macOS enrolment, provisioning, configuration, application delivery, updates and device retirement using Jamf Pro.

  • Build reusable scripts, tools and workflows using shell scripting, Python, Jamf APIs and other appropriate technologies.

  • Evaluate Jamf, Apple and related ecosystem capabilities, APIs and emerging technologies to simplify or extend the service.

  • Troubleshoot complex failures across macOS, Jamf, identity, networking, security and application-delivery services.

  • Convert recurring Mac incidents and support escalations into automated detection, remediation or prevention.

  • Document designs, code, operating procedures and support models, and enable support teams to use them effectively.

Dans ce cadre, vous piloterez également l’exécution des projets vendus, qui sont de nature complexe et à forte valeur ajoutée, couvrant l’un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants :

  • Cadrage et gestion de programmes complexes : superviser, du cadrage à la mise en œuvre, des plans moyen-termes et des projets de transformation à grande échelle (ex : refonte des systèmes, mise en conformité réglementaire, réorganisation…).
  • Accompagnement de projets réglementaires : Accompagner les clients dans la mise en conformité avec les principales réglementations des marchés de capitaux (MiFID 2, EMIR, Dodd-Frank, PRIIPS, SFTR, FATCA…).
  • Transformation Finance & Risques : Refonte des dispositifs de contrôle des risques (marché, contrepartie, crédit, opérationnels), des outils et processus de reporting, pilotage de la performance.
  • Mise en œuvre de technologies et d’innovations : concevoir des architectures fonctionnelles alignées avec les stratégies métiers, superviser l'implémentation de progiciels financiers (ex. : Murex, Calypso, Simcorp…) et de nouvelles technologies innovantes (IA, automatisation des processus, big data, blockchain) pour améliorer la performance des opérations de marché.
  • Stratégie et gouvernance de la donnée : définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de gestion des données, accompagner les enjeux d’exploitation, de confidentialité et de sécurité des données.

Au-delà de vos interventions et des missions que vous superviserez, votre rôle consistera également à assurer :

  • Le développement commercial du cabinet dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux : pilotage de relations clients en direct ou en appui des équipes clients, origination d’opportunités business, contribution à la transformation des opportunités en missions concrètes.
  • Le développement de nos offres et services et la croissance des équipes Marché de Capitaux : développement de contenu, partage de nos visions et convictions, développement des compétences internes (recrutement et formation).

Savoir-Faire et Savoir-être

Les caractéristiques suivantes sont requises :

  • Expérience :
    • 12/15 ans d’expérience minimum dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux, dont un minimum de 7/8 ans dans le Conseil.
    • Expérience confirmée dans la gestion de programmes et projets de transformation complexes, depuis le cadrage jusqu’au pilotage, et dans des missions métiers (gestion post-trade, finance, risque et conformité) et/ou technologiques.
  • Compétences techniques :
    • Expertise en stratégie d’une banque de financement et d’Investissement, de son architecture fonctionnelle, de son organisation, de ses métiers et processus et de ses enjeux.
    • Maîtrise des méthodes de gestion de programme / projet, en cycle V ou en agile.
    • Connaissance des instruments financiers et des principes de gestion des risques (marché, contrepartie et crédit).
    • Connaissance des progiciels de marché.
    • Connaissance des nouvelles technologies, des progiciels de marché et des systèmes d’informations des BFI, ainsi qu’une expérience dans le cadrage ou la réalisation de projets de transformation IT dans le domaine des marchés de capitaux serait un réel atout pour ce poste.
  • Soft skills :
    • Leadership avéré et capacité à encadrer des équipes seniors.
    • Excellent niveau de communication, grande aisance rédactionnelle.
    • Fortes compétences en gestion de la relation client.

    • Orienté résultats, avec un sens aigu du client et de ses enjeux métiers et technologiques.
    • Forte autonomie en matière de relation client, de développement commercial, de pilotage de missions et de développement des collaborateurs.

title: Marketing Director
descriptionHtml:
digiLab is a formative AI company with world-leading specialists in uncertainty quantification, applied where the stakes are highest and the margin for error is smallest.

Our customers are among the largest and most advanced engineering and science-led organisations in the world, and they're using our technology to tackle some of society's biggest challenges. How do we make fusion energy a commercial reality? Can we drive down the cost of renewable energy and accelerate the transition to a sustainable future? How do we support coral reef restoration, or strengthen Britain's national security? These are just a few of the critical questions our technology is helping to answer. 

At the heart of our work is digiLab's trustworthy and explainable AI platform, enabling our customers to accelerate innovation, reduce risk, and deliver real value through better informed decisions. 

We are looking for ambitious team members to help shape our pioneering technology and tackle some of the world's most impactful problems. 

Summary: 

This full-time position (Monday to Thursday), reporting to the Chief Marketing & Strategy Officer, leads the development and delivery of digiLab’s marketing programmes.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will help shape our positioning, develop campaigns, launch products and build the processes that make marketing effective as the company scales. You should be comfortable moving between strategic decisions and practical execution, from planning a market campaign to editing a customer story or improving a sales presentation. Your challenge will be to make sophisticated technology understandable and commercially relevant to engineering leaders, enterprise buyers and technology partners. You will work directly with technical and commercial leaders, with meaningful ownership of the marketing programme and its impact.

The role: 

As Marketing Director at digiLab, you will be responsible for:

  • Building integrated campaigns that generate qualified opportunities and support expansion within existing accounts.
  • Working with commercial leads on target-account programmes, events, webinars and prospect engagement.
  • Planning product launches and creating sales materials that explain what customers can buy, how it works and why it matters.
  • Establishing shared definitions and reporting for marketing contribution to pipeline, conversion and revenue.
  • Working with the research and product teams to translate technical work into compelling content.
  • Developing customer stories that connect technical outcomes with business value.
  • Building digiLab’s presence through relevant industry events and expert communities, maintaining accuracy in technical and commercial claims.
  • Developing joint campaigns, content and events with engineering and technology partners.
  • Giving partners the messaging and materials they need to introduce digiLab to their customers.
  • Owning the marketing calendar, budget and delivery process.
  • Managing agencies, freelancers and specialist suppliers, and helping build the internal team as requirements grow.
  • Improving the website, CRM integration, campaign measurement and content production process.
  • Prioritising the activities that deliver results within a startup’s resources.

Duties may evolve, and you may be asked to take on other reasonable responsibilities within your competence to support our growth.

Required Skills & Experience: 

  • Experience leading B2B marketing for enterprise software, AI, deep technology or a closely related business.
  • A record of translating complex products into clear propositions and effective campaigns.
  • Experience supporting enterprise sales cycles and working closely with commercial teams.
  • Practical knowledge of demand generation, digital channels, marketing measurement and HubSpot.
  • The ability to work credibly with technical specialists and draw out what matters to customers.
  • Experience managing budgets and external resources, with a willingness to do the work yourself.
  • Sound judgement about priorities, a collaborative approach and comfort operating with incomplete information.

Location: 

On-site at either our Exeter or Bristol office.

As an ambitious, rapidly-growing start-up, we’re looking for proactive, adaptable people who thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our standard working hours are 9.00–5.30pm, Monday to Thursday, though some flexibility outside these hours may be required to meet business needs.

Our Culture and Values

At digiLab, we're building something we truly believe in, and we're looking for like-minded people. 

We foster a culture of innovation, trust, and collaboration. Our values include:

  • Creativity & Agility: Encouraging innovation and flexibility in goal achievement.
  • Trust & Responsibility: Supporting each other in taking calculated risks for bold innovation.
  • Open & Honest Collaboration: Ensuring transparent communication and alignment.
  • High-Performance Standards: Continuously challenging ourselves to excel in delivery.
  • Value-Driven Work: Regularly assessing our contributions toward company goals.

Benefits:

We value enthusiasm and loyalty, and we’re committed to offering a great work-life balance. Along with the exciting challenges this role provides, we offer a range of benefits including:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Personal & professional development
  • BUPA private health care (via salary sacrifice)
  • Company Cashplan
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Referral Program
  • Regular social events such as pizza nights, kayaking, bouldering and bake offs

Equal Opportunities:
digiLab is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to ensuring our recruitment processes are fair, inclusive, and legally compliant. We take equality, dignity, and non-discrimination seriously. 

Final Note:
We aim to respond to every applicant, but due to high application volumes, we may not be able to respond individually. Thank you for your interest in joining the digiLab team. The information you provide will be stored and used in line with our Privacy Notice.

title: Marketing Operations
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

title: Medior/Senior Java & Angular Developer
descriptionHtml:
Medior/Senior Java & Angular Developer

Delft | 32–40 uur per week |

Wil jij met jouw skills écht impact maken in de zorg? Bij CHA bouw je niet zomaar software – je bouwt systemen waar honderden apotheken en uiteindelijk miljoenen inwoners in Nederland dagelijks op vertrouwen. We zijn een klein team van zo’n 20 collega’s: groot genoeg om samen veel te bereiken, klein genoeg om elkaar écht te kennen. Hier krijg je de ruimte om te creëren, te verbeteren en je stempel te drukken, mét de steun van ervaren collega’s en in een omgeving waar samenwerking centraal staat.

Wat ga je doen als Java & Angular Developer?

Voor jou begint software pas écht te leven als het draait in productie, veilig, snel en in handen van gebruikers. Je bent niet alleen een bouwer, maar ook een meedenker: van functioneel ontwerp tot technische architectuur. Samen met je collega’s zorg je dat onze applicaties future-proof zijn en optimaal draaien.

De komende tijd werken we aan het moderniseren en modulariseren van ons applicatielandschap. Dat betekent: veel ruimte om jouw ideeën en expertise toe te passen. Samen met je collega’s ontwikkel je nieuwe features, verbeter je bestaande functionaliteiten en zorg je ervoor dat zorgverleners minder tijd kwijt zijn aan administratie, zodat zij zich kunnen richten op hun verdere bedrijfsvoering.

We zoeken geen alleskunner die elk vinkje af kan kruisen, maar een enthousiaste developer die zich wil verdiepen én verbreden. Of je nu uit de Java/Spring-hoek komt en je kennis van Angular wilt versterken, of juist andersom: je krijgt bij ons de kans om beide kanten uit te bouwen.

Wat zijn je belangrijkste taken/verantwoordelijkheden?

  • Meedenken over software-ontwerpen en deze vertalen naar robuuste oplossingen.

  • Nieuwe features ontwikkelen én bestaande functionaliteit verbeteren.

  • Clean code schrijven, mét geautomatiseerde (unit) tests.

  • 2e-lijns support leveren bij gebruikersvragen en incidenten.

  • Technisch aanspreekpunt zijn voor externe softwareleveranciers.

  • Werken aan diverse applicaties die het verschil maken in de dagelijkse zorg.

Wie ben jij, en wat breng je mee?

Java

  • Diepgaande kennis van Java & Spring (Boot, MVC, Batch).

  • Bedreven met Hibernate en SQL.

  • Ervaring met CI/CD-tooling en testing frameworks, zoals JUnit en Mockito.

  • Basiskennis van Angular is mooi meegenomen.

Angular

  • Up-to-date kennis van Angular.

  • Skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript & RxJS.

  • Ervaring met CI/CD-tooling en testing frameworks, zoals Jasmine.

  • Basiskennis Java & Spring Framework

Soft skills

  • Je bent zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en werkt oplossingsgericht.

  • Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor je werk én dat van je team.

  • Je durft fouten te maken, leert ervan en helpt je collega’s vooruit.

  • Je deelt je kennis graag en staat open om ook van anderen te leren.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met de farmacie en interesse in declaratieverwerking in de zorg.

  • Samenwerken met je collega’s geeft jou energie.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • Een dynamische werkomgeving met korte communicatielijnen en een informele cultuur;

  • Een salaris tussen €5000,- en €6250,- bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), afhankelijk van ervaring en achtergrond. Dit is geen absolute range, wel een goede indicatie;

  • Jaarlijkse bonus (bij goede resultaten) ter hoogte van een maandsalaris.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,23 per km) of een NS Business Card met volledige OV-vergoeding;

  • Thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werkmogelijkheden;

  • Een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage werknemersbijdrage;

  • Minimaal 26 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, met de mogelijkheid om feestdagen flexibel in te zetten;

  • Diverse secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals korting op sportabonnementen via Bedrijfsfitness NL, een fietsleaseplan, workation-mogelijkheden, sabbaticalopties en mantelzorgverlof;

  • Tijd en ruimte voor vrijwilligerswerk onder werktijd.

  • Een inspirerende werkomgeving met een een gezellig, hecht team.

Wie zijn wij?

Clearing House Apothekers (CHA) is onderdeel van MSPS Groep B.V. – Medical Software & Processing Services. Samen met verschillende bedrijven binnen de groep (o.a. Infomedics en Vertimart) zetten wij ons in om de zorg slimmer, efficiënter en menselijker te maken.

CHA is al ruim 30 jaar een betrouwbare partner voor apotheken in Nederland. Wij zorgen ervoor dat declaratie- en facturatieprocessen soepel verlopen, zodat apotheken zich volledig kunnen focussen op hun patiënten. Ons team bestaat uit ruim 20 collega’s: klein genoeg om elkaar écht te kennen, groot genoeg om impact te maken. Wij hebben een open cultuur, zijn ambitieus en zetten samen de schouders eronder.

De sollicitatieprocedure

Het eerste gesprek is een kennismaking met collega’s uit het team. Wie zijn wij, wie ben jij, wat neem je mee aan ervaring en vooral waar ben je naar op zoek? Daarna volgt een tweede ronde met een verdiepend gesprek. Mogelijk nodigen we je ook uit om een dagdeel mee te lopen zodat na afloop voor iedereen duidelijk is wat we van elkaar verwachten.

Daarnaast is het belangrijk om te weten dat het verkrijgen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) nodig is om de functie te kunnen vervullen.

Reageren

Ben je enthousiast geworden en geïnteresseerd in deze functie? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog met jouw CV met motivatiebrief. Wil je eerst meer weten? Kijk dan op https://www.infomedics.nl/werkenbij of neem contact op met onze Recruiter Chenara Vischer Heb je vragen? Je mag ons mailen naar ).

Aan bureaus & recruiters: we got this. Profielen en cv’s die tóch ongevraagd worden toegezonden, zullen behandeld worden als directe sollicitaties van de kandidaat.

title: Member of Technical Staff — Environments / Evals
descriptionHtml:
Member of Technical Staff — Environments / Evals

Remanence is pioneering the next era of enterprise AI by building intelligent systems that learn continuously from real-world execution. We transform complex enterprise workflows and business context into dynamic, interactive environments where AI agents can safely learn, adapt, and improve. By combining high-fidelity simulation environments with state-of-the-art training loops, we build specialized models that solve long-horizon, complex tasks with unmatched reliability. We’re building the most talent-dense AI team in Europe to make this happen.

You’ll build systems that automatically synthesize tasks, construct adaptive curricula, and learn simulators of real-world deployments. Your goal is to create a continually improving source of training experience, alongside evaluations that establish whether learning transfers to real use.

What you’ll work on

  • Build pipelines that generate tasks, initial states, tool configurations, and verifiers; automatically filter for validity, diversity, and difficulty.

  • Develop curriculum strategies that select and generate tasks based on model failures, learning progress, and gaps in capability coverage.

  • Train learned simulators from deployment traces to model user behavior, tool responses, and environment dynamics. Validate their fidelity against real interactions.

  • Build reproducible evaluation harnesses and held-out tests that detect reward exploitation, simulator shortcuts, contamination, and failures to generalize.

Relevant technologies

  • ML Frameworks: PyTorch, transformers, and vLLM or SGLang.

  • Environment execution: Ray, Docker, OpenEnv and Gymnasium-style interfaces; Playwright for browser-based tasks.

  • Evaluation and data: Inspect AI and DeepEval for evaluations and custom verifiers/graders, versioned datasets with Apache Parquet, LanceDB and DVC.

About you

You combine strong engineering with experimental judgment and curiosity about model behavior. You think from first principles about what the company needs, not just the task in front of you. Experience with synthetic data, world models, agents, curriculum learning, or evaluation is valuable.

We welcome both deep specialists and generalists who master unfamiliar domains exceptionally quickly. You don’t need prior experience across the entire stack.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity.

  • A fast-paced environment combining frontier research with impactful real-world applications.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support for candidates joining us in Paris or London.

  • A flexible hybrid setup, with a preference for working together in person.

title: ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer - LLMs
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

Who we're looking for

We're seeking an experienced ML Infrastructure & Acceleration Engineer to own the GPU infrastructure that powers our LLM training and serving, and to make every workload on it faster and cheaper. You'll run our H200 cluster end to end, deploy models to production, and profile and optimize our training and inference pipelines down to the kernel level when it matters. You understand GPUs from the cluster scheduler to the memory hierarchy, you measure before you optimize, and you're motivated by turning raw compute into faster iteration for our ML team. You thrive in environments where infrastructure reliability and efficiency directly shape how quickly research reaches millions of users.

What you'll do

GPU Cluster & Infrastructure:

  • Own our H200 GPU cluster end to end: Kubernetes and Slurm for training and inference workloads, with multi-tenant scheduling, quotas, and resource isolation

  • Keep large distributed training runs healthy: node health checks, NCCL and interconnect debugging, automated job recovery, and checkpoint management

  • Track and optimize GPU utilization and cost across training and inference, with dashboards and budget alerting

  • Manage infrastructure-as-code and provisioning for GPU environments

  • Define and monitor SLIs/SLOs for cluster availability and production model serving

Deployment & Serving:

  • Deploy LLMs to production using vLLM or SGLang, with CI/CD, model versioning, and safe rollouts and rollbacks

  • Monitor serving latency, throughput, errors, and cost, and act on regressions

ML Acceleration:

  • Profile training and inference end to end (PyTorch Profiler, Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute) to find and remove bottlenecks

  • Improve training throughput and MFU: parallelism strategies (FSDP, tensor and pipeline parallelism), communication/compute overlap, mixed precision and FP8, activation checkpointing, torch.compile

  • Optimize inference: quantization (FP8, INT8, INT4), speculative decoding, prefix caching, continuous batching, KV cache tuning, and parallelism layouts

  • Write or integrate fused and custom kernels (Triton, CUDA) where off-the-shelf implementations fall short

  • Build benchmarking tooling so every optimization ships with measured gains

Enablement & Best Practices:

  • Partner with ML engineers and researchers to make training and serving efficient by default

  • Establish best practices for using the cluster and guide teams in their adoption

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in ML infrastructure, MLOps, HPC, or platform engineering with focus on GPU workloads

  • Hands-on experience operating multi-node GPU clusters with Kubernetes and/or Slurm, including debugging hardware, networking (NCCL, InfiniBand/RoCE), and job failures

  • Production experience deploying and optimizing LLM inference with vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM

  • Proven track record of profiling and accelerating GPU workloads, with measured results in throughput, latency, MFU, or cost

  • Solid understanding of monitoring and observability for GPU systems (Prometheus, Grafana, DCGM, or similar)

  • Naturally curious with a track record of proactively identifying and implementing improvements

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing custom kernels in Triton or CUDA, and familiarity with fused kernels such as FlashAttention

  • Performance tuning of distributed training frameworks: FSDP, Megatron-LM, or DeepSpeed

  • Experience with low-precision training and inference (**FP8**, INT4) and model compression for production deployment

  • Deep knowledge of GPU architectures: memory hierarchy, tensor cores, roofline analysis

  • Experience with multi-tenant GPU scheduling and fair-share resource allocation

  • Contributions to open-source projects such as vLLM, SGLang, PyTorch, or Triton

What we offer

  • Critical infrastructure ownership for high-impact AI projects that are strategically vital to the company, with direct visibility to senior leadership including the CEO

  • State-of-the-art GPU infrastructure: H200 fleet, vLLM serving stack, and the freedom to optimize it end to end

  • Expert ML team who have released top Hugging Face models, published at NeurIPS, and built production systems that will run on your infrastructure

  • Significant autonomy in choosing tools and shaping our infrastructure and performance strategy

  • Modern tooling: Latest ML frameworks, coding assistants, best-in-class development environment

  • Hybrid work model with our Amsterdam office - home to the AI House, bringing together 200+ AI professionals through events and collaborations

  • Competitive compensation, top-spec MacBook Pro, and an environment genuinely built for professional growth and learning

If you're excited to own the GPU infrastructure behind cutting-edge LLMs and make every training run and every request faster, let's talk.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About HIVED 📦

At HIVED, we’re steamrolling forward as one of Europe’s fastest growing startups, and our momentum shows no signs of slowing.

Based in London, we are a climate and logistics start-up building the first sustainable parcel delivery network at scale, powered by a 100% electric fleet. In an ever-growing industry where unreliable service has long been the norm, HIVED has been built from the ground-up to meet the demands of modern consumers and disrupt parcel delivery.

A tech company at heart, our talent and technology is laser-focused on delivering the best possible delivery experience for end-customers and meeting the needs of our retail partners. From our drivers to our data engineers, we are constantly working to improve this customer experience that makes us deliver better.

Already trusted by leading international brands such as John Lewis, Nespresso, Uniqlo, H&M brands and more, we are solidifying our position as the leaders in Europe to tackle this growing market.

Our tight-knit team is made up of ex-Revolut, Bain, HelloFresh, ASOS, Apple and Google employees, and we are backed by some of Europe’s leading investors and VCs in climate-tech, logistics and mobility including Planet A Ventures, Maersk Growth, Pale Blue Dot VC, Eka Ventures, NordicNinja VC and the British government. We’re passionate about driving innovation and redefining the future of delivery.

 

Role Overview 📝

The Ops Manager is a critical role at our depots. As the Ops Manager, you are accountable for site performance during your shift.

Your role will focus on primary sort for our middle mile hub. You will ensure that arrivals are unloaded, sorted and cross docked according to the plan provided to you by the Network team, whilst maintaining high quality and safety levels.

You will lead a team of handlers throughout your shift and be accountable for the results that are delivered. You need to have the highest standards of professionalism and discipline, leading by example in every moment. This is an on-site role embedded in the day-to-day operations. The shifts for this role are a 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern which will require you to work one day on the weekend. Our Operations team is organised into roles at different levels: this is a level 5 role reporting into the site leader.

 

What you’ll be doing 🚀

  • Lead shift during rotation - managing a variety of team members - to deliver exceptional under the roof performance.

  • Be the Site Lead’s primary support & deliver strong handovers

  • Lead & inspire, & develop and performance manage, team on OM’s shift rotation.

  • You will be responsible for:

    • Labour planning for week-ahead & night.

    • Managing day activities, e.g. sortation as relevant, preparation for sortation.

  • Succession planning for week ahead + 6-week glance for their side of the week, & peaks.

  • Drives continuous improvement initiatives & Develop standards and operating procedures.

What you’ll be accountable for 🤝

  1. Adherence to the plan for the day from the Network team. You will ensure drivers are dispatched on time, and vehicles are loaded with correct volume.

  2. All in-depot day-to-day and planning activities including people (labour pool, engagement, leadership succession planning), safety (auditing and near miss/incident reporting), quality (SLA, set-off/on-time dispatch), and cost (labour planning D+1/W+1/TPH).

What we’re looking for 🔎

  • 4-8 years’ experience leading fast-paced dispatch / middle-mile operations.

  • Strong command of driver operations, route execution, and dispatch accuracy.

  • Hands-on shift leadership with ability to manage 10-20+ staff. Ability to lead and coach team.

  • High urgency, strong communication, strong escalation habits.

  • Comfortable solving real-time operational pressure during peak windows.

  • Excellent cross-functional stakeholder management skills.

How we reward our team 🎁

  • Competitive market-related salary. Including the opportunity to work overtime when required.

  • 25 days of holiday allowance plus public holidays. If you're on on 4 days on, 3 days off shift pattern, you are entitled to the equivalent of 20 days paid holiday plus public holidays

  • 1 Birthday Day Off + 2 Tenure-Based Additional Days Off

  • Subsidised Private Medical Insurance including dental, vision & mental health therapy

  • Team lunch provided once a week

  • Quarterly team socials and annual sports day (HIVED Olympics)

  • Enhanced maternity/paternity/adoption policy as day 1 right

  • MacBook Air or Windows Laptop (depending on your preference)

  • Cycle to work scheme

Our Values

  • 😊 We Are Kind - We leave our egos at the door and aren't afraid to make difficult decisions. We must never confuse kindness with being "nice" - kindness requires us to be fair, consistent and work together to move HIVED forward.

  • 🤝 We Are Tenacious - We fight every day to keep the customer promise, for every parcel entrusted to us. No matter how hard it gets or whatever stands in our way, we are relentless in our pursuit of excellence.

  • 💡 We Are Curious - We never settle, constantly challenge convention and are never afraid to ask why. We believe there is always more to learn, always a better way, and that we're always only just getting started.

  • 💰 We Are Resourceful - Resources are scarce and our business depends on our ability to use resources wisely. Waste is the enemy. We strive to do more with less, be more efficient and make the most of what we have.


🔍 Want to learn more?

  • HIVED is #7 on The Sunday Times Tech 100

  • HIVED is B Corporation certified

  • Check the Impact Reports for 2024 and 2025

title: Oracle SIOCS Solution Architect
descriptionHtml:
Oracle SIOCS Solution Architect

Consumer Goods, Retail and Logistics Practice

Principal / Senior Principal

You want to boost your career and collaborate with expert, talented colleagues to solve and deliver against our clients' most important challenges? We are growing and are looking for people to join our team. You'll be part of an entrepreneurial, high-growth environment of 300.000 employees. Our dynamic organization allows you to work across functional business pillars, contributing your ideas, experiences, diverse thinking, and a strong mindset. Are you ready?

About your role

We are looking for a hands-on Oracle SIOCS solution architect to join the Design Pod of a global luxury retail POS transformation. A standard Oracle Xstore and SIOCS template is being rolled out to boutiques in around 36 countries (2027 to 2030), delivered through a Design Pod, a Base Template Pod and regional EU and APAC PODs, under a standard-first (90/10) principle.

You will own the end-to-end design of Oracle Retail Store Inventory Operations Cloud Service (SIOCS) and its integration with Xstore and the wider landscape, so boutique inventory processes are accurate, standard and scalable across markets and across Fashion and F&B concepts.

You are a trusted advisor to senior business and IT stakeholders, able to say no to unnecessary customisation with a clear rationale, and you document decisions so knowledge is retained. You will be measured on inventory accuracy at go-live, template conformance and on-time design of 3 to 4 work packages a year.

Responsibilities

  • Fit-gap and Adopt-vs-Adapt for store inventory: receiving, transfers, adjustments, counts, returns, reservations, in-store fulfilment
  • Solution designs and FSDs for SIOCS configuration, workflows, reporting and user roles
  • Integration designs for SIOCS with Xstore, ERP and merchandising, order management, e-commerce, warehouse and logistics
  • Inventory data designs: master data, item and location setup, conversions and reconciliation approaches
  • Country and market localisation, including tax, traceability and regulatory requirements affecting inventory
  • Design hand-over packs to delivery PODs that meet Definition of Ready and design-gate criteria
  • Contribution to the Base Template roadmap and cloud release readiness, including impact of Oracle quarterly updates
  • Design reviews, quality gates and root-cause input on design and data defects; coaching of POD engineers

Requirements

  • Have a broad business skill set including stakeholder management with senior business and IT leaders, problem-solving, and resilience
  • Are able to say no to overcommitment and unnecessary customisation with a clear rationale
  • Have experience building and growing the right-skilled team: one team across PODs, vendors and locations
  • Have excellent interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication skills in English (C2 proficiency); French is a strong advantage; willingness to travel regularly to boutiques, regional PODs and client sites. Location: France (preferred, Paris)
  • Deep knowledge and hands-on experience with Oracle SIOCS (and its SIM heritage): configuration, workflows, APIs, and how SIOCS and Xstore share stock and transactions
  • Experience working with Oracle Retail Cloud architecture, integration patterns and update management; inventory concepts, shrinkage and cycle counting
  • 15+ years in retail technology and 7+ years designing Oracle Retail inventory solutions incl. SIOCS or SIM (Senior Principal: 18+ years, several global rollouts as lead architect)
  • Have previously led multi-country store systems rollout covering POS and store inventory together
  • Strong luxury, fashion or premium retail background: high-value, low-volume and serialised stock, boutique-to-boutique fulfilment
  • Experience with Oracle product teams on SRs and escalations, and across multiple vendors; Oracle Retail certification is a plus

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for team members who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

About your team

Our CRL (Consumer Goods, retail & Logistics) practice helps some of the largest global firms and most recognizable local brands solve their biggest challenges in today’s age of constant disruption. With diverse services spanning growth strategy and new product innovation, to omni-channel customer experience, supply chain resiliency and AI-driven new business models, we help clients shape and achieve their growth agenda for a sustainable future. We transform traditional organizations to digitally centric business models and drive new revenue streams.

About Infosys Consulting

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology. We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

Within Europe, we are recognized as one of the UK’s top firms by the Financial Times and Forbes due to our client innovations, our cultural diversity and dedicated training and career paths. Infosys is on the Germany’s top employers list for 2023. Management Consulting Magazine named us on their list of Best Firms to Work for. Furthermore, Infosys has been recognized by the Top Employers Institute, a global certification company, for its exceptional standards in employee conditions across Europe for five years in a row.

We offer industry-leading compensation and benefits, along with top training and development opportunities so that you can grow your career and achieve your personal goals. Curious to learn more? We’d love to hear from you.... Apply today!
