💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

Why is this role important for Pennylane?

Pennylane is creating Pennylane Financial Services (PFS), a subsidiary seeking ACPR authorisation as a payment institution and financing company, to serve its 1.6 million SMB customers base.

  1. This is a 0-to-1 role: you will lay the foundations of PFS’s accounting model, controls and reporting as the business is built.

  2. You ensure the reliability of PFS’s financial information, from product events and accounting entries through to financial and prudential reporting.

  3. You check daily that client funds are safeguarded and that PFS meets its own funds requirements and applicable prudential ratios. You flag risks early and help the Head of Finance anticipate capital needs.

You report to Maxime Leclercq, GM PFS, and functionally to @Raphaël Nahum, Head of Finance, on accounting standards and methods aligned with group finance.

How will you contribute to the project?

You build from scratch the accounting model and controls with Product and Tech, then run daily accounting until volumes justify a dedicated operator.

You own the figures and accounting decisions, and prepare the accounting-based prudential reports. You collaborate with our Regulatory Lead, who oversees reporting deadlines, completeness and reviews, the reports before submission.

You would be a great fit if:

  • You can work with incomplete information and make decisions, assumptions and open questions clear.

  • You document accounting decisions and are able to defend them internally and externally, including to statutory auditors and the ACPR.

What will your day-to-day responsibilities be?

Build

  • Design and test payment and financing accounting schemes in the Core Banking System, the accounting interpreter, working closely with Product and Tech teams

  • Document the accounting impact of each product before launch.

  • Reconcile the ledger, general ledger, bank accounts and reports. Keep each reported figure traceable to its transactions.

  • Set up RUBA and COREP reporting, including dry runs, with the Regulatory Lead.

Operational accounting

  • Reconcile payment accounts (eg. SCT, SDD, cards, cheques) against the settlement account daily. Check safeguarding coverage, keep evidence and flag shortfalls.

  • Check own funds requirements, applicable ratios and available buffers daily.

  • Forecast the amount and timing of capital needs with the Head of Finance and FP&A

  • Resolve and document exceptions.

  • Account for doubtful receivables, provisions, write-offs and reversals.

  • Prepare closing entries, reconcile intercompany balances with Pennylane SAS and support statutory closings.

Strategic contributions

  • Prepare the accounting, exposure and provisioning materials for the committee that sets credit risk appetite, overall exposure and counterparty limits.

  • Quantify the accounting, provisioning and capital impact of new products, pricing or volume scenarios before launch.

  • Alert the Head of Finance early on capital needs, prudential constraints and standards changes (PCEC, ACPR) that affect the model.

  • Work closely with Pennylane’s Accounting Manager and the FP&A team to align on definitions, key metrics, and group procedures

Profile we are looking for

Must-have:

  • At least 6–7 years of experience, ideally in financial services audit followed by accounting in a payment institution, financing company or bank.

  • Strong PCEC, doubtful receivables and provisioning knowledge.

  • Able to both build the accounting model and run daily reconciliations, exceptions and closings.

  • Comfortable working with incomplete information and owning accounting decisions.

  • Able to query large datasets independently.

  • Works well with Engineering, Product, Data, Operations and the Regulatory Lead, with clear responsibilities.

  • Professional French and English: documentation and regulatory exchanges are in French; teams work in English.

Nice-to-have:

  • DEC or equivalent.

  • SQL.

  • Core banking or accounting interpreter experience.

  • Experience building accounting and controls for a new entity or licensing programme.

  • ACPR reporting experience (RUBA, COREP).

Recruitment Process

1. Interview (30-45 min) with Simon, Senior Recruiter

2. Interview (1h) with Maxime, General Manager and Raphaël Nahum (Head of Finance)

3. Case Study (1h30) with Raphaël, Sabrina and Maxime

4. Last round with Laurent and Felix (45 min)

What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :

-To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)

-To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment

-To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)

-Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains ----- or ----- style="min-height:1.5em">We will never ask you for payment or financial information

title: QA Software Engineer (C2)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London

Level: C2

Team: Quality Enablement

Contract: Permanent

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we rev

Kaluza Overview

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

The role

Kaluza has new opportunities for QA Developer Engineers who will build and maintain automation frameworks that test AI-generated and AI-assisted code, and develop agent-based tooling that supports engineering teams across the business. These roles sit at the intersection of software development, quality engineering, and applied AI — you will build the tools that other engineers and clients rely on to develop, test, and ship AI-driven solutions with confidence.

The QA Development Engineers will be part of a Quality Enablement function which forms part of Kaluza’s Quality departments.

They will work closely with Applied Engineering and Global Products teams to deliver reusable frameworks and agent solutions. You will have opportunities to work with internal and external clients to understand their requirements and build solutions to meet their needs. AI will be a core part of your own workflow — used to accelerate 

the design, build, and iteration of testing tools and frameworks.

What you will be doing

  • Automation Framework Development: build and maintain automation frameworks specifically for testing AI-generated code and AI system outputs, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and consistency.

  • Agent Solution Development: Create agent-based tools and solutions that Applied Engineering and Global Products teams can use to deliver work faster, and that developers can use to test their code and systems.

  • AI-Assisted Tool Building: Use AI tools and techniques to build, refine, and scale internal testing tools and frameworks efficiently, embedding AI into your own development lifecycle.

  • Solution-Driven Delivery: Operate as part of a solution-focused team, translating customer and stakeholder requirements into working tools, frameworks, and processes.

  • Continuous Improvement: collaborate with other team members to identify bottlenecks in code and architecture, and build internal AI-driven tools to accelerate our test-and-deploy lifecycles. participate in constructive code reviews to champion best engineering practices and maintain high code quality.

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with internal engineering teams (as internal customers) to understand their AI deployment constraints and testing needs — gathering requirements and delivering quality frameworks and solutions that meet real needs.

  • Documentation and Enablement: Produce documentation and guidance so that developers, QA teams, and clients can adopt and use the frameworks and agent tools effectively.

  • Feature Delivery and Ownership: Take technical ownership of discrete components and features end-to-end, writing clean, well-tested code.

What you will have

  • Proven experience as a QA Engineer, Automation Engineer, or Software Engineer with a strong quality/testing focus.

  • Hands-on experience building test automation frameworks (e.g. using tools/languages such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar).

  • Experience working with or testing AI-generated code, AI models, or AI agents — covering both deterministic validation (is the generated code correct) and non-deterministic evaluation (is the AI's behavior/output acceptable).

  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) and QA methodologies.

  • Problem-solving skills with a solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What will set you apart:

  • Experience building or integrating AI agents (e.g. LangChain, AutoGen, custom agent frameworks, MCP-based tooling).

  • Understanding of prompt engineering and LLM evaluation techniques (e.g. faithfulness, relevance, LLM-as-a-judge patterns), since traditional pass/fail assertions don't translate well to AI agent testing.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into deployment workflows.

  • Experience with API testing.

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Relationship Manager - North London/Northern Home Counties
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Our vision is to reimagine Relationship Banking for established SMEs, through the very best people, products and digital tools. We don’t pretend to have all the answers yet, and you will play a role in continuing to shape our offering.

Our Relationship Manager team was formed in 2022 and continues to grow with the Bank at pace. Providing every customer who opens an account with us with a Relationship Manager, to work alongside them and provide outstanding service, is core to our strategy.

In addition to providing outstanding service, our Relationship Managers build deep levels of understanding and trust with their customers, and get to understand their ambitions, goals and motivations. Allica Relationship Managers support their customers through the provision of appropriate Allica Bank products including Business Current Accounts, Savings Accounts, Commercial Loans, Asset Finance and Working Capital Facilities.

Role Description

All Relationship Manager roles at Allica Bank carry a requirement for new business acquisition as we continue to build the bank. Where portfolios are held, they are built to allow capacity to do this.

Relationship Managers will bring, and continue to build, a strong network of trusted SME advisors such as accountants, solicitors, business organisations and others (but not commercial finance brokers – these are looked after by our dedicated broker team). We expect our Relationship Managers to be recognised as valued partners and experts in business finance by their clients and in the communities they serve.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Relationship Manage a portfolio of SME customers, understanding customer’s needs and business aspirations, and looking for opportunities to support them via Allica Bank services and through their own external networks

  • Originating SME lending opportunities for both existing and new customers from initial enquiry through to completion, including writing credit papers in line with Allica’s credit policy and appetite.

  • Delivering the business plan for your local area, and actively managing your objectives and personal development plan.

  • Making your colleagues proud that you represent Allica in your local area, by ensuring excellent service for local SME customers, prospects and advisors.

  • Working closely and collaboratively with all areas of Allica to ensure a seamless and professional service is always provided.

  • Being a positive contributor to Allica’s culture, and always demonstrating the bank’s values

  • Complying with all mandatory policies, and adherence to operational procedures to maintain internal controls.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Highly capable Relationship Manager and Business Developer with a long-term track record of building high-value, trust based and long-lasting referral relationships.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - AWS (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Shopware ist ein führendes E-Commerce-System, das es Unternehmen weltweit ermöglicht, im digitalen Handel schnell und effizient zu skalieren. Über die Position

Du wirst Teil des Teams IT Infrastructure innerhalb des Bereichs IT Operations, das die interne IT-Infrastruktur der shopware AG betreut. Als Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - AWS (m/w/d) sorgst du für den stabilen Betrieb, die Automatisierung und die Weiterentwicklung unserer AWS-Umgebungen und Netzwerkarchitektur. Gemeinsam mit internen Expert:innen und externen Partnern, darunter AWS-Spezialist:innen, stellst du eine stabile, leistungsfähige und zukunftssichere Systemlandschaft sicher und gestaltest die technische Basis von Shopware aktiv mit.

KI in der IT-Infrastruktur von Shopware

Künstliche Intelligenz wird zunehmend zu einem festen Bestandteil unserer Infrastruktur. Vom Model Routing und Hosting von KI-Modellen bis hin zu Cloud- und selbstverwalteten Infrastrukturen schaffen wir die Grundlage, um KI sicher, effizient und skalierbar zu betreiben. Wir möchten, dass du diese Entwicklung aktiv mitgestaltest.

Dein Arbeitsort

Vor Ort, hybrid oder vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Vorfeld gemeinsam vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.


  • Du entwickelst unsere AWS-Architektur kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst für stabile, leistungsfähige und kosteneffiziente Umgebungen.

  • Du gestaltest unsere KI-Infrastruktur aktiv mit – vom Model Routing bis zum Hosting von KI-Modellen in Cloud- und selbstverwalteten Umgebungen.

  • Du automatisierst unsere Infrastruktur mit Terraform und setzt auf Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

  • Du begleitest Projekte von der Planung bis zur Umsetzung und arbeitest dabei eng mit den Teams Cloud Engineering und Infrastructure zusammen.

  • Du teilst dein Wissen mit deinen Kolleg:innen und trägst aktiv zum Aufbau und zur Pflege unserer internen Wissensdatenbank bei.

Das bringst du mit:

Position Overview

As a member of the World Wide Strategic Accounts field team, the Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a senior technologist who owns the technical sales strategy, evaluation program, and architectural vision creating repeatable business with software opportunities with the company’s largest multinational customers. You will guide C‑level and engineering stakeholders through solution discovery, validation, and financial justification, ensuring every engagement results in a technical win and a clear path to enterprise‑wide adoption that delivers the customers business outcomes aligned to the project. Driving Everpure as the standard solution for delivering data-management in the WWSA Segment. Creating market penetration strategy and thought leadership across the entire theater/segment.

The role of a Cloud Native Architect (CNA) is a multifaceted position that serves as a technical bridge between the sales, product, and engineering teams. This role is important for driving revenue growth and enhancing customer relationships by providing technical solutions for a specific set of accounts. Primarily focused on the pre-sales process, the individual in this role will engage with potential and existing customers to understand their business issues and technical hurdles related to Kubernetes. They will deliver tailored product demonstrations, respond to technical inquiries, and work with the Everpure technical field to architect solutions that integrate Everpure offerings with clients' software driven platforms. The responsibilities of the Cloud Native Architect will fall into (5) categories:

  • Participation in Lead Generation
  • Technical Qualification
  • Solution Validation
  • Prospect to Customer Transition
  • Established Customer Satisfaction

These categories will serve not only as the foundation for the role, but align with the Technical Sales Process to provide the best possible customer experience.

Role Scope

Theater: Strategics (EMEA)

Builds and leads: CNA team pooled to deliver outcomes in aligned theater Strategic accounts

Role type: Technical Pre-sales Architect

Revenue alignment:

Focus Areas & Key Responsibilities

    • Own the technical sections of proposals, RFx responses, and SOWs.

Thought Leadership

  • Evangelize best practices in Cloud Native data management, platform engineering, and cost optimization through conference talks, blogs, and executive roundtables.
  • Mentor fellow Cloud Native Architect (CNA) on enterprise engagement methodology and financial value selling.

  • Enablement of Cloud Native Processes, standards and excellence.
  1. Lead Generation:

    • Proactively engage contacts in professional network through LinkedIn etc
    • Support monthly Hands-on Labs
    • Attend Pure user groups

    • Attend co-seller Sales Engineering Manager/Directors team meetings monthly to reinforce alignment, share relevant insights, and ensure consistent technical messaging across teams.

title: Consultant Neurologist PAYE
descriptionHtml:
Our patients have often tried everything. Years of appointments, medications that did not work, conditions that slowly took over their lives. By the time they reach us, many have run out of road with conventional treatment. You could be the clinician that changes that.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultant Neurologists to join our clinical team.

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical call on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is still a young field. The evidence base is growing, best practice is being written in real time, and you will have a genuine hand in shaping it.

You do not need experience with cannabis based medicines. You need sound clinical judgement, an open mind and an interest in doing things differently. We provide full specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks, so your time is spent where it matters: with patients.

What you will be doing:

  • Providing high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment

  • Conducting patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management

  • Contributing to clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practice

  • Supporting clinical governance and maintaining robust standards of patient care

  • Working closely within a multidisciplinary team of nurses and pharmacists

  • Taking part in ongoing training and development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBPMs)

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Neurology

  • A genuine interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

Why join us?

  • Highly competitive salary

  • Flexible working with full time or part time options

  • Comprehensive indemnity coverage. Montu covers all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare scheme

  • No night shifts and no on call

  • CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • A collaborative multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training and development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians, sponsored by Montu

  • Specialist training delivered by experts

  • Ongoing support on clinical protocols, prescribing practices and Montu's systems

Working arrangements:

  • Fully remote with flexible working hours and days

  • Standard sessions are 4 hours of patient consultations, and you choose your preferred days and hours

  • To support onboarding, we ask for a minimum commitment of 2 sessions per week (8 hours) initially, so you become confident with our platform

  • Appointments are 15 minutes for new and existing patients. Our multidisciplinary model means nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, so Consultants focus on prescribing and patient care

About Montu

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines. We exist to transform lives by improving access to safe, effective treatment and delivering an exceptional standard of care. We move quickly, we care deeply about our patients, and we are building something that did not exist in UK healthcare five years ago.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we would love to hear from you.

title: People Partner GTM
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're scaling from 1,000 → 4,000 employees across 50+ countries, and the complexity of our teams, hubs, and workflows is growing quickly. Our People Partners play a critical role in enabling leads, supporting peeps, and protecting performance and culture as we grow. As a People Partner at ElevenLabs, you'll sit at the intersection of leadership coaching, organisational design, performance, and day-to-day people guidance.

You'll be the dedicated People Partner for our entire Revenue organisation across North America and LATAM, working closely with the Revenue leadership team to understand their rhythms, challenges, and talent needs deeply. You'll meet proactively with leads and teams, unblock people issues, and help architect the organisation ahead of scale, with Employee Relations and employment counsel on hand when cases need them.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can context-switch quickly, advise with confidence, build trust across functions, and bring clarity and calm to fast-moving environments.

You will

  • Act as the dedicated People Partner for Revenue across North America and LATAM, owning the people agenda for the organisation end to end.

  • Partner deeply with the Revenue leadership team to improve team health, performance, talent density, and organizational clarity.

  • Run proactive 1:1 sessions with leads, surfacing issues early and guiding leads through People challenges and change.

  • Lead organisational design for Revenue as it scales, advising on spans and layers, team structures, staffing needs, capability gaps, and succession planning.

  • Support key People programs (performance reviews, engagement, recognition, and lead enablement) for the Revenue org.

  • Collaborate with Employee Relations and employment counsel on investigations, complex performance cases, and early-stage ER issues, escalating at the right time.

  • Identify patterns across teams and regions and turn them into insights, frameworks, or new People initiatives that help us scale smoothly.

  • Partner closely with the Revenue People Partner for International to compare themes and surface them upwards to our CRO.

  • Partner with People Ops & Compliance teams to support terminations, mobility, local requirements, and compliance-heavy workflows across North America and LATAM.

Requirements

  • Experience supporting senior leaders and teams through the full range of people topics: performance, relations, coaching, growth, restructuring, and organizational design.

  • Hands-on organizational design experience, including spans and layers, team structures, and succession planning.

  • Experience guiding leaders and teams through change, such as restructures, team moves, or new ways of working.

  • Strong judgment and the ability to handle sensitive issues with discretion, clarity, and fairness.

  • Comfortable working alongside Employee Relations and employment counsel on sensitive cases.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-velocity, ambiguous environment and make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable owning both strategic partnership and hands-on execution, as the dedicated People Partner for North America and LATAM.

Experience partnering with teams in North America and LATAM, or an understanding of how People practices and employment norms differ across those regions, is a plus.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in on the East Coast USA

title: Senior Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location: UK. Fully remote, or from our London office next to East Croydon Station

Working pattern: Fully remote working is allowed, and the London office is available to you

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will build the products drivers and car park operators use every day: ANPR camera enforcement, pay-by-web, Autopay, permits, a client console and a motorist account app, across about 160 sites, and the new products we build next. We are a small engineering team, and we form teams around the work from the people we have.

We work in Kotlin on the backend (Spring Boot WebFlux, a domain-driven layering of domain, edge services and repository, Postgres, Axon event sourcing and Pub/Sub) and in TypeScript with Next.js and React on the front end, on GCP and Kubernetes. You do not need to know Kotlin to apply. Our engineers work with AI coding agents day to day, and we are looking for people who use them well and check what they produce.

Every engineer here is product-minded. You will talk to the people who use what you build, decide with product people what is worth building, and find out afterwards whether it worked.

You will report to the CTO and work with a team that reviews each other’s work.

The Senior level

Senior Software Engineer. You own a product area: its architecture, how it is staged, its quality bar, and working out with customers what is needed. You may be the only engineer on a new product area, so you need to be able to work alone for weeks at a time and keep quality high without a peer reviewer. Other engineers will come to you for design review.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the delivery of what you are given, from the first ticket to production, with tests, and be the person who fixes it if it breaks.

  • Talk to the people who use what you build, and use what you learn to shape and cut scope.

  • Write acceptance criteria, and check a feature after release to see whether it was used and whether it worked.

  • Work in our existing codebase and its layering, and keep it consistent for the next engineer.

  • Use AI coding agents as part of how you work, and be accountable for everything you ship, however it was written.

  • Take part in the on-call rota and look after what you ship.

  • Review other engineers’ pull requests, and welcome review of your own.

  • Own the architecture and staging of a product area, and the quality bar for it.

  • Work out with customers what is needed, and give design review to other engineers.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re product-minded. In the last 12 months you’ve talked to real users or customers, and what you learned changed or cut the scope of what you built. You write acceptance criteria, you check a feature after release, and you can say whether something you shipped got used.

  • You’ve shipped production code end to end in the last 12 months, in any language. You can say what you personally built, and what happened after it went live.

  • You test as you build. You can describe a bug you shipped and the test that would have caught it.

  • You use AI coding agents in real work today, and you can describe how you check what they produce, including a time one was wrong.

  • You’re willing to be on call, and you take ownership of what you ship. You don’t need to have been on call before.

  • You work well in an existing codebase with a layered or domain-driven structure that you did not design, and you read before you write.

  • You’re comfortable across the stack. You’ve changed a React or Next.js front end, or worked properly against an API contract, even if you lean backend.

  • You review others’ pull requests, finding real problems and saying so well, and you change your own design when review shows you a better way.

  • You’ve owned a product area on your own, from first design to production, and staged it so each stage delivered something usable.

  • Ideally, you’ve modelled a domain in which the rules change over time (such as pricing, eligibility, tax or regulation) and can answer “what was true on a given date”.

  • You’ve kept quality high without a peer reviewer, and other engineers have come to you for design review.

You do not need a degree, a particular programming language, or Kotlin. Experience of Axon, Temporal, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform, parking or payments is welcome, but none of it is required.

We are hiring software engineers at two levels, Mid-level and Senior. This advert is for the Senior level. If you are earlier in your career, see our post for a Mid-Level Software Engineer.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working in the UK if you want it, with our London office next to East Croydon Station available to you.

  • Real ownership: mid-level engineers own whole features, and senior engineers own a product area.

  • A team that works with AI coding agents every day and measures what they do for us.

  • A strong, high performing culture, with genuine influence over how that culture develops as Hozah grows.

  • A fully refurbished, modern office, right next to East Croydon Station (with a fully stocked kitchen, offering free breakfast, lunch and drinks!).

descriptionHtml:

Reports to: CTO

About Us

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities.

With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte’s Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we’re one of the fastest scaling companies in the country.

Role Overview

You will be Hozah’s first Site Reliability Engineer, and the person who owns how our platform runs. Our parking and payments systems take money from motorists (pay by web, Autopay, kiosks) and pay it on to landowners, and our ANPR enforcement runs around the clock. Those paths have to stay up and stay correct. You own the platform they run on: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform for our Google Cloud organisation and projects, SOPS-encrypted secrets, the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines, Temporal for the ANPR workflows, and Postgres. You also own the reliability practice around it: uptime targets, alerting, on-call, incident response and the cost of running it all.

Product engineers keep ownership of the code in their services. You own the ground it runs on, and you make it easy for them to ship safely. Our engineers use AI coding tools every day, which means more code reaches production each week, so release safety and observability matter more than ever.

This is a new role. We are hiring a senior engineer to own cloud cost, uptime and on-call, set up a proper incident process, and make the platform something engineers trust. You’ll support all of Hozah’s engineering teams, and you’ll work daily with their engineers. The data engineer owns the data warehouse; you’ll work with them, and infrastructure for data still goes through engineering. This is a newly created role with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the production platform: GKE and Kubernetes, Helm, Postgres, Temporal and the environments (staging and production) and how a change is promoted between them.

  • Own uptime and reliability. Agree service level objectives for the money-moving and enforcement paths with the engineers and the business, and alert a named owner when they are at risk.

  • Own on-call: the rota, the runbooks and the incident process, including postmortems that lead to changes rather than reports.

  • Own observability across Cloud Monitoring, Logging and Trace, so the team finds problems before motorists and clients do.

  • Own our infrastructure as code. Everything changes through Terraform and CI, with no console click-ops, including our SOPS-encrypted secrets.

  • Own the Semaphore CI/CD pipelines and safe release: rollbacks, progressive rollout and promotion between environments.

  • Own cloud cost. Know what we spend and why, reduce it with measured results, and keep it down as volume grows.

  • Work with product engineers as a partner and not a ticket queue: help them design for reliability, and review changes that affect production.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve owned production reliability for a Kubernetes-based platform (GKE, EKS or AKS) in the last 12 to 24 months, as the person who gets called when it breaks. You can say exactly what you were accountable for and what you personally changed.

  • You write and maintain infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and you’ve built CI/CD pipelines with safe release: rollbacks and promotion between environments. You can walk through a change of yours that went wrong, what it affected and what you changed afterwards.

  • You’ve cut cloud cost with a measured result and kept it down. You can say what you spent before and after, what you changed, and what you checked before you changed it.

  • You’ve set up or rebuilt on-call and incident response in a small team: the rota, the runbooks and the postmortems. You can describe the last real incident you handled and what changed because of it.

  • You’ve built observability and service level objectives that changed what got fixed, not just dashboards that nobody opened.

  • You work with product engineers without becoming a ticket queue. You can describe how you got engineers to take on reliability work themselves.

  • You use AI tools sensibly for operations work, and you know where not to. You can describe real recent use and a time you did not trust the output.

  • You’re comfortable setting your own priorities in a fast-moving SME, and you’re happy being the only SRE in the company.

Experience of Google Cloud itself, Temporal, Semaphore or SOPS is welcome, but none of it is required.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote working within the UK, or a London office next to East Croydon Station if you prefer to be in.

  • Sole ownership of the platform and reliability practice, reporting directly to the CTO.

  • The chance to build Hozah’s reliability function from a working base as we scale.

title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data.

When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human. This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design.

The work combines research and production engineering:

  • The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers.

  • The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints.

Day to day, much of our work is done with Claude: you'll direct agents to run experiments and ship code, and review what they produce. That moves the hard part of the job towards deciding what to do and in what order. Additionally, organisation, communication, and prioritisation skills matter a great deal as our classifiers sit in the path of many other teams' work.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, train, and evaluate classifiers that detect unsafe agent actions in real time, owning pieces such as prompted models, trained classifiers, or probes on model internals

  • Deploy, tune and operate these classifiers in the critical path of internal agents, RL training, and evaluations, and own their accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and failure behaviour

  • Build the datasets, labelling pipelines, and evaluations that allow us to measure and improve our classifiers and harm taxonomies

  • Partner with red teaming colleagues to stress-test our classifiers, and harden them against what they find

  • Work with the teams whose agents, environments, and evaluations we run on, so that false positives get fixed quickly without weakening protection

  • Contribute to the team's direction, including what to build, what to partner on, and where to invest

Minimum qualifications

  • Ability to organise and prioritise several parallel streams of work, and to communicate clearly with the teams that work affects

  • Ability to critically review code and experiment results, including work produced by AI agents

  • Sincere interest in developing safe and beneficial AI systems

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience leading ambiguous technical projects and setting direction for other engineers or researchers

  • Experience evaluating large language models, developing classifiers, or operating high-scale production systems where requirements change quickly

  • Experience building detection systems where true positives are rare and false positives are costly, such as abuse, fraud, spam, or intrusion detection

  • Experience running low-latency, high-availability services that other systems depend on, including being on call for them

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, or working with probes and other methods that read model internals

  • Experience with LLM inference or serving infrastructure, or with integrating new components into training infrastructure

  • Background in security, such as sandboxing or detection and response

  • Familiarity with research on AI control, scalable oversight, agent safety, or reinforcement learning

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:£375,000—£640,000 GBP

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Retention and Growth Project & AI Coordinator (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Purpose of Position

Our Retention & Growth Team is responsible for two keys areas;

  1. Customer Retention – ensuring long-term continuity and sustainability of our customer base. 
  2. Portfolio Growth – expanding revenue in line with Gross Profit (GP) and Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) targets.

This team leads the migration of customers onto new MarTech commercial models and updated contracts as part of the company’s wider business transformation.

In parallel, the team drives revenue optimisation by:

  • Upselling customers to higher-value Platform Offers or Service Packages
  • Cross-selling additional services or add-ons
  • Expanding existing customers into new markets or programmes
  • Downgrading customers to more suitable Platform Offers or Service Packages where appropriate

The R&G Project & AI Coordinator is an assistant-level role responsible for providing operational, contractual and project support to the Retention & Growth Team. 

A key focus of the position will be supporting contract reconciliation and contract management activities, ensuring that customer agreements, Salesforce records, internal approvals and supporting documentation are complete, accurate and aligned.

The role will also support the team in identifying and implementing AI-based efficiencies. This may include improving administrative processes, supporting AI initiatives, testing new ways of working and identifying opportunities to reduce manual effort across contract management, reporting, account preparation and other R&G activities.

Where appropriate, the R&G Project & AI Coordinator may attend customer calls and support commercial or contractual discussions. This will initially be alongside an R&G Manager or the R&G Team Leader, with the opportunity to take greater ownership of suitable activities as their knowledge and confidence develop.

This is a temporary maternity leave cover position. The role is intended to provide flexible support across the R&G Team, with priorities determined by current workload, team capacity and business requirements.
The position reports directly to the local R&G Team Leader, who will provide day-to-day management, training and prioritisation. The role will work closely with R&G Managers and relevant teams across Client Services, Legal, Finance, Global Business Operations, Go-to-Market, InfoSec and Technology.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the reconciliation of existing customer contracts against Salesforce records, pricing information, programme configurations and internal documentation.
  • Review contract records to identify missing agreements, amendments, approvals, signatures or supporting documentation.
  • Assist with the preparation, processing and administration of opportunities, contracts, renewals, renegotiations, upgrades, downgrades and other contractual documentation.
  • Support the identification of activities that could be simplified, accelerated or improved through AI, automation or better use of existing systems.
  • Work with the R&G Team to understand time-consuming or repetitive processes and help develop more efficient ways of completing them.
  • Support the planning and delivery of R&G projects and operational initiatives.
  • Attend customer calls where appropriate to support R&G Managers with contract, renewal or account-related discussions.
  • Support straightforward customer communications and follow-ups under the guidance of an R&G Manager or the R&G Team Leader.
  • Communicate professionally and clearly with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide flexible support across the wider R&G function based on changing team priorities and capacity.


Skills & Expertise

  • Provide flexible support across the wider R&G function based on changing team priorities and capacity.
  • An interest in AI, automation and process improvement, with a willingness to test and adopt new ways of working.
  • Ability to identify repetitive or inefficient processes and suggest practical improvements
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using Salesforce to manage customer communications and records.
  • Comfortable engaging with internal stakeholders and participating in customer conversations where appropriate.
  • Commercial awareness and an interest in developing knowledge of customer contracts, negotiations and retention
  • Good problem-solving skills and the confidence to highlight issues or inconsistencies.
  • Able to work independently while recognising when support or escalation is required.
  • A collaborative and flexible approach, with a willingness to support different priorities across the team.
  • Affiliate marketing experience is beneficial but not essential.

As an assistant-level position, the R&G Project & AI Coordinator will not initially have independent ownership of complex negotiations, high-risk contractual decisions or material commercial approvals.
Such matters should remain with the relevant R&G Manager, R&G Team Leader, Legal or authorised approver. Responsibility may be expanded gradually for suitable activities based on experience, training and business need.


Our Offer
  • Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
  • Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
  • Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
  • Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
  • Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
  • Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.

Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.

Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.

Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.

Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why  

Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

title: Revenue Operations Analyst (London)
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Note: this role is based remotely out of London, UK.

 

Regional Expectations

  • Based in London with strong overlap to customer business hours.

  • Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a plus.

The Opportunity

Deepgram is hiring a Revenue Operations Analyst to help build and operate the systems, data, and workflows that power our GTM organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting into the details: fixing broken workflows, improving data quality, supporting quote-to-cash and usage-based billing processes, and finding ways to automate repetitive work. You’ll work closely with GTM Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Renewals to make our commercial systems more reliable, scalable, and efficient.

What You’ll Do

  • Support and improve quote-to-cash workflows, including CPQ, order forms, contract changes, subscriptions, entitlements, and downstream system updates.

  • Partner with Finance and GTM Engineering on usage, billing, and monetization workflows, including reconciliation across CRM, product, billing, and finance systems.

  • Serve as a hands-on Salesforce and GTM systems operator, building reports, dashboards, flows, automations, and system enhancements.

  • Maintain strong data quality and governance across accounts, opportunities, contracts, usage, renewals, and customer records.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve GTM systems and process issues, identifying root causes rather than relying on manual workarounds.

  • Identify repetitive or high-friction workflows and help build automation and AI-enabled solutions to reduce manual effort.

  • Support the systems and reporting used to operationalize forecasting, routing, territory, quota, and commission decisions.

  • Partner with the Director, GTM Engineering on system requirements, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing optimization.

  • Help create scalable operating processes as Deepgram grows, while staying close to the day-to-day work that surfaces where systems need to improve.

It’s Important to Us That You Have

  • 3–4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, GTM Systems, Sales Operations, Business Systems, or a related role.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, flows, automation, and data management.

  • Experience working across CRM, CPQ, billing, contract, or other GTM systems.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.

  • A track record of improving workflows, not just executing existing processes.

  • Comfort using AI and automation tools to reduce manual work and improve operations.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across GTM, Finance, and technical teams.

It Would Be Great If You Had

  • Experience in a usage-based or consumption-based business.

  • Experience with CPQ and contract-generation tools.

  • Familiarity with billing or metering systems.

  • SQL or experience working with GTM/customer data.

  • Experience with tools such as Claude, Cursor, n8n, Workato, Retool, or similar automation environments.

  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or AI company.

descriptionHtml:

Nous recherchons un Administrateur Salesforce expérimenté avec une solide expertise en CPQ pour soutenir et optimiser notre environnement Salesforce au sein d'une organisation SaaS en forte croissance. Ce poste se situe à l'intersection des Ventes, des Opérations de Revenus, de la Finance et du Succès Client, en veillant à ce que Salesforce soutienne la manière dont l'entreprise vend et gère réellement ses clients. Le candidat retenu sera opérationnel, proactif et à l'aise pour travailler avec les équipes GTM dans un environnement SaaS à abonnement. Vous devez comprendre le fonctionnement des Account Executives et des Account Managers, et être capable de traduire les processus commerciaux en configurations Salesforce évolutives. Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations CRM, aux intégrations ou à la consolidation de systèmes lors d'acquisitions sera un atout majeur.

Veuillez noter que certains entretiens se dérouleront en anglais.

Tasks

  • Gouvernance du cycle de vie complet : Piloter l'optimisation de bout en bout de Salesforce CPQ, en traduisant des stratégies commerciales complexes en offres produits sophistiquées, en logiques de tarification et en workflows d'approbation automatisés.
  • Alignement Devis-Encaissement : Garantir que le moteur CPQ reflète fidèlement les structures tarifaires réelles et les processus contractuels, en fluidifiant le parcours du devis initial jusqu'aux données prêtes pour la finance.
  • Conception de systèmes évolutifs : Piloter l'évolution de nos structures de données fondamentales et des automatisations Flow, en veillant à ce que la plateforme soit conçue pour une performance à long terme plutôt que pour des correctifs à court terme.
  • Pilotage des migrations et des fusions-acquisitions : Assurer le rôle de référent technique pour les migrations CRM et les consolidations de systèmes, en maintenant un modèle de données unifié et robuste lors des expansions mondiales et des intégrations d'entités.
  • Conseiller stratégique GTM : Collaborer directement avec les directions Ventes, RevOps et Finance pour traduire les besoins métier de haut niveau en configurations techniques évolutives.
  • Synergie des opérations de revenus : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Data et RevOps pour assurer une cohérence optimale des systèmes, en mettant l'accent sur la visibilité du pipeline et sur des reportings fiables sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie client.
  • Intégrité et performance du système : Maintenir des standards élevés en matière de qualité des données et de santé du système, en faisant de la plateforme une « source de vérité » que les équipes GTM adoptent réellement et en laquelle elles ont confiance.
  • Résolution proactive des problèmes : Identifier et éliminer les points de friction au sein de l'écosystème Salesforce, en allant au-delà de la simple maintenance pour porter une démarche d'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

Requirements

  • Approfondie en administration Salesforce, avec un historique démontré dans la gestion d'organisations complexes.
  • Expérience démontrable avec Salesforce CPQ
  • Expérience au sein d'entreprises SaaS B2B ou à modèle d'abonnement
  • Solide compréhension des processus de vente, de la gestion du pipeline et du cycle de vie client
  • Une expérience dans le soutien aux migrations ou intégrations CRM est fortement appréciée
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec les équipes Ventes, RevOps, Finance et Succès Client
  • Gestion du changement : Expérience dans la conduite d'intégrations ou migrations CRM, idéalement dans un contexte de fusions-acquisitions ou de croissance rapide.
  • Maîtrise des langues : Français (C2), Anglais professionnel courant

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Construire des produits à impact réel : Nous résolvons des problèmes complexes du quotidien pour des milliers d'entreprises à travers l'Europe, en remplaçant des opérations de flotte manuelles et fragmentées par des solutions intelligentes et basées sur les données sur lesquelles les gens comptent vraiment.

  • Grandir avec autonomie et confiance : Nous investissons massivement dans le produit, la data et les personnes — en vous donnant l'espace pour prendre des responsabilités, contribuer vos idées, challenger les autres et donner le meilleur de vous-même tout en participant à façonner notre croissance.
  • Tickets Restaurant : 19 tickets restaurant par mois complet travaillé, d'une valeur de 9 €, financés à 60 % par l'entreprise et à 40 % par le salarié.
  • Transport : Remboursement à 50 % de votre abonnement aux transports en commun (sur présentation d'un justificatif).
  • Plateforme Avantages Salariés (Comité d'Entreprise) : Accès à diverses réductions et avantages via notre plateforme CE.

title: Sales Development Representative
descriptionHtml:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Sales Development Representative with a love for selling and a tenacious and methodical approach to prospecting.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Create a fantastic first impression with prospects and customers while building pipeline for Account Executives.

  • Follow up and qualify inbound requests and MQLs, via the telephone and email, for scientific fit.

  • Organize, categorize, and prioritize sales leads in Salesforce and measure lead conversion and performance against quota.

  • Leverage prospecting tools to research companies and identify key decision makers at new accounts.

  • Develop customized pitches for different target accounts and personas.

  • Work with Account Executives to drive outbound prospecting activities, including cold calling, emailing, and communicating our value proposition to decision makers.

  • Work with the field marketing and sales teams to drive attendance at Benchling field events such as executive dinners and happy hours.

  • Staff tradeshows and follow-up on leads collected at the Benchling booth.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Undergraduate degree in life sciences required (e.g. molecular biology, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, biochemistry), Postgraduate welcomed

  • Recent graduate or 1-2 years of internship / work experience in a Sales Development Representative, Business Development Representative function.

  • Passionate about Benchling’s mission and the acceleration of life sciences research

  • Not afraid to pick up the phone and cold call in German

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in German and English

  • Driven to meet/exceed goals with a proven history of consistent high achievement

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

title: Sales Manager – SaaS/B2B (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
UNSER PURPOSE BEI PLANCRAFT

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 30.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

 

Als Sales Manager (f/m/d) bist du ein zentraler Treiber des Umsatzwachstums bei plancraft. Du arbeitest mit qualifizierten, eingehenden Leads und begleitest sie vom ersten Gespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.



Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du bearbeitest qualifizierte Leads mit erkennbarem Bedarf.

  • Du führst Produktdemos durch, analysierst Kundenbedürfnisse und entwickelst passende Lösungen.

  • Du berätst potenzielle Kund:innen strukturiert und begleitest sie durch den gesamten Verkaufsprozess.

  • Du schließt Deals eigenständig ab – vom Erstgespräch bis zum Vertragsabschluss.

  • Du behältst deine KPIs im Blick und arbeitest strukturiert mit unserem CRM.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Customer Success zusammen, um die bestmögliche Kundenerfahrung zu schaffen.

Bei plancraft erwarten dich klare und transparente Karrierepfade – z. B. von Junior Sales Manager bis Senior Sales Manager – und du kannst dich bei uns mit klarer Perspektive und nachhaltig weiterentwickeln. Unsere Gehaltsstruktur ist transparent aufgebaut: Je nach Erfahrungslevel liegt dein On-Target-Earnings (OTE) zwischen 60.000 € und 87.500 €, bestehend aus einem Fixgehalt zwischen 45.000 € und 62.500 € sowie einer variablen Komponente zwischen 15.000 € und 25.000 €.

 

DEIN PROFIL

 

Must-haves

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B- oder SaaS-Vertrieb, idealerweise im Umgang mit warmen Leads oder Closing.

  • Erfahrung in der Bedarfsanalyse und im Führen strukturierter Verkaufsgespräche.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen (z. B. HubSpot, Pipedrive oder Salesforce).

  • Interesse daran, AI zu nutzen, um deinen Sales-Alltag smarter, skalierbarer und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau.

  • Offenheit, regelmäßig in unser Büro in Hamburg zu kommen (hybrid).



Nice-to-Haves

  • Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertrieb.

  • Erfahrung mit Kund:innen aus dem Handwerks- oder Baugewerbe.

 

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen ChatGPT+-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

  • Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

  • Flexibilität: Ob remote, hybrid oder im Office: Du arbeitest dort, wo du es am besten kannst. Unser Hamburger Büro am Rödingsmarkt (inkl. Dachterrasse) steht dir jederzeit offen.

  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

  • Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.

  • Internationales Umfeld: Wir werden stetig internationaler mit Kolleginnen u. a. in Italien, Frankreich, den Niederlanden und Österreich – und kommunizieren intern auf Englisch.

 

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

Diversity makes us better.
We welcome people of all backgrounds, identities, abilities, and experiences, and we believe that different perspectives lead to better ideas, stronger products, and a healthier workplace.
