title: Sales Team Lead (mid-market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Account Executives and scale some of our Mid-Market segments addressing companies of 30–300 employees.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Account Executives to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Account Executives:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

title: Scriptwriter intern
descriptionHtml:
La mission de Finary

Notre mission : rendre le pouvoir aux investisseurs. Le bon conseil financier a toujours existé, mais il était réservé à ceux qui dépassaient un certain seuil de patrimoine. Nous changeons la donne en construisant la plateforme d'investissement tout-en-un, propulsée par l'IA : suivre ses actifs, gérer son budget, investir et se former, au même endroit. Une idée simple et ambitieuse nous guide : mettre un banquier privé dans la poche de chacun.

Mounir a lancé Finary en 2021, et plus d'un million de personnes nous confient aujourd'hui leur vie financière. Nous lançons des produits de pointe avec une touche de plaisir, et nous sommes exigeants sur l'expérience, la performance et la simplicité.

 

Pourquoi maintenant ?

Une nouvelle génération d'investisseurs émerge : ambitieuse, impliquée, débarrassée des tabous autour de l'argent. Nous croyons en un monde où investir permet à chacun de vivre la vie dont il a toujours rêvé. Pour accélérer, nous avons levé 40M€ auprès de Hedosophia, Y Combinator et Speedinvest, aux côtés de fondateurs et d'opérateurs comme Steve Anavi et Alexandre Prot (Qonto), Matthieu Rouif (Photoroom), Eric Demuth (Bitpanda), Axel Weber (ancien président d'UBS) et Harsh Sinha (CTO de Wise).

En juillet 2026, l'AMF nous a accordé l'agrément MiCA, qui s'ajoute à notre agrément d'Entreprise d'Investissement : nous sommes l'une des très rares plateformes françaises à détenir les deux, avec actions, ETF et crypto réunis sur une seule plateforme régulée, au moment même où l'Europe se consolide autour des acteurs agréés. Il n'y a jamais eu de meilleur moment pour nous rejoindre.

 

Ce que nous offrons

Nous sommes 70 builders qui aimons profondément ce que nous faisons : de vraies responsabilités dès le premier jour, un package salaire et equity au meilleur niveau du marché, des bureaux en plein cœur de Paris avec du remote hybride, et des offsites trimestriels qu'on attend vraiment.

Nous recrutons des A-players aussi bienveillants qu'exigeants, des personnes dont les idées transforment notre produit autant que notre façon de travailler et de penser. Notre culture est directe et transparente : on se challenge ouvertement, puis on s'aligne et on exécute. Et sur l'IA, pas de demi-mesure : c'est la compétence la plus importante de la décennie et un vrai critère chez nous. Chacun a repensé sa manière de travailler autour d'elle. Si c'est déjà une seconde nature pour vous, vous trouverez ici des gens qui repoussent cette frontière chaque jour.

Découvrez nos valeurs ici.

---

LE POSTE

Finary Media fait la première chaîne YouTube d’éducation financière en France : 880 000 abonnés et 5 à 10 millions de vues par mois, tout est produit en interne. Chaque vidéo est traitée comme un produit : on mesure, on itère, on améliore.

Rattaché·e à Rayan, tu travailles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne d’écriture : recherche, script, vérification, packaging et présentation face caméra.

TES MISSIONS

  • Mener la recherche sur des sujets d’investissement et de patrimoine (ETF, assurance-vie, immobilier, fiscalité), à partir de sources fiables, et vérifier chaque donnée.

  • Rédiger des scripts pour la chaîne YouTube et les formats courts, puis les faire évoluer avec l’auteur senior jusqu’à la version validée.

  • Présenter tes scripts face caméra.

  • Concevoir le packaging des vidéos : titres, accroches, angles de miniature.

  • Intégrer l’IA à chaque étape de la production et développer tes propres outils : prompts structurés, workflows, automatisations.

CE QUE CE STAGE T’APPORTE

  • Écrire pour une audience de plusieurs centaines de milliers de personnes, avec des résultats mesurés sur chaque vidéo.

  • Une formation à la présentation face caméra, au sein d’une équipe qui tourne chaque semaine.

  • La rigueur d’une rédaction financière, où aucune approximation n’est acceptée.

  • Une méthode de production où l’IA prend en charge une grande partie de la recherche et de la mise en forme.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Étudiant·e en Bac+4 ou Bac+5 en école de journalisme, en école de commerce ou en master de finance ou d’économie, avec une convention de stage.

  • Une solide culture financière : tu maîtrises les fondamentaux de l’épargne et de l’investissement (enveloppes fiscales, classes d’actifs, fiscalité du patrimoine) et tu sais les rendre accessibles.

  • Une plume démontrée : des textes publiés que tu peux nous montrer (média étudiant, blog, newsletter, LinkedIn, rédaction en stage). Nous évaluons la qualité de l’écriture et ta capacité à retenir le lecteur.

  • Une rigueur factuelle sans faille : chaque chiffre est sourcé et vérifié avant publication.

  • Une pratique avancée de l’IA : au-delà d’un usage conversationnel, tu as déjà conçu des prompts structurés, des workflows ou des automatisations pour produire mieux et plus vite.

  • L’aisance face caméra, qui est un prérequis du poste.

  • Un vrai esprit de synthèse, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

  • La capacité à intégrer un retour rapidement et à le traduire dans la version suivante.

ATOUTS APPRÉCIÉS

  • Une expérience vidéo : tournage, présentation ou montage.

  • Des compétences techniques : code, outils no-code, création d’outils d’analyse financière.

  • Une première expérience en finance, dans un média ou dans une fintech.

Entretiens

Les entretiens avec les candidat·es francophones se déroulent en français. En tant qu’entreprise internationale, nous attendons un niveau d’anglais professionnel, que nous évaluons lors de l’entretien de présélection.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Unblu

Unblu helps the world's leading banks and insurance companies deliver conversational finance solutions. We provide highly secure engagement and collaboration software, enabling financial institutions to enrich the digital experience of their clients.

By choosing a career with Unblu you choose to join an international, and innovation-savvy company. With our head office situated in Basel, Switzerland and additional offices in Bulgaria, Germany, the UK, Canada and the USA, you’ll be joining an international team dedicated to shaping the future of digital engagement. While Unblu is run as an independent company with global scope, we are fortunate to have Swiss Post as our anchor shareholder, providing long term support and vision to the company.

The Role

We're looking for a Security Engineer to work alongside our SRE and engineering teams, embedding security across the full software development lifecycle. You'll own a mix of defensive operations and developer-facing security tooling, from WAF rule management and CVE triage to building the pipelines that keep our deployments safe by default.

This role sits at the intersection of application security, platform security and operations. You'll partner closely with engineering to ship secure software, and with SRE when things need to be hardened or investigated. We run entirely in the cloud, with a strong focus on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

You'll report to our VP SRE. An on-call rotation shared with SRE may be part of this role; we'll finalize expectations with the successful candidate.

Responsibilities

  • Embed security practices throughout the software development lifecycle, from design review to production monitoring, working hands-on with engineering teams
  • Build, maintain and evolve the security tooling in our GitLab CI/CD pipelines: SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secret detection and container scanning
  • Review Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs) for our applications, track supply chain risk and drive remediation of issues in third-party components
  • Own CVE triage end to end: assess relevance, prioritize based on exposure and exploitability, and coordinate remediation with product teams
  • Manage and tune our Web Application Firewall (WAF) rules, balancing strong protection against false-positive noise
  • Run internal security audits, document findings clearly and work with teams to close gaps
  • Coordinate our annual external penetration test end to end; review pen test reports commissioned by our customers, translate findings into actionable work and respond back to the customer
  • Lead the technical investigation, containment and recovery of security incidents together with SRE
  • Provide technical evidence for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 audits, DORA resilience testing and customer security questionnaires, together with our Compliance Manager
  • Help run or grow our external bug bounty program (optional scope): triage reports, coordinate with researchers and drive fixes through engineering

Requirements

  • Practical, hands-on security experience in a SOC, incident response or security engineering context, where you've done the work, not just written policy
  • A degree, recognized certification (OSCP, CISSP, GIAC or equivalent) or structured training in information security
  • Comfortable working across the entire software lifecycle, shifting between developer collaboration, operations and governance
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally in GitLab CI
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanners, SBOM tools (Syft, Grype, Trivy, Dependency-Track or similar) and WAF platforms (Cloud Armor, Cloudflare or similar)
  • Working knowledge of GCP security primitives (IAM, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Armor, Secret Manager, Binary Authorization, Security Command Center); comparable experience in another major cloud is fine if you're ready to go deep on GCP
  • A clear communicator who can explain risk to engineers in terms they'll act on, and present confidently to customer security teams and auditors
  • Fluent in English; German or French is a plus

Benefits

  • An interesting and rewarding role in the Sales team in the world's leading live collaboration software manufacturer
  • Direct reporting line to the VP SRE
  • Work in a diverse environment: 30+ nationalities across 8 locations
  • Competitive salary, 5-week holiday, and great referral bonuses
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid working environment
  • Our office in Basel is next to the main railway station

#LI-Hybrid

Make sure to have a look at our Glassdoor page too - it will give you more insights into what it is like to work for us.

Unblu is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We use Workable as our recruitment platform, which utilizes AI to help categorize and organize applications. However, every application is carefully reviewed by our HR team. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills, and experiences within our workforce. Please note that due to the nature of our business, all new joiners will have to complete a detailed background check, further information can be requested.

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that builds trust, sparks innovation, and strengthens team culture.

 

About Superhuman

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that makes AI work for everyone. Over 40 million people rely on it daily to get work done. A recognized leader in productivity tools, Superhuman is the maker of popular products including Docs, Fathom, Go, GPTZero, Grammarly, and Mail. The newest product, Superhuman Go, builds on Grammarly’s ability to deliver help everywhere people work. It lets anyone build proactive agents that act as teammates across more than 1 million apps and websites, without changing how they work. Learn more at superhuman.com.

 

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Security Engineer to join our Detection & Response Team to achieve our ambitious goals. This role will contribute to our D&R team as hands-on practitioner across incident response, detection engineering, threat hunting, and threat intelligence. You'll plan, execute, and debrief complex security operations, leveraging those insights to enhance our threat mitigation capabilities and build robust, automated security tooling across all Superhuman environments.

Additionally, you'll own key workstreams in executing and advancing our security vision, translating strategic objectives into tactical implementations through strong technical execution and innovative solution building, with particular emphasis on automation and AI-powered security solutions. You'll conduct research across security domains and automation technologies, identifying opportunities to enhance our capabilities through cutting-edge approaches and intelligent automation. Finally, you'll bring an attacker mindset into Superhuman’s engineering and security culture, thinking like a threat actor to defend our systems in a way that is grounded in how real attacks happen.

Superhuman's engineers and researchers have the freedom to innovate and uncover breakthroughs—and, in turn, influence our product roadmap. The complexity of our technical challenges is growing rapidly as we scale our interfaces, algorithms, and infrastructure. Curious how we build and operate our AI agents? Check out our engineering blog, and explore our threat-hunting AI here.

As a Security Engineer, you will:

  • Own the IR strategy end-to-end, building, maintaining, and operating the systems and tooling that strengthen our ability to detect, contain, and recover from security incidents at scale

  • Build and maintain automated threat detection systems, AI-driven alert triage solutions, and security intelligence pipelines that scale with business growth

  • Conduct threat hunting and detection engineering, developing detection-as-code, hunting-as-code, and intelligence-as-code capabilities.

  • Research and develop cutting-edge security automation and AI-powered security solutions to deepen and scale our ability to identify threats, including autonomous security agents.

  • Operate without traditional scope limitations, following attacker kill chains to uncover security gaps that scoped teams miss.

  • Lead complex security investigations, including insider threat scenarios and sophisticated attack campaigns.

  • Maintain incident response capabilities and serve as part of the Incident Command on-call schedule.

  • Embed attacker mindset thinking throughout the organization through education and collaboration with engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • Has 3+ years of relevant experience in security engineering, with expertise across multiple disciplines including incident response and detection engineering (threat intelligence, threat hunting experience is nice to have too)

  • Proven incident response leadership and complex security investigation experience.

  • Automation and development skills in Python, Go, or similar languages, with experience building production security tooling.

  • Knowledge of cloud security architecture.

  • Research mindset with an ability to identify novel attack vectors and develop creative, pragmatic solutions.

  • Thrives in ambiguous environments and can deliver meaningful results at a rapid pace while managing multiple competing priorities.

  • Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and thrives in fast-paced, results-driven environments.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with CI/CD security integration, identity and access management concepts, and security orchestration.

  • Experience with large-scale Kubernetes clusters.

  • Background in AI/ML applications for security, including experience with or interest in developing autonomous security systems.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Professional Growth: We believe that autonomy and trust are key to empowering our team members to do their best, most innovative work in a way that aligns with their interests, talents, and well-being

  • A connected team: Superhuman builds a product that helps people connect, and we apply this mindset to our own team. Our remote-first, hybrid model enables a highly collaborative culture rooted in our values. We work to foster belonging among team members in a variety of ways. This includes our team member resource groups, Superhuman Circles, which promote connection among those with shared identities including BIPOC and LGBTQIA+ team members, women, and parents. We also celebrate our colleagues and accomplishments with global, local, and team-specific programs.

  • Comprehensive benefits for candidates based in Germany: Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing life care (including mental health care and risk benefits) and ample and defined time off. We also offer support to set up a home office, wellness and pet care stipends, learning and development opportunities, and more.

  • Relocation Support: Superhuman provides relocation support to make your move to Berlin seamless. Our package includes visa assistance, destination services to help you and your family settle in comfortably, and a relocation bonus to cover additional expenses, such as temporary housing.

 

We encourage you to apply

At Superhuman, we value our differences, and we encourage all—especially those whose identities are traditionally underrepresented in tech organizations—to apply. Superhuman is an equal opportunity company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race or ethnic origin, religion or belief, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, sexual identity, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, criminal prosecution, judgment in a criminal case, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Seller Support Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

And here's where you come in

We're looking for talented folks to join our Customer Experience team – the heart and soul of

Motorway. As a Customer Experience Specialist, you'll be the friendly voice and expert guide

for our customers, making sure they have a smooth and enjoyable journey with us.

What makes us different

We're not your typical call centre. No rigid scripts or endless queues here. We're using tech

to shake up the car industry. We're empowering buyers and sellers to get the best deals.

And we're building a team of passionate people who are excited to be part of something truly

innovative. Here's what that means for you:

  • Impactful Work: You're not just answering calls; you're guiding customers through

our cutting-edge online platform, using your skills to solve real problems and make

their car selling experience amazing.

  • AI-Powered Technology: We use the latest AI tools, so you can give customers a

seamless and efficient experience. Say goodbye to clunky systems!

Tangible Results: Every day, you'll directly help people navigate the car selling

process, making sure they get the best deal and avoid the stress of traditional

methods.

What you'll be doing

  • Building genuine connections: Chatting with car sellers and dealers, answering

their questions, and building trust.

  • Finding creative solutions: Using your initiative and problem-solving skills to tackle

any challenges.

  • Mastering our systems: Becoming a whiz with our CRM systems, ensuring data

accuracy and efficiency.

  • Putting customers first: Always championing the customer and looking for ways to

make their experience even better.

About you

  • You genuinely enjoy helping people and have a knack for building rapport.

  • You're a natural communicator, whether it's on the phone, via email, or through chat.

  • You're detail-oriented and take pride in your work.

  • You're a quick learner and enjoy solving problems.

  • You thrive in a collaborative environment.

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive

  • £26,000 starting salary plus commission

  • Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 8:45am to 5:30pm

  • Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages

and free snacks to keep you going!

  • Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

  • One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

  • Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks

paternity leave and workplace nursery scheme

... and much more!

Our interview process

  • Initial Call (30 mins): A casual chat to discuss your experience and learn more

about Motorway.

  • Final Interview (60 mins): Meet the team, get a feel for the role, and participate in a

skills-based assessment, which may include a role-playing exercise.

We'll get back to you within a week business days of each interview stage. You can chat with

a talent partner throughout the process if you have any questions or need anything at all.

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

  • Competitive salary

  • Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

  • 25 days holiday

  • Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

  • Private medical insurance via BUPA

  • Life assurance

  • Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

  • Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

  • 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

  • EV leasing scheme

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

  • 1 paid volunteering day a year

Compensation: £25.5K

  • • Starting Salary £25.5K

title: Senior Account Executive - Mid-market and Enterprise - €80–110K OTE (Uncap) + BSPCE
descriptionHtml:
Our team shared’s mission is deploy AI agents to transform how patients and doctors connect

We believe healthcare shouldn’t be defined by missed calls, endless waiting lines, and overwhelmed staff. Patients and professionals deserve better.

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer every call instantly, schedule and reschedule appointments, and free up staff to focus on what matters most: care.

Already trusted by 15 000+ providers, we’re transforming the patient–provider relationship, one call at a time.

Want to shape the future of healthcare?

Join us !

  • Discover our company culture and values

  • Here is a product teaser

  • Eliott's interview for Welcome to the jungle

  • Eliott's quick interview for Speedinvest

  • Articles on our A round (techfundingnews, Maddyness, les echos, our blog)

Context

Vocca builds AI voice agents that answer patient calls, book and reschedule appointments, triage emergencies, and free up administrative staff so care teams can focus on care. The product is live and used daily in hundreds of healthcare facilities, just a few months after launch.

We are scaling fast. The CDS segment (health centers, ~€20–50k ARR per account) is one of our top priorities, but we still address it in an unstructured way.

This is a full-cycle new-business role: you own everything from cold outreach to signature, and you build your own territory.

Your mission

Generate €600k ARR in year one in new business on the CDS segment, owning the full cycle from prospecting to signed deals.

Expected outcomes

1 month:

  • Get up to speed on our pitch, our product, and our market (types of centers, buying journey…)

  • Make your first prospecting calls, demos, and initial sales conversations

  • Open your first multi-stakeholder opportunities

3 months:

  • Build a stable pipeline, generating at least 10 meetings per week and a healthy book of active opportunities

  • Improve our call scripts and email sequences

  • Work closely with the Ops team to ensure smooth deployments

  • Identify weak signals from the field and feed into the product roadmap

  • Full autonomy by month 3 on pitch, product, ICP, and qualification

6-12 months:

  • Manage complex sales cycles (groups, multi-site, multiple stakeholders)

  • Contribute to structuring our sales playbook

  • Participate in training new Sales hires (onboarding, coaching, sharing learnings)

What the role looks like day to day

Build your own pipeline

  • Generate qualified meetings across every sales channel: cold calling first, plus email, LinkedIn, events, and networking

  • Create your own network and get referred to new decision-makers

  • Run phoning, email campaigns, and inbound screening from day one

Own the full sales cycle

  • Map accounts and manage multiple stakeholders (center directors, group GMs, practitioners, secretaries) through a considered cycle

  • Deep discovery, sharp pitch, and efficient closing with center decision-makers

  • Master the Vocca sales playbook to move deals stage to stage

  • Work closely with Ops to ensure smooth deployments

Make the engine better

  • Keep Attio (CRM) spotless and your week tightly planned across prospecting, meetings, and networking

  • Surface field signals into the product roadmap and improve our scripts and sequences

What sales look like on the CDS segment

  • Deal size from 15K to 65K (~30K average)

  • 1.5 month sale cycle, multi-stakeholder

  • ICP: health centers (centres de santé)

This role is for you if

The prerequisites:

  • You build qualified pipeline from cold. You've done real cold calling on cold targets: people you're interrupting, not warm inbound or an existing book you upsell. You know how to create a network and earn referrals from new decision-makers.

  • You've run mid-market deals end to end. You've personally sourced and closed your own deals for at least 1 year, on multi-stakeholder cycles (~€30k average basket). You map accounts, listen actively, and you're convincing and assertive in closing.

  • You have a solar, high-energy presence with the gravitas to deal with center directors: health centers rewards organized, senior sellers, more structured. You adapt your posture and vocabulary from group GMs to practitioners and secretaries with the same professional posture.

What we'll evaluate in interviews:

  • Demanding with yourself, highly coachable: your track record shows you don't settle for the status quo (academic, athletic, or professional over-achievement; you hit or beat your targets). No ego: you take feedback, apply it next time, and stay curious about a sector you may not know yet.

  • Team-first: you put collective success before personal recognition. Problem solver, not problem builder. You question yourself when things don't work.

  • Rigor, discipline, organization: you plan your week, arrive prepared and on time, keep the CRM discipline tight. You're reliable.

Requirements:

  • 3–6 years of B2B sales with genuine cold prospecting + closing experience, ideally having done the BDR → AE track

  • Native-level French and good written and spoken English for internal communication

  • Top-tier background: a strong school, or a demanding company

  • Entrepreneurial mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience in healthcare / healthtech, or selling a product with regulatory constraints

  • Grounding in sales theory (you've read the fundamentals)

  • Familiarity with Attio, Notion, Slack, Apollo

This role is NOT for you if

  • You've only ever been a BDR/SDR booking meetings, or you've only sold by upselling a warm existing portfolio. This role is cold sourcing + closing from scratch.

  • You optimize for individual recognition over team outcomes.

Perks and Benefits

  • Equity (BSPCE)

  • Executive contract (cadre) on a forfait-jours basis, with ~8–12 RTT days per year (depending on the year's public holidays).

  • Hybrid rhythm from Paris: 3-4 days at the office, 1-2 day per week remote.

  • MacBook provided.

  • Meal vouchers: €9 per working day (55% covered by the company).

  • EGYM Wellpass (Gymlib).

  • Health insurance: 50% of Alan covered.

  • Public transport: 50% of Navigo covered.

  • Annual offsite and multiple team events throughout the year.

Hiring process

  1. Discovery interview (30 min, video) — Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Manager fit interview (30 min, video) — Alexandre, Head of Sales

  3. Track record + case study (1h) — Alexandre and Nathan (Senior AE)

  4. Founders / culture fit (1h, on site) — Eliott, CEO and/or Hugo, CTO + coffee with the team

  5. Reference checks

  6. Offer

We aim to keep the process within 30 days. You’ll receive continuous feedback throughout.

Why should you join Vocca?

  • An entrepreneurial adventure, with a supportive, high-energy, execution-focused team

  • A product already live, with delighted customers in a fast-growing market (healthcare automation, voice AI)

  • A true scaling phase, with everything still to build

  • Real responsibilities from day one

We hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about our opportunities but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

title: Senior AI - Computer Vision Engineer - UK
descriptionHtml:
Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer

Build the spatial AI behind the future of construction

At XYZ Reality, we've created the world's first engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution for construction. Our technology, The Atom, is already being used on major construction projects around the world to help teams build more accurately, efficiently and with fewer mistakes.

Our R&D team applies computer vision, spatial AI and machine learning to one of the most demanding real-world settings there is: the active construction site.

We’re looking for a Senior AI / Computer Vision Engineer with deep expertise in 3D computer vision and spatial AI to join the team and help develop the perception technology behind our products.

As a Series B business entering our next phase of growth, we're investing in our R&D capability and growing our team. This great opportunity will be based out of our Angel, London office on a hybrid basis, 2-3 days per week.

The Role

This is an opportunity to solve computer vision problems that exist at the intersection of the digital and physical world.

You’ll develop the perception and scene-understanding systems that enable our wearable technology to recognise construction objects, understand complex 3D environments, and relate what’s on site to the design model, using real-world sensor data.

For this role, 3D / spatial computer vision expertise is fundamental. We’re looking for someone who understands how AI and computer vision can reason about physical space, not simply someone with broader AI or machine learning experience.

You’ll work across research, algorithm development, optimisation, deployment and productisation, taking sophisticated computer vision techniques and turning them into robust technology capable of performing on active construction sites.

You’ll bring senior technical expertise to the team as we build our capability and presence in Calgary. You’ll also collaborate closely with our Navigation, Embedded Software, Hardware and Product teams across the wider business.

This is a role where you can combine deep technical work with real-world impact, seeing the algorithms and systems you develop ultimately deployed through wearable technology on some of the world's most complex construction projects.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Develop advanced computer vision algorithms for construction scene understanding and spatial intelligence.

  • Design and develop semantic segmentation, object detection and instance segmentation models.

  • Build algorithms capable of understanding 3D environments, spatial relationships and physical geometry.

  • Develop automated BIM correspondence and object-matching capabilities.

  • Develop algorithms using multi-modal sensor data.

  • Combine AI, 3D vision, SLAM and BIM to develop geometric and spatial reasoning capabilities.

  • Explore emerging scene representation techniques including Gaussian Splatting and NeRFs.

  • Improve localisation-assisted perception and robustness across varying lighting, weather and real-world site conditions.

  • Design, train and evaluate large-scale deep learning models.

  • Develop data pipelines supporting supervised, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning.

  • Evaluate emerging foundation models, multimodal AI and modern computer vision techniques where they can add meaningful value.

  • Optimise models for embedded deployment, improving inference speed, accuracy and robustness.

  • Deploy and optimise models for embedded GPU platforms.

  • Build and improve production inference pipelines, benchmarking performance, latency and accuracy.

  • Contribute to technical architecture, design reviews and our technical direction.

  • Share knowledge and mentor other engineers as the team continues to grow.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ industrial experience in Computer Vision, with strong hands-on experience solving complex technical problems.

  • MSc or PhD in Computer Vision, AI, Computer Science or a related discipline.

  • Experience with perception for autonomous or embodied systems, such as SLAM, sensor fusion or state estimation, would be valuable.

  • Deep expertise in 3D Computer Vision / Spatial AI, this is a core requirement for the role.

  • Strong understanding of geometry, spatial relationships and scene understanding.

  • Experience developing and deploying computer vision and deep learning systems in production.

  • Strong Python development skills and expert knowledge of PyTorch.

  • Experience with semantic segmentation, object detection, image understanding and modern computer vision architectures.

  • Experience designing and training large-scale deep learning models and working with large image datasets.

  • Strong mathematical foundations in machine learning and computer vision.

  • Ability to bridge research and production engineering, comfortable exploring emerging techniques while remaining focused on building robust, deployable products.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex, ambiguous technical challenges.

  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams.

What matters most for this role is genuine depth in 3D / spatial computer vision and the ability to apply that expertise to complex, real-world engineering problems.

We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about where computer vision and AI are heading, but who also has the practical engineering mindset to turn emerging research into technology that works reliably outside of the lab.

What You Could Be Working On

From the outset, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to some of our highest-priority R&D initiatives, including:

  • 3D construction scene understanding

  • Construction semantic segmentation

  • Automated BIM understanding and object correspondence

  • Spatial reasoning across wearable sensor data

  • Embedded AI deployment

  • Foundation models for construction understanding

  • Perception for wearable AR

Why Join Us

  • 🚀 Work at the intersection of Spatial AI, 3D Computer Vision, AR and real-world engineering

  • 🧠 Solve genuinely difficult perception and scene-understanding problems

  • 🥽 Develop AI that ultimately runs through physical, wearable technology – not just software on a screen

  • 🏗️ See your work applied to some of the world’s most ambitious construction projects

  • 📈 Join a Series B business at an exciting stage of international growth

  • 🔬 Work alongside specialists across Computer Vision, AI, Navigation, Embedded Software and Hardware

  • 💡 Have meaningful influence over technical architecture and the future direction of our perception technology

  • 🌍 Build technology with tangible, real-world impact

If you’re passionate about 3D computer vision and spatial AI, enjoy solving difficult problems at the intersection of research and engineering, and want to see your work move from algorithms into technology being used in the physical world, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
Waracle are looking for a Senior Developer for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.

This is a Hybrid role working from the London office 2 days a week.

As a Senior Developer at Waracle, you will play a pivotal role in shaping robust, scalable systems while fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. If you love solving complex technical puzzles, supporting peers through thoughtful mentorship, and balancing innovation with code quality, we would love to welcome you to our team.

Key aspects of the role include

  • Architectural Delivery: Designing and building end-to-end backend subsystems using Go, ensuring our codebases remain modular, maintainable, and built to scale.

  • Quality & Security: Championing engineering excellence through constructive peer reviews and proactive defensive security measures.

  • Technical Guidance & Testing Strategy: Guiding unit, integration, and service-level testing strategies while exploring and introducing fresh industry ideas to our practice.

  • Consulting & Collaboration: Translating complex technical choices into clear, accessible language for client stakeholders and presenting confident, engaging solution demos.

  • Mentorship & Practice Growth: Mentoring and coaching colleagues to support their growth, sharing lessons learned, and continuously enriching Waracle's collective knowledge.

  • Balanced Delivery: Evaluating trade-offs thoughtfully between delivery pace and system health, taking shared accountability for successful feature launches.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring

  • Core Backend Expertise: Proven hands-on experience building, scaling, and troubleshooting secure Go (Golang) systems and microservices in high-traffic environments.

  • Polyglot Mindset: Experience working with at least one other major programming language, giving you the flexibility to contribute across varied tech stacks and architecture patterns.

  • Cloud-Native Knowledge: Practical proficiency with Kubernetes and Helm to deploy and manage resilient, containerised applications.

  • Agile Execution: Strong experience navigating full Agile delivery lifecycles, turning designs into clean code, and working with Continuous Delivery (CD) pipelines.

  • Supportive Leadership: A passion for clean code, comprehensive testing, and uplifting colleagues through empathetic code reviews and ongoing mentorship.

  • Thoughtful Problem Solving: The ability to weigh technical trade-offs, balancing feature momentum with long-term system maintainability and performance.

  • Bonus if you have experience in Kubernetes, deployments with helm, Java Development, SQL databases and monitoring tools like SPLUNK

What to expect from our hiring process

  1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time).

  3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one.

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

title: Senior Brand Designer (12 month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
A little about us

incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Notion, Linear, Ramp and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime.

The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously.

We've raised $100+ million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join.

The role in one line

We're looking for a brilliant Brand Designer who knows B2B SaaS, moves fast, and can make great work happen without a lot of fuss.

What that looks like day to day

We're looking for an experienced Brand Designer to join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, covering maternity leave.

Our brand design function was built from scratch over the last two years and the foundations are strong - a visual identity, an events design system, SEV0, a rolling drumbeat of launches and campaigns. This isn't a holding-pattern role. You'll take what we've built and run with it, across our website, social, events, launches and our flagship conference. Where you see something that should be better, you'll be trusted to make it better.

We're looking for someone who's done this kind of work before, ideally for ambitious B2B SaaS startups or established software brands. You'll have great creative instincts, an eye for the details and, crucially, the ability to get brilliant work out the door quickly. We move fast, priorities can change, and there's always something new around the corner. You'll know when to sweat the small stuff and when to just get things done.

You'll sit day-to-day in Marketing and be part of the wider Design team, alongside experienced Product Designers who'll be on hand to partner on web-native work.

  • Own brand design across all touchpoints - website, social, ads, guides, reports, events and swag - keeping quality and consistency high through a busy launch and campaign calendar.

  • Design and roll out launch creative for product launches, including launch video animation and campaign assets, partnering with Product Designers on product-screen work.

  • Lead the design for our events programme, including our flagship conference SEV0 - booths, banners, printed collateral, swag and the event design system.

  • Keep things moving - juggle multiple projects, turn around great work quickly and know how to prioritise when everything feels important. We're a fast-moving startup, and we need someone who can keep up without compromising on craft.

  • Be an advocate for consistency and craft as we scale and grow the incident.io brand. You'll have the judgement to know when something needs more attention and when it's ready to go.

  • Partner with the marketing team on both tactical and long-term projects, bringing your own perspective on how we should develop our brand.

  • Collaborate with the wider design team as we know an amazing product is the foundation for a great brand, and compelling design can be the foundation for both.

Who you are

  • You've got solid B2B SaaS experience. You've designed for B2B software companies before, whether in-house, freelance or on a contract basis. Ideally, you've worked with established SaaS brands or fast-growing startups, and you understand how to make complex, technical products feel exciting and accessible.

  • Your portfolio speaks for itself. You've got exceptional brand and marketing design work to show us, including websites, campaigns, launches, guides and presentations for B2B SaaS audiences. You care about the little details and know how to make a brand feel brilliant across every touchpoint.

  • You move fast and get stuff done. You've worked in fast-paced environments, ideally startups, and know how to balance speed with quality. You're pragmatic, comfortable juggling competing priorities and don't need everything perfectly mapped out before getting started.

  • You're confident picking up an established brand. You don't need to rebuild things from first principles to make an impact. You can get up to speed quickly, understand what's working and find ways to make it even better.

  • You've got strong digital design skills. You're brilliant in Figma, comfortable with Adobe tools for print, and care just as much about the quality of a one-pager or piece of swag as you do a big campaign.

  • You're a natural collaborator. You enjoy working closely with Marketing, Product Designers and engineers, sharing work early, taking feedback on board and sweating the details to make sure the finished thing is as good as it can be.

  • You're organised and comfortable with ambiguity. Startups can (occasionally!) be chaotic. You can figure things out as you go, make good decisions independently and keep things moving without needing lots of direction.

Bonus points

  • You have experience with motion design / animation.

  • You've designed booths, installations or other creative for conferences and events.

  • You're comfortable working with frontend engineers and getting hands-on with HTML/CSS where needed.

  • You've covered a role on an FTC or contract basis before and know how to get productive fast.

Supporting you

We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both.

  • Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover - we want you and the people you love to be looked after.

  • Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that.

  • First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously.

  • Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought.

  • Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it.

  • Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too.

  • Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

  • Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself.

Compensation: £80K – £115K

title: Senior Commercial Program Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
As a Commercial Strategy & Program Manager in our Sales Strategy & Operations team, you’ll manage the commercial go-to-market for on-top products across our international markets. With a particular focus on new product launches, you’ll build the business case, define the commercial approach and lead cross-functional execution from launch preparation through adoption and scaling. 

You’ll be the central commercial point of contact for your assigned products, working closely with Product, Product Marketing, local sales leadership, Pricing, Finance and Analytics. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting or commercial strategy background who wants to combine analytical depth with hands-on responsibility for product commercialization. 

What you’ll do: 

  • Own go-to-market plans: Define target customers, sales motions, market sequencing and launch priorities for on-top products. Drive execution against clear milestones and responsibilities.

  • Manage commercial performance: Agree KPIs, targets and reporting requirements before launch. Analyze adoption, usage, sales conversion and revenue contribution to identify what drives or limits growth. 
  • Turn performance insights into improvements: Lead structured performance reviews and coordinate action plans with clear owners and timelines, escalating unresolved dependencies where needed. 
  • Strengthen commercialization practices: Develop reusable business case and performance-management frameworks, capture lessons learned and ensure a clear handover to ongoing owners. 

What you’ll bring: 

  • 4+ years of experience in management consulting, commercial strategy, sales strategy and operations, or a similarly analytical business role. 
  • Experience building business cases, financial models and performance analyses, with the ability to test assumptions and explain their business implications. 
  • A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from recommendation through implementation, ideally involving product launches or commercial growth. 
  • Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of how customer value, pricing and sales execution translate into adoption and revenue. 
  • The ability to structure complex problems, present clear recommendations and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

We are moving away from siloed analyst roles and building interdisciplinary data teams where AI, specifically Claude, handles the heavy lifting of routine analysis, freeing analysts to focus on judgment, framing, and impact.

As a Senior Data Analyst (f/m/x), you will operate as a generalist across product, commercial, and financial questions, using Claude and Databricks daily rather than as an occasional tool, and you will grow alongside the team as it evolves toward deeper data engineering and ML capability. How We Win

title: Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling
descriptionHtml:
Senior Data Scientist - Credit Risk Modelling

Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

As a Senior Data Scientist in Credit Risk Modelling, you'll own credit risk and CLtV projects end to end – from spotting where the models hold the business back to getting the change live. The work ranges from keeping today's models accurate as conditions change, through incremental improvements, to research that could replace them.

You'll decide which problems to take on and how to solve them. With AI making prototyping cheap, more of the role now goes on research. You'll review other data scientists' modelling choices and coach newer members of the team.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Estimating the causal effect of amount, duration, and price on customer outcomes.

  • Unifying automated and manual models. Finding a principled way to put the two model families, which optimise slightly different objectives, on a common cost function.

  • IFRS accounting model. Developing a multi-stage model where recovery predictions feed back to improve the upfront loss estimates that International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) require.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Exploring whether a single, more general model could replace the separate credit and CLtV models.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Applied statistics. You have a background in statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, or similar. You've applied it to commercial problems for several years, and chosen the methods yourself. You know when the data breaks a method's assumptions, and what that does to your answer.

  • Probabilistic reasoning. You quantify the uncertainty in each estimate, and treat calibration as a first-order concern.

  • Production ML. You've built supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere.

  • Project leadership. You've led modelling projects you spotted yourself, from framing the question to a decision the business acted on. Some of that work changed how a team models a problem.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it, and built tools or workflows your colleagues now use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You've worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Coaching. You've helped other data scientists improve their work, through review or mentoring.

  • Non-linear methods. You can think in terms of the cost function and inductive biases of your models.

  • Bayesian methods. You've used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You've modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Coding. You can write code for analysis. The team works in Python.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £130,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM

Relay is a marketplace for delivery work. Every day, 400,000 parcels move through our network, carried by couriers who choose when and how they work, across four marketplaces, each with its own app and its own economics.

When we offer a courier work, the price is part of the offer. Price it too low and routes go unserved; price it too high and the network pays for capacity it didn't need. Science at Relay brings operational research, machine learning, causal inference and economics together to optimise the whole network rather than one decision at a time. Economics decides what the work is worth.

Marketplace Highlights

  • Four marketplaces, four apps, each with its own economics.

  • A live, two-sided marketplace where couriers choose their work, with every decision logged across millions of parcels.

  • Interference between couriers, heterogeneous effects and long-run behaviour are the norm, not the exception.

  • Prices sit inside recommendations and network-wide optimisation, so economics, personalisation and operational research have to work as one.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Economist at Relay, you'll:

  • Own courier pricing and pay policy: how work is priced, how couriers are paid, and how incentives are set across our marketplaces.

  • Apply economic theory to a live marketplace: model supply, demand and courier behaviour, and design pricing and incentive mechanisms that hold up in the real network.

  • Measure what every pricing and pay change did, working with our Applied Scientists and experimenting across a live two-sided marketplace.

  • Partner with Operational Research and Recommender Systems so price is set as part of the recommendation, not after it.

  • Advise leadership on pricing and incentives, and help build Relay's research culture and voice in the tech community.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have a PhD in economics, and have applied it in a tech marketplace such as ride-hailing, delivery or a gig platform.

  • Have advised leadership on pricing or incentive decisions, and seen those decisions through to what happened next.

  • Are deeply skilled in econometrics and causal inference, and know how to apply economic theory to a real marketplace, not just a model of one.

  • Are hands-on: you write the code, run the analysis and build the models yourself.

  • Explain economics clearly to operations, product and leadership, without the jargon.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

descriptionHtml:

⭐ About our Financial Crime & Fraud Team:

Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Senior Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.

As a Senior Fraud Investigator, you will be part of the Prevent pillar which provides vital intervention and education to Monzo customers who are experiencing potential active fraud attempts on their funds across two main channels:

  • Authorised card payment fraud
  • Authorised faster payment fraud

Your day to day; 

Senior Fraud Investigators in our Prevent pillar support the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar by answering escalations, supporting operational changes, and speaking to our customers who are at potential risk of the most complex scams. We’re looking for investigators with in-depth knowledge of cryptocurrency and understanding of how this can be used by fraudsters across a range of typologies as we continue to develop and optimise our controls. This means you can complete a complex investigation from start to finish for our customers and provide clear feedback to our teams as we work together to become the most trusted bank in the UK. 

Specific responsibilities include: 

  • Gathering evidence from flagged transaction data 
  • Use of Monzo’s values to investigate the nature of suspicious transactions with empathy and attention to detail.
  • Use of Monzo’s values to reassure and support customers through the process of identifying active fraud.
  • Independently making decisions on cases and releasing or blocking flagged transactions up to a case value of £59,999.00.
  • Submitting accounts for closure where first party concerns are held following investigation (in line with relevant guidance).
  • Triaging cases with a value of more than £59,999.00 for upwards escalation
  • Safeguarding compromised accounts and taking appropriate remedial action to ensure customers can resume safe usage of their Monzo account.
  • Providing advice and support to victims of fraud on how they can protect themselves in the future.
  • Handling non-FOS complaints and feeding back to Investigators and their managers where required as part of our continuous improvement feedback loop.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…

  • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements in fraud and/or financial crime
  • A strong knowledge of cryptocurrency and how this is used in fraud typologies 
  • Excellent English written & verbal communication skills and experience speaking to victims of potential fraud
  • Ability to be persuasive and empathetic
  • Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making
  • Ability to work well independently & be collaborative with the wider team
  • Ability to work to deadlines
  • Values driven approach in line with Monzo’s core values

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £31,100 - £39,350 ➕ Incentive Awards tied to your performance 

📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given MacBooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits

  • Some initial application questions (please take your time, we read these carefully!)
  • A short call with a Recruiter
  • A remote interview, lasting approximately 1 hour with two team members from the Fraud Team.

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!
