Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

As Senior Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you’ll lead, coach and develop a team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers in the UK. You’ll own team-level commercial performance, improve sales execution and build a predictable, data-driven revenue engine through disciplined pipeline management, forecasting and deal coaching. This is a hands-on player-coach role where you’ll support complex opportunities, develop Account Executive capability, strengthen outbound motions with Sales Development and Marketing, and help shape the UK go-to-market strategy. You’ll work closely with Product, Account Management, Revenue Strategy & Operations, GTM Partnerships and other regional stakeholders to turn customer and market insight into growth.

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of 10 Account Executives serving SME and mid-market customers, setting clear expectations for customer engagement, pipeline quality, sales execution and revenue delivery.

  • Run a consistent sales operating rhythm through regular one-to-ones, call coaching, deal strategy sessions, live opportunity reviews, pipeline reviews, forecast reviews and quarterly business reviews.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Strong practical knowledge of MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPICED, Challenger or an equivalent sales methodology, with the ability to train, inspect and reinforce its use across a team.

  • Strong commercial judgement, including experience managing pipeline, inspecting opportunities, forecasting accurately and maintaining disciplined CRM standards.

  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and performance-manage Account Executives, including providing clear feedback and addressing under-performance fairly and effectively.

  • Experience in high-growth technology, fintech, payments or financial services, together with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Preferred

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You take feedback well and actively seek it. You see it as a tool, not a criticism.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You value in-person collaboration and are happy being in the office three days a week.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

title: Senior Scrum Master
descriptionHtml:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Senior Scrum Master to join our team in London. Our products help the world's top teams and athletes perform at their best. We need an experienced Agile leader to help the squads building them do the same.

As a Senior ScrumMaster, you'll:

  • Coach the system, not just the team. You'll guide squads toward high autonomy while focusing on broader organizational design issues, such as resolving friction across business units, managing dependencies, and establishing scaling patterns.
  • Architect outcomes, not processes. You'll move fluidly across frameworks, adapting events to what the team needs to deliver value. You will act as an outcome architect, designing information flow and decision rhythms rather than functioning as a framework fundamentalist.
  • Anticipate, not react. You'll utilize predictive delivery intelligence and cross-team dependency mapping to resolve impediments before they surface, keeping coordination moving in the right direction even as the pace of delivery accelerates.
  • Foster psychological safety. You'll build environments where candor is safe, failure is treated as a data point, and conflict is constructive. You'll ensure teams feel secure enough to take on hard problems and navigate the shifting dynamics brought on by AI-assisted development.
  • Align and design for visibility. You'll map value streams to see where decisions stall and design cross-BU communication layers. You will maintain the signal through the noise, ensuring stakeholders know what's changed and what decisions are needed.

Location

Time spent collaborating with your teammates in-office will be a regular part of how you work. We're currently considering applicants within commuting distance of our London office. You'll be expected to work more days in-office than remote, but will have the freedom to coordinate your specific in-office schedule with your team.

Must-Haves

  • An experienced Agile practitioner. You have three or more years as a Scrum Master and have guided squads to improved, sustainable results and can scale your coaching capacity to influence broader organizational maturity.
  • A systems thinker. You see beyond the squad level, actively identifying and breaking down siloed organizational designs to reduce friction and eliminate duplicated efforts across Business Units.
  • Data-driven and predictive. You know how to use both qualitative and quantitative signals to establish predictive metrics that forecast delivery risk and guide investment decisions.
  • A clear communicator. You design lightweight operating guardrails and information flows that keep dependencies transparent and align stakeholders at every level without creating overhead that slows teams down.
  • A champion of responsible speed. You optimize for quality, anticipated dependencies, commitments kept, and team sustainability, ensuring that the speed of code generation never outpaces our coordination speed.

Nice-to-Haves

  • AI fluency. You have an interest in or experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI-powered agile tools, such as automated bottleneck detection or real-time sentiment and health monitoring.
  • A diverse Agile toolbelt. You're familiar with multiple frameworks (Kanban, Lean, SAFe, etc) and know when and how to blend them for better outcomes.
  • Global team experience. Our product teams span the U.S. and Europe, and you're comfortable collaborating across time zones and cultures.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We'll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time above any required statutory leave, company-wide holidays, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too. Plus, every five years, we give you a paid sabbatical to unplug and recharge.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you'll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We're lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We'll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you're at the office or working remotely, we'll provide you the tech you need to do your best work.
  • Support your wellbeing. Depending on location, we offer medical and retirement benefits for employees—but no matter where you're located, we have resources like our Employee Assistance Program and employee resource groups to support your mental health.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices. 

This role will also be eligible for a long-term incentive (LTI) award. Any bonuses awarded are based on individual and company performance paid at Hudl's discretion.

title: Senior Security Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

What you'll be doing
This role does the hands-on architecture work. You design the secure patterns engineering builds against, review hard problems in depth, and help make secure-by-design real across the Hyperblock and Polaris platform and the AI product surface. You work closely with the Principal Security Architect, who sets the technical bar. You own significant areas of that work and deliver them end to end. Engineers adopt good architecture because it is the better path. You will build that kind of architecture, working on problems that carry real risk.

Anaplan is not a simple SaaS application. The platform performs highly dimensional, enterprise-scale modelling with responsive recalculation and strong correctness expectations. The technical surface includes the legacy Hyperblock engine, the newer Polaris engine, and a growing set of AI products. These include CoModeler for AI-assisted model building and CoPlanner for conversational planning support.

Enterprise customers in regulated industries increasingly ask a hard question: if Anaplan is breached, can Anaplan staff or an attacker read their data? Answering it takes rigorous architecture work. We are commissioning an independent Trail of Bits assessment of exactly this. It covers end-to-end tenant isolation, the proposed BYOK design, and internal infrastructure boundaries. You will help turn findings like these into concrete design changes. That includes moving key management from legacy HSM-based designs to Vault, and extending encryption coverage to storage and data paths that lack an agreed architecture today.

What you'll do
• Produce reference architectures: design and maintain security patterns for platform and AI components, working to the standards set by the Principal.
• Contribute to identity and authorisation design: including tenant isolation, service-to-service trust, and authorisation for AI agents and analyst-style workflows.
• Apply cryptography and key management: work on encryption, BYOK and key custody. Be clear about where data is plaintext, who can use keys, and what each control protects against.
• Design AI guardrails: input and output controls, tool and authorisation boundaries, and prompt-injection and abuse defences. Draw on MITRE ATLAS and the OWASP LLM Top 10.
• Run threat models: lead them on high-risk systems, working with engineers to trace trust boundaries and compromise paths. Turn the findings into prioritised, actionable design changes.
• Support external assessments: prepare architecture evidence, join discovery sessions with engineering, and check that what is built matches what is documented.
• Improve the supply chain and attack surface: build integrity and provenance, hardened images, and less exposed surface.
• Stay hands-on: write and review designs and prototypes, and test your own work.
• Grow the practice: mentor engineers, contribute to standards, and help turn design decisions into enforceable guidance.

What we're looking for
• Solid experience in secure software architecture, with depth in at least two of: cryptography and key management, identity and authorisation, tenant isolation, and threat modelling.
• A working understanding of AI and ML security, and of how LLM-driven features change identity, authorisation, supply chain, and verification.
• The ability to design and review real systems, and to defend your decisions to strong engineers.
• A record of influencing engineers without formal authority, including when risk and delivery pressure conflict.
• Experience with enterprise-scale SaaS or cloud-first systems, ideally multi-tenant.
• Clear written and verbal communication. You can explain architecture honestly to engineers, leadership, and customers.

Nice to have
• Experience with Vault, KMS/HSM, or BYOK/HYOK designs.
• Experience designing for regulated environments, such as FedRAMP.
• Contributions to NIST, ISO, or OWASP, or talks and published research.
• An offensive grounding that you use to pressure-test designs.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! 

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer  

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.  

Anaplan does not:  

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.   
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.  

All emails from Anaplan would come from an ----- email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to ----- before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   

Privacy & AI Notice

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

About the Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be the primary software point of contact for the Laser team and provide technical leadership across software, hardware, and experimental-system interfaces. You will help define the architecture and technology direction for a greenfield laser-software platform while remaining hands-on in developing reliable tools for calibration, operation, human-machine interaction, and experimental data processing.

This role offers the opportunity to work across software, hardware, and experimental-system boundaries while contributing to a strong engineering culture within the Darmstadt Software Department. You will help shape technical direction, establish the foundations of a new software platform, and grow toward a broader technical leadership role. The position does not initially include direct people-management responsibility.

What You’ll Do

  • Act as the primary software partner for the Laser team and coordinate software activities across laser projects.

  • Provide technical leadership for software initiatives, including planning, technical alignment, risk identification, and coordination with laser physicists, engineers, and systems-integration partners.

  • Help define the architecture, technology choices, development practices, and interfaces for a new laser-software platform in a greenfield environment.

  • Design and implement reliable software for critical laser projects, from system-level interfaces to user-facing applications.

  • Develop and maintain automated calibration software that improves repeatability, reduces manual effort, and supports reliable laser operation.

  • Design and build clear, dependable human-machine interfaces, dashboards, and operational tools for monitoring and operating laser systems.

  • Develop software that interfaces with laser devices, diagnostic systems, cameras, and experimental equipment to support data acquisition, system monitoring, operational control, and visualization.

  • Develop data-processing pipelines and data-storage solutions for experimental and operational data, including diagnostic and camera data where appropriate.

  • Define robust interfaces between software, hardware, cameras, and experimental systems in an environment where requirements and technologies are still evolving.

  • Work with networked device and system interfaces, potentially including TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable communication technologies.

  • Write automated tests, technical documentation, and operational guidance to support long-term maintainability and safe, reliable operation.

  • Identify and address reliability, performance, integration, debugging, and maintenance risks in software that interacts with real-world systems.

  • Contribute to technical design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing across the Software Department.

  • Mentor engineers and help establish engineering practices as the software team grows.

Who You Are

  • You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous technical problems and building systems from the ground up.

  • You are comfortable taking ownership of technical direction while collaborating closely with software specialists, laser physicists, experimental experts, and systems-integration partners.

  • You can move effectively between technical leadership, project coordination, architecture, and hands-on implementation.

  • You take ownership of the quality, reliability, testability, and long-term maintainability of the systems you build.

  • You communicate clearly with both software specialists and technical partners from adjacent disciplines.

  • You apply sound technical judgment when making design, implementation, and technology-selection decisions in an evolving environment.

  • You are curious, adaptable, and motivated to understand how software interacts with hardware, cameras, diagnostics, and experimental systems.

  • You are experienced in debugging and testing complex software and understand their importance in senior-level engineering work.

  • You value constructive feedback, knowledge sharing, and mentoring other engineers.

  • You are interested in developing toward technical leadership and project ownership. Formal people-management responsibility is not required at the outset.

Desirable Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong programming experience in C++, Python, or comparable programming languages.

  • Experience designing, implementing, testing, debugging, and maintaining complex software systems.

  • Knowledge of software architecture, code review practices, automated testing, technical documentation, and engineering best practices.

  • Experience with greenfield development, platform or architecture definition, and making technology choices where requirements are still evolving.

  • Experience with automated calibration, control-adjacent software, laboratory systems, automation, or physical-device interfaces.

  • Experience developing human-machine interfaces, dashboards, or software for operating technical equipment.

  • Experience with camera integration, image processing, diagnostic data, or experimental data-processing pipelines.

  • Experience developing data-storage solutions for high-volume, time-series, experimental, or operational data.

  • Familiarity with software-hardware integration and working across experimental-system boundaries.

  • Experience with networked device communication or system interfaces, such as TCP/IP, REST APIs, webhooks, DDS, SCADA, or comparable technologies.

  • Familiarity with control systems or optics is beneficial, but not required; the ability to learn and collaborate across these disciplines is more important.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Platform (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

You will join an engineering squad in our Berlin office working on distributed systems and platform infrastructure. Our products serve analytics engineers and business teams across the company, but this is primarily a systems engineering role (roughly 75% core software systems engineering, 25% data architecture). We value engineering depth: we build internal distributed solutions and understand the runtimes underneath, rather than only orchestrating managed tools.

As a Senior Software Engineer you will shape the architecture of our low-level infrastructure, orchestration frameworks and storage engines. You will lead technical design, resolve systemic bottlenecks in compute and streaming layers, and mentor engineers across squads, working with colleagues in Berlin, the US and Latin America.

What you will do

  • Design and build core low-level services and distributed runtimes for Nubank’s global data platform, with high fault tolerance, elastic scale and sub-second event availability.

  • Lead the design of compute orchestration frameworks on large Kubernetes clusters, improving scheduling throughput and resource utilization for complex data pipelines.

  • Design and optimize high-throughput streaming and storage architectures using Apache Kafka and distributed database internals for mission-critical financial workloads.

  • Find and remove performance, network and storage bottlenecks across the infrastructure stack to reduce latency.

  • Work with Analytics Engineering leads and platform users to define internal APIs, developer toolchains and data modeling practices that speed up developers company-wide.

  • Set standards for resilience testing, automated failover, observability and architectural documentation.

What you bring

  • Substantial experience designing, scaling and operating mission-critical distributed systems and backend architectures in high-throughput production environments.

  • Strong practical knowledge of container orchestration and systems management at scale, ideally Kubernetes internals and custom controllers or operators.

  • Advanced proficiency in a systems-oriented language such as Go, Java, Scala, Rust or C++.

  • Experience with database system architecture (storage engines, indexing, replication) and/or event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka.

  • A track record of technical leadership: writing design proposals, aligning teams on complex technical decisions, and mentoring engineers.

Nice to have

  • Experience building internal developer platforms, custom compute engines or low-level database products.

  • Experience with data platforms or compute runtimes that support production AI/ML training and inference.

descriptionHtml:

AWS

  • AWS Lambda: designing event-driven, serverless functions triggered from API Gateway, S3, SQS or EventBridge, including running Java on Lambda and reducing cold starts (for example with SnapStart)

Experience with the following would be advantageous:

  • Python, Next.js, Spring Cloud, WebFlux or reactive programming
  • Amazon Bedrock: integrating foundation models into applications, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (Knowledge Bases) and guardrails
  • Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: building, deploying and running AI agents in production, including runtime, memory, tool integration and observability
  • Amazon SageMaker: deploying, hosting or integrating machine learning models into applications
  • Snowflake or Databricks: building data integrations between AWS services and modern data platforms

What you'll be doing:

As a Senior Software Engineer - Java, React & AWS, you will:

  • Design, build and maintain scalable, secure and resilient applications, from backend services using modern Java and the Spring ecosystem to responsive, accessible front ends built with React.

  • Lead technical design and architectural discussions, ensuring solutions are maintainable, performant and aligned with best practices.
  • Develop and evolve RESTful APIs with a focus on security, versioning, performance and reliability, and integrate them seamlessly with React applications.
  • Champion engineering excellence through clean code, automated testing, documentation and code reviews.
  • Drive delivery across multiple initiatives while balancing speed, quality and commercial value.
  • Mentor engineers through coaching, pairing and constructive feedback, helping raise capability across the team.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve problems together and deliver outstanding outcomes for clients.
  • Research and evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks and AI capabilities that improve how we build software.
  • Promote automation wherever possible, removing repetitive work so teams can focus on solving meaningful problems.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, innovation and technical excellence.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll demonstrate:

Technical Excellence & Craft Mastery

  • Write clean, maintainable and highly optimised code.
  • Set high standards for quality, testing and documentation.
  • Coach others in engineering best practices and modern development techniques.

Architectural Leadership

  • Design scalable, resilient and secure systems, making informed trade-offs between serverless, containerised and managed AWS services.
  • Make thoughtful architectural decisions that support long-term maintainability.
  • Evaluate new technologies and guide adoption where they add value.

Commercial Delivery

  • Lead projects from discovery through delivery.
  • Understand client challenges and translate them into practical technical solutions.
  • Deliver outcomes that create measurable business value.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Lead engineering ceremonies and facilitate productive technical discussions.

  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Foster an environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

AI & Innovation

    • Explore and implement AI-driven approaches that improve engineering efficiency.
    • Champion responsible adoption of AI across delivery teams.
    • Help shape our engineering practices for the future.

What we’ll offer you:

We trust people to do their best work. That means flexibility over rigid rules, impact over activity, and real investment in your growth both professionally and personally. You’ll be part of a supportive, and friendly culture, surrounded by smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do.

We offer flexible working, including hybrid and remote options. Our office hubs are located in Edinburgh, Leeds, Manchester, London and Bulgaria, with occasional travel to client sites or CreateFuture offices when needed.

We trust you to manage your time balancing collaboration with client time and focused work. What matters is the impact you have, not how busy you look.

We try to keep our hiring process clear, fair and respectful of your time. We aim to get back to everyone who applies and we will be upfront about where you are in the process.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Roku UI
descriptionHtml:
Teamwork makes the stream work.

Roku is changing how the world watches TV

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

What does the team work on?

At Roku, the UI team builds the foundational frameworks, tooling, and high-performance UI components that power experiences across millions of devices. We own the middleware and UI layers that enable smooth navigation, responsive interactions, rich animations, and consistent developer workflows across the platform.

Our work spans graphics rendering, layout and animation systems, performance optimization, and developer APIs that make it easy to create reliable, visually compelling applications at scale. We operate in a collaborative, high-trust environment and partner closely with firmware, platform, and product teams to ensure the end-to-end experience is fast, robust, and future-ready.

What is the role?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the UI team, you'll design, implement, and optimize systems that underpin Roku's user experience and developer platform. You'll work on performance-critical code paths across graphics rendering, animation, layout, and UI frameworks, ensuring smooth visuals and highly responsive interactions across a wide range of devices.

At Roku, AI agents do most of the keystroke-level coding. Engineers act as the technical leads for those agents — setting context, planning work, verifying outputs, and recovering when the agent goes off course. You'll play a key role in shaping core architecture, working across the stack with hardware, firmware, and application teams, and delivering solutions that directly impact tens of millions of users. This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy deep technical problem-solving, care about performance at a systems level, want to build the foundational layers that power great user experiences — and are energized by the shift to agentic engineering. If you are excited about working this way, we want to talk to you.

How will I use AI at Roku?

At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 
We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.

What are the responsibilities of the role?

  • Build and scale UI frameworks and features optimized for millions of users
  • Design and implement performance-critical systems across rendering pipelines, layout engines, and animation frameworks using C++
  • Drive work through agentic coding tools — setting context, planning, and verifying agent-generated output across the full SDLC
  • Develop and maintain developer-facing tools and UI layers
  • Lead technical investigations and architect solutions across middleware and UI infrastructure
  • Integrate AI/ML and generative AI capabilities into developer workflows and platform features
  • Establish verification practices — testing, review, and quality gates — that let the team operate confidently on AI-assisted work
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver platform features with measurable gains in performance, reliability, and scalability
  • Create tooling, frameworks, and automation that improve developer efficiency and code quality
  • Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance — including how to effectively drive and verify AI agents
  • Stay current with advancements in graphics, UI systems, and AI, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement

What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on UI frameworks, systems, or application development
  • Strong proficiency in C++ for performance-critical systems and rendering pipelines
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript for building UI layers and developer-facing tooling
  • Experience with JavaScript/BrightScript or similar scripting languages
  • Proficiency in Python for tooling, automation, or AI workflows
  • Demonstrated fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks — with projects where you've shipped real work using these tools
  • The ability to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you
  • A working understanding of common AI failure modes and the habits to catch them before they ship
  • Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML and generative AI tools into development workflows or product features
  • Solid understanding of graphics systems, rendering, or UI performance optimization
  • Strong debugging and root cause analysis skills
  • Clear and effective technical communication skills
  • You can describe specific examples where you used AI tools, agents, or workflow automation to move faster, raise quality, or scale your impact. You frame problems well, guide AI-assisted work, verify results, and ramp quickly in unfamiliar domains
  • Above all: curiosity, adaptability, good judgment, and a genuine willingness to learn new ways of working alongside AI
#LI-NM1

What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

What are some of the benefits?

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

Accommodations

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to  

What should I know about Roku's culture?

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer (Integrations)
descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will deliver fast, reliable, API-driven integrations for our largest customers by translating business workflows into scalable, repeatable technical solutions. You will partner closely with Sales and Customer Success to deliver best-in-class integration experiences that drive adoption and long-term success. This role is primarily customer-facing, with a strong focus on solution design and customer outcomes rather than traditional software development. You'll build integrations primarily with low-code tools, using light scripting where needed.

What You’ll Do

  • Independently design, build, and deliver complex, scalable, and secure integrations between Choco and customer systems using low-code tools (e.g. n8n and Tray.ai).

  • Own complex and strategic integration projects end-to-end, from technical discovery and solution architecture to go-live, ensuring quality, scalability, and long-term reliability.

  • Partner with Account Executives in pre-sales by leading technical discovery, proofs of concept, and integration scoping, advising on feasibility and solution design for complex customer requirements.

  • Act as a technical escalation point, troubleshooting critical integration issues, proactively identifying risks, and driving sustainable solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with Customer Success, Implementation, and Product teams, providing technical guidance, documenting integration designs, and influencing product improvements based on customer needs.

  • Mentor junior Solutions Engineers, providing technical guidance, sharing expertise, and supporting their development through complex projects.

  • Drive continuous improvement of integration architecture, processes, and best practices to increase delivery efficiency, quality, and scalability globally.

  • Independently make technical and architectural decisions within complex projects, escalating only major strategic decisions requiring broader alignment.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in solutions engineering, IT/ERP consulting, or systems integration.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience managing end-to-end API integrations, including requirements gathering, solution design, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support across multiple customer environments.

  • Experience with low-code or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, and Tray.ai.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a collaborative, solution-focused mindset.

  • Excellent communicator with the ability to make complex ideas clear and simple.

  • This position requires in-office attendance 3 days per week in our Paris office.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with the ERP or ordering systems common among food and beverage distributors.

  • Background in food distribution, supply chain, or B2B SaaS.

  • Comfort using AI tools to speed up discovery, documentation, and integration builds.

What you get

  • Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

  • Work with an AI product with proven product–market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

  • Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

  • In return, you get real ownership, equity, and the support to do your best work, including competitive compensation, health and wellbeing support, and long-term benefits like a sabbatical (all localized by office).

  • Collaborate with people who want to own outcomes in a messy, real-world system and make it work at scale.

If you want to work on real problems, take ownership, and raise the bar, we should talk.

Choco is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to ensuring that our technology is available and accessible to everyone. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Our Tech Stack:

  • Java, Spring Boot and JOOQ to build the RESTful APIs of our microservices (but we welcome people who are used to any strongly typed general purpose programming language!)
  • Event-driven architecture with messages over SNS+SQS and Kafka to make them reliable
  • Primary datastores are MySQL and PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora (we are heavy AWS users)

title: Senior Test Manager (m/w/d) Teststrategie, QA & IT Consulting
descriptionHtml:
Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität nicht dem Zufall überlassen wird.

Testmanagement bedeutet für dich mehr als Testfälle zu verwalten und Statusberichte zu erstellen?

Du behältst auch in komplexen IT-Projekten den Überblick, entwickelst tragfähige Teststrategien und schaffst klare Strukturen für Teams, Stakeholder und Kunden.

Als Senior Test Manager bei NELTA übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Qualitätssicherung in anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten. Du entwickelst Teststrategien und Testkonzepte, koordinierst Testaktivitäten über verschiedene Testphasen hinweg und sorgst dafür, dass Risiken, Bugs und Qualitätsstatus transparent werden.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Programm Management, Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und bist für unsere Kunden ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner rund um Testing und Qualitätssicherung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und implementierst Teststrategien, Testkonzepte und Testpläne für agile IT-Projekte.

  • Du planst, koordinierst und überwachst Testaktivitäten über verschiedene Testphasen hinweg.

  • Du steuerst System-, Integrations- und Abnahmetests und behältst Abhängigkeiten und Risiken im Blick.

  • Du übernimmst das Stakeholder Management mit Programm Management, Product Ownern, Entwicklungsteams und weiteren Schnittstellen.

  • Du reviewst und optimierst funktionale Testfälle und unterstützt bei Bedarf auch bei manuellen GUI- und Oberflächentests.

  • Du bewertest Bugs, unterstützt bei der Priorisierung und verfolgst die Mängelbeseitigung konsequent.

  • Du schaffst Transparenz durch Testreportings, Statusberichte und Management-Präsentationen.

  • Du dokumentierst relevante Entscheidungen rund um Testumgebungen und Testarchitektur.

  • Du berätst Frontend- und Backend-Teams zu einer ganzheitlichen Qualitätssicherung.

  • Je nach Kundenprojekt arbeitest du unter anderem mit Tosca, XRay, Ranorex, Postman, SilkCentral Testmanager oder HP ALM.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung im Software Testing bzw. QA-Umfeld mit – idealerweise mindestens drei Jahre.

  • Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Testmanagement, Testmethoden, Testverfahren und entsprechenden Werkzeugen.

  • Du kannst Teststrategien und Testkonzepte nicht nur verstehen, sondern strukturiert in die Praxis überführen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit komplexen IT- bzw. Kundenprojekten und bewegst dich sicher zwischen technischen Teams und Business-Stakeholdern.

  • Du kommunizierst klar, kannst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammenbringen und besitzt die nötige Durchsetzungsfähigkeit, um Qualität konsequent einzufordern.

  • Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung – beispielsweise Certified Tester, Technical Test Analyst, Certified Agile Tester oder Advanced Level Testmanagement – ist ein Plus.

  • Du bist grundsätzlich bereit, für wichtige Termine und Projektphasen zu unseren Kunden innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau, da unsere Kundenprojekte überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Benefits

Das erwartet dich bei NELTA

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht einfach eine vorgegebene Teststrategie ab. Wir möchten, dass du deine Erfahrung einbringst, bestehende Vorgehensweisen hinterfragst und gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden Lösungen entwickelst, die wirklich funktionieren.

Dich erwarten unterschiedliche Kunden und Systemlandschaften, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein Team, in dem fachlicher Austausch ausdrücklich gewünscht ist.

Dazu kommen unter anderem flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Mentoring, Coaching und Weiterbildung, Wellpass, Job-Ticket, Corporate Benefits sowie unsere NELTA Bibliothek.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Für deine Bewerbung brauchen wir kein Anschreiben. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf sowie dein frühestmögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung.

Bewirb dich jetzt als Senior Test Manager bei NELTA und gestalte mit uns Qualität in anspruchsvollen IT-Projekten.

Standort: Kundenprojekt in Frankfurt am Main
Anstellung: Unbefristete Festanstellung
Arbeitszeit: Vollzeit

title: Senior transformatieconsultant
descriptionHtml:
0,8 tot 1 fte | Utrecht | Hybride | € 5.086 - € 7.800 | Transformatie van organisaties | Wo

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Grote veranderingen vragen om meer dan een goed plan. Ze vragen om iemand die mensen, belangen en expertise samenbrengt en ervoor zorgt dat er daadwerkelijk beweging ontstaat.

Als senior transformatieconsultant begeleid je complexe en vaak meerjarige veranderprogramma’s bij grote organisaties. Je werkt op het snijvlak van strategie en uitvoering, verbindt experts vanuit verschillende vakgebieden en helpt opdrachtgevers om het transitieproces met succes te implementeren.

Omdat ons team groeit, krijg je veel ruimte om mee te bouwen aan onze propositie én aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

Dit ga je doen

Je stuurt complexe transformatieprogramma’s aan

Een transformatieconsultant begeleidt organisaties bij fundamentele veranderingen die verder gaan dan een gewone reorganisatie of procesverbetering. Het doel is om de organisatie duurzaam anders te laten functioneren, zodat zij beter kan inspelen op nieuwe strategische uitdagingen.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse regie op omvangrijke verandertrajecten bij opdrachtgevers. Vaak gaat het om programma’s die meerdere jaren lopen en waarbij meerdere organisatieonderdelen betrokken zijn. Je bewaakt de samenhang tussen strategie, organisatie-inrichting, processen & technologie, hr-processen, organisatiedynamiek en leiderschap. Je zorgt ervoor dat verandering niet alleen wordt bedacht maar ook daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd.

Je verbindt mensen en expertise

De kracht van Berenschot zit in de combinatie van verschillende expertises. Afhankelijk van de opgave werk je samen met collega's op het gebied van organisatieontwikkeling, hr, leiderschap, cultuur, data-analyse, functiewaardering, bedrijfsvoering en collega’s uit specifieke sectoren. Denk daarbij aan openbaar bestuur, bedrijfsleven en energie & leefomgeving.

Jij brengt deze expertise samen rond één gezamenlijke ambitie. Je creëert structuur, houdt overzicht en zorgt ervoor dat mensen elkaar versterken en resultaten worden behaald.

Je bent een vertrouwde gesprekspartner voor bestuurders

Je werkt intensief samen met bestuurders, directeuren, programmateams en andere stakeholders. Je helpt hen keuzes te maken, creëert draagvlak en begeleidt besluitvorming in omgevingen waar verschillende belangen samenkomen.

Je durft richting te geven wanneer dat nodig is, maar begrijpt ook dat duurzame verandering begint met het meenemen van mensen.

Je bouwt mee aan de toekomst van het team Transformatie van organisaties

Naast je opdrachten draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van onze propositie. Je deelt kennis, ontwikkelt nieuwe aanpakken en begeleidt minder ervaren collega’s in hun professionele groei.

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je komt te werken binnen de adviesgroep Transformaties van organisaties. Vanuit verschillende expertisegebieden werken we samen aan complexe veranderopgaven bij onze klanten. Vaak gebeurt dit onder regie van een transformatiepartner of programmamanager.

Wij geloven dat duurzame verandering alleen lukt wanneer strategie, organisatiestructuur, processen, systemen, hr, cultuur en leiderschap in samenhang worden aangepakt. Daarom werken we nadrukkelijk multidisciplinair en zoeken we collega’s die energie krijgen van het verbinden van mensen, ideeën en expertise.

Je werkt regelmatig zelfstandig bij de klant, maar bent nooit alleen. Achter je staat een sterk netwerk van collega’s dat je kunt inzetten wanneer een vraagstuk daarom vraagt. Juist die combinatie van zelfstandigheid, samenwerking en maatschappelijke impact maakt dit werk zo bijzonder.


Dit neem je mee

  • Een academisch werk- en denkniveau.

  • Minimaal zes jaar ervaring met complexe verander-, transformatie- of reorganisatietrajecten, bijvoorbeeld als programmamanager, verandermanager of transformatieconsultant.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van omvangrijke programma’s binnen complexe organisaties en stakeholderomgevingen.

  • Het vermogen om verschillende expertises, belangen en mensen samen te brengen rond een gezamenlijke opgave.

  • Ondernemerschap en gevoel voor kansen in de markt. Je bouwt graag aan klantrelaties en duurzame samenwerkingen.

  • Verbindend leiderschap en een uitmuntend teamplayerschap. Je brengt rust, overzicht en vertrouwen, ook wanneer de omgeving dynamisch of politiek gevoelig is.

  • Nieuwsgierigheid en de ambitie om jezelf continu te blijven ontwikkelen.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke commerciële omgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners. Dit geeft ons veel ruimte en vrijheid om te ondernemen en de mogelijkheid om ons in te zetten voor belangrijke maatschappelijke thema’s. Kenmerkend is onze informele cultuur. Berenschot is een platte organisatie met korte communicatielijnen waar echt naar je geluisterd wordt. Er zijn volop mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele groei, waarbij jouw initiatief wordt omarmd en gefaciliteerd. Je hebt hier de vrijheid om te ondernemen. Ons diverse en inclusieve personeelsbeleid omarmt diversiteit en biedt iedereen gelijke kansen.

Natuurlijk hebben we daarnaast ook uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en geweldige ontwikkelmogelijkheden:

  • een jaarcontract, met de absolute intentie om je na één jaar een contract voor onbepaalde tijd aan te bieden

  • een aantrekkelijk salaris tussen de € 5.086– en € 7.800,–, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring

  • een representatievergoeding van € 3.000,- per jaar

  • een reguliere collectieve winstdelingsregeling (afhankelijk van het resultaat van de onderneming)

  • een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling

  • 27 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid om bij een fulltime dienstverband maximaal 20 vakantiedagen bij te kopen

  • flexibele feestdagen. We bieden de mogelijkheid om officiële feestdagen te verschuiven naar dagen die voor jou van betekenis zijn.

  • een mobiliteitsregeling naar keuze: een auto van de zaak of een mobiliteitsbudget

  • een laptop en telefoon

  • de vrijheid om, in afstemming met je collega’s, te bepalen waar en wanneer je werkt

  • volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling via interne én externe opleidingen

Solliciteer meteen

Krijg jij energie van het begeleiden van complexe organisatieveranderingen? Vind je het leuk om mensen, expertise en belangen samen te brengen en langdurig samen te werken met klanten aan duurzame resultaten? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Heb je vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Vicky Schats via ----- style="min-height: 1.7em;">

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Heb je gesolliciteerd? Dan ontvang je binnen één werkweek een reactie. Is die positief? Dan nodigen we je graag uit voor een kennismaking. Zijn we na dit gesprek allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een gesprek met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Dat is het moment om jouw laatste vragen te stellen.

Gaan die gesprekken goed? Dan vragen we je om een assessment te maken. Blijkt daaruit dat jij goed past bij Berenschot en onze manier van werken? Dan doen we je graag een passend aanbod.

Hierna ben je een echte Berenschotter en heten we je van harte welkom in ons team.

title: (Senior ) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our (Senior) Verification Engineer, Functional Safety (m/f/d), you build and run the verification process that proves our safety controller and the safety software on our robots do what the safety requirements say, release after release. You own the evidence that our certification body reviews. If something is broken, you fix it. If something can be automated, you build it.

You will join the Safety & Compliance team in Munich, which is developing a new safety controller in-house while keeping the safety-software system on our robots today certified and moving forward. Verification has not had a dedicated owner so far, so you create the structure, the catalog and the process rather than only executing an existing one. You work daily with the safety (software) engineers and with TÜV to define what must be verified. Early on, you set up and prove the verification system for the current system, and you then carry it into the certification of the new controller.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the verification of our new safety controller end to end, from the verification plan to the certification evidence (target PL d per ISO 13849-1:2023 and SIL 2 per IEC 61508)

  • Build the complete verification catalog and set up the verification process and structure from scratch

  • Verify the safety software at unit and integration level with automated tests including fault and robustness cases, structural coverage, static analysis, and code and requirement reviews

  • Automate verification so that it runs on every change

  • Verify the controller and its safety functions as part of the robot arm against ISO 10218-1:2025

  • Keep traceability from risk assessment to test results and write reports that hold up in an audit

  • Work closely with the safety (software) engineers and TÜV to define what must be verified

  • Review the verification work of your colleagues and share your practices with the team

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A degree in a technical field such as software, electrical or mechanical engineering, or equivalent experience

  • 3+ years of experience verifying or testing safety-critical embedded systems in industrial automation, automotive, rail, aerospace or medical devices

  • Enough embedded C to write white-box tests and to find defects in a code review

  • Working knowledge of IEC 61508-3 or its industry counterpart (ISO 26262-6, EN 50716, DO-178C) and the verification evidence it requires

  • Hands-on lab skills with oscilloscope, logic analyser and debugger, including measuring a reaction time you can defend

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with EtherCAT and Safety over EtherCAT (FSoE) or another safety protocol such as PROFIsafe or CIP Safety is a plus

    • Experience with ISO 10218-1:2025, ISO 13849-1:2023 or IEC 62061, HIL tooling, coverage and static analysis tools (e.g. VectorCAST, TESSY, LDRA, Polyspace), MISRA C, robot kinematics, or working with a certification body such as TÜV is a plus

    • Clear technical writing and fluent English (C1+); German is a plus

How you'll make an impact

  • You drive complex, ambiguous work to clear outcomes and raise the quality of your colleagues' work through review and mentorship.

  • You translate goals into plans independently, identify improvements to processes and tooling, and make most decisions in your area.

  • You bring specialized expertise and cross-functional knowledge, and solve complex problems with strong analytical and contextual judgment.

Why join RobCo?

  • Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

  • Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

  • As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

  • Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

  • Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

  • Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

  • Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that continuously learns and improves, requiring zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. In October 2026, RobCo reached unicorn status with a valuation exceeding one billion US dollars, with its valuation doubling in less than nine months. With $200M raised from investors including Sequoia, Lightspeed, Lingotto, Kindred, Cherry Ventures, and the European Tech Collective, 225+ people globally, and 3.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our Bay Area Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Site Associate - Editions Bermondsey
descriptionHtml:
Title: Site Associate (Part time)

Location: Bermondsey
Pay: £14.40 per hour

Hours: 20

 

About Deliveroo Editions

With a dash of hard-work, a sprinkle of teamwork and a whole dollop of creativity, we created “Editions” which is our ‘dark kitchens’ business. We have partnered with some fantastic restaurants such as Wagamama, Starbucks, Pho and Gourmet Burger Company to help further connect them with hungry customers.

Delivery-only kitchens have never been higher profile, or more valuable for improving service and selection for customers. Deliveroo Editions were the world's first delivery-only kitchens, and we are still the market leaders in helping our restaurant partners succeed. What’s even more exciting is that we’re expanding our portfolio further.

Great people help to drive our business forward and we are always looking for more to join our sites. If you don’t have the exact experience, that’s okay, we’d still love to hear from you.

Does this sound tasty to you? Take a look at our Site Associate role and apply below to join the Roo family.

About the role

The Site Associate role covers a wide range of tasks across the Editions site. You will ensure that the site is clean, support the wider operation of the site to ensure that our loyal customers receive their orders as quickly as possible from our trusted partners.

Responsibilities will include:

  • You will report into the Site Manager and the site management team.

  • Ensuring that the cleanliness of the site is maintained to a high standard by cleaning as you go throughout the shift as well as regular deep cleaning of various equipment throughout the week

  • Cleaning communal areas, such as staff room, bathrooms, stock rooms, maintaining site health and safety standards at all times

  • Working with the management team to ensure a safe and clean site by participating in regularly checking

  • Assisting with dispatching, which will include running food from our partners to the dispatch area, assisting with orders and communicating with our riders

  • Supporting our partners by keeping kitchen equipment clean and ready for use throughout the shift with the pot wash

Who we are looking for

  • You radiate positivity!

  • You have a great attitude to work, you are driven and have willingness to learn

  • You are a team player, punctuality and reliability is your forte

  • You always go above and beyond, you’re looking to progress in your career

  • You can work autonomously but you LOVE working with a fantastic team and with our partners

  • You like to solve problems, making recommendations on how to improve daily tasks

  • Previous experience in a Kitchen Porter or Kitchen Cleaner role is a bonus, but don’t worry if you haven’t, if you have the right attitude and drive, we can train you.

What to expect from the interview process

  • Step 1: apply for any role you'd like to be considered for - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Step 2: if your application is successful, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to say hello and understand more about your experience

  • Step 3: if we decide to progress your application, you will be invited to an onsite interview with one of the site managers

  • Step 4: We'll come back to you quickly after your interview to let you know the outcome!

Benefits

  • 25 days holiday, increases with length of service

  • Free food and LOTS of it

  • Access to Deliveroo Plus (no delivery fee on all orders)

  • Life assurance

  • Access to discounts in other companies via our benefits portal

  • Employee assistance programme

  • Company paid team meals and nights out

  • Online learning courses delivered by global universities

  • Clear career development path

Why Deliveroo


Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. . We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.
We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace and Diversity

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. We offer multiple great benefits in areas including health, family, finance, community, convenience, growth and relocation.

We believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest growing startups in an exciting space.

title: Software Engineer Fullstack Secteur Public - CDI Paris - Theodo GovTech
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Chez Theodo GovTech, nous accompagnons nos clients - ministères, collectivités territoriales et grands opérateurs publics - dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance de produits numériques accessibles, durables et utiles pour la société. Rejoindre notre aventure, c'est partager une ambition commune : utiliser le numérique pour augmenter l’efficacité de l'action publique et améliorer le quotidien des agents et des usagers.
Ton équipe : Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo GovTech, ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo GovTech :
  • Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement.
  • Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée.
  • Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement.
  • Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes
  • Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements
Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples :
  • France Identité : Dans le cadre du lancement de la carte grise numérique sur France Identité, wallet souverain piloté par l’ANTS et aligné avec eIDAS 2, Theodo a repris le développement mobile (iOS & Android) en natif dans un contexte de retards et de standards européens mouvants. Une équipe de 9 experts a structuré la delivery en sprints de 3 semaines et sécurisé les mises en production. Résultats en 2 mois : +350 000 cartes grises dématérialisées, +20 % de qualité technique et une cadence de livraison continue restaurée.
  • Ministère de l'Intérieur : Dans le cadre de la LOPMI et de la feuille de route interministérielle sur l’IA, le Ministère de l’Intérieur a lancé MIrAI pour industrialiser des produits d’IA utiles aux agents (transcription, rédaction, automatisation). Theodo a accompagné la structuration de l’organisation produit (vision, discovery, delivery) et la mise en production de FCR, outil d’aide à la génération automatique de comptes rendus. Une équipe de 7 experts (Lead PM, PO, Designer, Tech Lead, 3 Software Engineers) a posé les bases d’une véritable usine produit IA au sein de l’État, capable d’identifier, livrer et industrialiser rapidement de nouveaux cas d’usage.
Parmi les technos les plus représentées sur nos projets, tu pourras être amené à travailler avec : Java (Spring Boot), Angular, Node (Nest), React (Next), Python… Tes perspectives d'évolution : Notre ambition est de former les leaders de la tech de demain. Grâce au coaching et formations que l’on propose, tu pourras :
  • Devenir un expert en développement en étant formé aux meilleurs standards de qualité
  • Développer des compétences transverses : coaching, recrutement, commercial, management et marketing technique
  • Participer à des groupes d’expertises avec d’autres passionnés (Cybersécurité, Serverless, Performance, GreenIT…)
  • Construire ton parcours sur-mesure pour atteindre tes objectifs : tech lead, senior architecte, évangéliste (spécialiste d’un sujet), CTO ou fondateur d’une entité etc
Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : Nous recherchons avant tout des potentiels plus que des compétences déjà acquises. Si tu n’es pas encore un·e développeur·se chevronné·e, ce n’est pas un frein : ne te retiens pas pour postuler.
  • Tu es diplômé·e d’une top école d’ingénieur
  • Tu as entre 0 et 2 ans d'expérience
  • Tu aimes travailler en équipe et intéragir avec des profils et des métiers variés, en faisant preuve de pédagogie et d’esprit constructif (revues de code, pair programming)
  • Tu es orienté·e création de valeur : tu t’intéresses à l’activité du client et tu ne fais pas de la tech pour la tech
  • Tu es promoteur de l’IA, notamment sur les sujets de GenAI, et tu cherches à progresser en continu grâce à la veille technique
  • Tu fais preuve d’exigence sur la qualité du travail produit et sais questionner, voire interrompre, la chaîne de production lorsque nécessaire (#jidoka)
  • Tu aimes travailler de manière structurée et appliques naturellement des principes d’organisation et d’amélioration continue (inspirés du 5S)
  • Tu souhaites évoluer dans un environnement qui encourage au quotidien l’envie de progresser, l’esprit d’équipe et la prise d’initiative
Le processus de recrutement :
  • Un premier call de 30 minutes avec un recruteur
  • Un échange d’une heure avec le même recruteur
  • Un exercice de refactoring à effectuer chez toi, suivi d’un échange avec un tech lead pour revenir sur tes erreurs
  • Un exercice en direct de debuging
  • Un entretien dirigeant de 30 minutes pour revenir sur tes motivations à rejoindre Theodo et répondre à tes derniers questions
Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo GovTech ? L’environnement: 💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel Le package : 📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 💸 Prime d’intéressement indexée sur la croissance de Theodo 🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 🩺 Mutuelle prise en charge à 50% 🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées Prêt à nous rejoindre ?
