title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
descriptionHtml:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. 

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion.

What you’ll do: 

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 7+ years of overall software engineering experience.
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++.
  • Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Welcoming differences
    • Being relationship-minded
    • Practicing responsible participation
    • Having grit

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Enterprise DLP development or deployment
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Stage – Ingénieur(e) Production & Industrialisation
descriptionHtml:
Isembard est une scale-up industrielle « software-first » qui reconstruit un réseau européen et souverain de fabrication de précision. Nous fabriquons des pièces usinées complexes (tournage, fraisage 5 axes) pour la défense, le spatial, les drones et l’aéronautique. Nous travaillons l’aluminium, l’acier inoxydable, le titane et d’autres alliages aéronautiques.

Notre première usine française, à Wissous, monte rapidement en cadence, avec de nouvelles machines, de nouveaux clients et de nouveaux process. Nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire ingénieur(e) pour rejoindre l’équipe fondatrice. Vous travaillerez directement avec notre Ingénieur Production fondateur.

Vos missions

  • Gestion de production : appuyer le suivi quotidien de la production et la planification. Vous contribuerez aussi au respect des délais de livraison des commandes clients.

  • Standardisation des process : rédiger et déployer avec l’équipe des instructions de travail. Elles couvriront la réception des marchandises et des matières, les expéditions, le référencement fournisseurs, ainsi que la gestion des RFQ et des documents.

  • Management de la qualité : contribuer à la construction de notre système qualité ISO 9001 et EN 9100. Cela comprend la traçabilité matière, les certificats, le processus de non-conformités (NCR) et l’inspection premier article (FAI).

  • Capacité industrielle : aider à identifier, évaluer et intégrer des sous-traitants en usinage pour étendre nos capacités et notre savoir-faire.

  • Lean & performance : animer et soutenir les démarches 5S en atelier.

  • Équipements & digital : participer à la mise en service des nouvelles machines et au déploiement de nos logiciels d’usine développés en interne (ERP, stocks, traçabilité).

  • Projets : porter un ou deux projets d’amélioration de bout en bout, du problème jusqu’à la solution déployée.

  • Vos idées : si vous identifiez un sujet où vous pouvez contribuer au succès d’Isembard, proposez-le et nous le concrétiserons ensemble.

Votre profil

  • Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur (dernière année ou césure), en génie mécanique ou génie industriel.

  • Intérêt pour l’usinage, les procédés de fabrication et la qualité. Savoir lire des plans techniques et le GD&T (cotation ISO GPS) est un plus.

  • Structuré(e) et rigoureux(se), tout en étant à l’aise pour avancer vite dans une petite équipe sans management intermédiaire.

  • Concret(e) et sur le terrain : vous aimez passer du temps en atelier, pas seulement derrière un écran.

  • Français courant et bon niveau d’anglais, car nous échangeons chaque semaine avec notre siège à Londres.

  • Bonus : des bases en Lean / Six Sigma.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • De vraies responsabilités dès la première semaine, dans une usine en pleine construction.

  • Une exposition directe à des clients de la défense, du spatial et de l’aéronautique et à leurs exigences qualité.

  • Le mentorat d’un ingénieur production et supply chain expérimenté (Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, PMP, CPIM).

  • Une scale-up en forte croissance, bien financée, avec une présence européenne.

department: DEII - Régulation et Conformité - Référencement et certification
descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous intégrerez l’équipe Référencement et Certification du Domaine Régulation et Conformité, au sein de la Direction Expertise, Innovation et International (DEII). L’ANS évalue la conformité des solutions numériques en santé aux exigences d’interopérabilité, de sécurité et d’éthique, à partir des preuves déposées par les entreprises sur la plateforme Convergence. À la suite d’un premier prototype ayant démontré la faisabilité d’une automatisation partielle sur données fictives, le stage vise à confronter les résultats à des données réelles, à qualifier les solutions d’IA et de RPA et à étudier les conditions d’intégration dans l’environnement existant, en tenant compte des exigences de sécurité et de fiabilité.

🎯 Missions principales

Concevoir et tester une solution d’automatisation

  • Analyser les travaux existants et les processus de vérification de conformité.

  • Concevoir et réaliser un prototype en environnement de préproduction à partir de données réelles.

  • Mettre en œuvre et orchestrer des solutions de RPA et d’IA, par exemple UiPath ou Azure Document Intelligence, ou des outils équivalents.

Évaluer la faisabilité et préparer l’industrialisation

  • Étudier les modalités d’intégration avec la plateforme Convergence et contribuer à la définition d’une architecture cible.

  • Prendre en compte les contraintes de sécurité, d’hébergement, de performance, de passage à l’échelle et de traçabilité.

  • Identifier les cas d’usage pertinents, évaluer les limites et les risques, mesurer les gains attendus et formuler des recommandations ainsi qu’une feuille de route de mise en production.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en informatique, génie logiciel, data science ou systèmes d’information.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

  • Vous avez des connaissances en automatisation, traitement documentaire ou intégration de systèmes

  • Une familiarité avec UiPath, les tests logiciels ou l’analyse de conformité sera appréciée.

  • Vous êtes rigoureux·se et doté·e d’un bon esprit d’analyse.

  • Vous savez prendre en compte les enjeux de qualité, de fiabilité et de sécurité des données.

  • Vous appréciez le travail transversal avec des interlocuteurs techniques, réglementaires et métiers.

Mit viel Leidenschaft, Offenheit und Freude am gemeinsamen Gestalten möchten wir begeistern und einzigartige Momente schaffen.

title: Strategic Account Executive UK/I
descriptionHtml:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Are you ready to redefine the future of digital identity in the AI era?

Okta’s UKI Strategic Account Executive Sales Team is hiring!

Our Strategic Account Executives (SAE) are the visionary leaders who orchestrate and drive sales engagements for our most critical and prestigious UKI customers.

In an era where Artificial Intelligence is transforming how enterprises operate, identity has become the new security perimeter. As an SAE, you won't just be selling software—you will act as a trusted, long-term advisor helping the C-suite safely navigate the AI revolution. You will build first-class Account Plans that map directly to your customers' overarching business strategies, digital transformation initiatives, and AI adoption plans. By championing value-based selling, you will translate complex technical capabilities into undeniable business outcomes, showing how secure identity is the ultimate enabler of modern enterprise innovation and ROI.

You will collaboratively plan and orchestrate the execution of aligned account strategies, ensuring robust opportunity generation, deep relationship alignment, and flawless account governance. Expect to lead from the front: presenting Okta’s transformational proposals, negotiating high-stakes terms, and bringing down complex, multi-layered, seven-figure deals that deliver massive win-win scenarios for both the customer and Okta.

Beyond managing existing relationships, you will hunt for new business leads that fit our ideal client profile, uncovering uncharted territory in the market. You will align closely with our Global partners to build sustainable strategic engagements, and leverage cutting-edge Account-Based Marketing to ensure Okta's investment continuously aligns with customer growth.

We are seeking a passionate, strategic, and hyper-focused professional to drive massive new revenue growth across Fortune 500 accounts. As an individual contributor, you will play a vital, high-visibility role in driving a significant share of revenue for Okta, helping the world's most prominent enterprises transition securely into a smarter, AI-driven future.

We provide our reps with an environment where they can make incredibly valuable contributions from day one, while also building endless opportunities for learning and career growth. The work you do here will directly impact the security, trust, and digital experience of the world's largest organizations.

As an Okta Strategic Account Executive, you will:

  • Establish a Vision: Create and execute a master plan to guide your long-term, strategic approach to the premier accounts assigned in your Territory.

  • Master Value Selling: Deeply understand your clients' business goals and tie Okta's solutions directly to their strategic imperatives, continuously selling on business value and ROI rather than just features.

  • Orchestrate Complex Deals: Navigate and close highly complex, multi-stakeholder, seven-figure deals, bringing together cross-functional teams to deliver transformational outcomes.

  • Enable Secure AI Transformation: Partner with clients to position identity as the critical foundation for their AI initiatives, ensuring they can safely deploy AI agents, automate workflows, and manage machine-to-machine identities without compromising security.

  • Expand & Deepen: Land, adopt, expand, and entrench sales opportunities within Fortune 500 accounts across your region.

  • Navigate the Org Chart: Explore the full spectrum of relationships and business possibilities across the client’s entire organizational structure, from technical buyers to the CIO, CISO, and Board of Directors.

  • Be a Thought Leader: Become the definitive authority on Okta’s platform, the vertical in which you are aligned, and the evolving security requirements of the modern, AI-first enterprise.

  • Leverage the Ecosystem: Holistically embrace, access, and utilize our channel and alliance partners to identify and crack open new, uncharted opportunities.

  • Collaborate to Win: Work as a unified team for the most efficient deployment of resources, providing timely and insightful input back to other corporate functions.

  • Champion the Platform: Represent Okta to prospective clients at executive sales presentations, site visits, and high-impact product demonstrations.

  • Build Partnerships: Cultivate highly effective working partnerships with your Okta colleagues globally (channel partners, sales engineering, business value management, customer first, etc.) with both humility and relentless enthusiasm.

You could be a great fit for this role if you have:

  • Proven Experience: A highly consistent track record in strategic field sales, specifically developing new logos and selling enterprise cloud software to Fortune 500 companies.

  • Complex Deal Expertise: A proven track record of successfully navigating, negotiating, and closing highly complex, six-to-seven-figure software cloud deals with prospects and customers in the defined territory.

  • Value-Selling Mastery: Deep experience with target account selling, solution selling, and consultative sales techniques that focus on business value. (Knowledge of MEDDIC, Challenger methodologies, or similar frameworks is a massive plus!)

  • Forward-Looking Tech IQ: A solid understanding of how modern technologies, automation, and AI are reshaping enterprise security, data access, and cloud architectures.

  • Ecosystem Leverage: Previous success utilizing partners, channels, and alliances to sell more effectively and obliterate your quota.

  • Domain Knowledge: Experience selling complex cloud solutions in areas like enterprise Cloud/SaaS software, identity/security, infrastructure management, application development, or modern data platforms.

  • Market Creation Skills: A measurable track record in new business development and over-achieving sales targets, especially in high-growth, fast-changing environments or during market creation phases.

  • Executive Presence: Deep experience engaging with the “C” suite, possessing strong executive presence, immense polish, and world-class listening skills.

title: Strategic Account Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Strategic Account Manager, you won't own a fixed book of accounts. Instead, you'll work across a large, shared pool of customers, 50+ at a time, and your job is to make every single one of them successful.

Unlike a traditional account role built around a handful of strategic relationships, you'll operate at scale: building Omnea's presence and community across your customer base through events, webinars, roundtables, and digital engagement, turning individual customers into a connected, invested group of Omnea advocates.

You'll still carry a commercial edge, owning retention and a smaller share of expansion across your pool, but the bulk of the role is about driving real value realisation and adoption at volume rather than running a small number of deep, high-touch relationships.

You're someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, is energised by variety, and knows how to prioritise ruthlessly. You're as comfortable hosting a roundtable for 30 procurement leaders as you are running a tight renewal call with a CFO.

What You'll Do

  • Own a large, shared pool of accounts: Manage 50+ accounts at a time across SMB and mid-market, not a fixed book, building relationships from end users (Procurement, Finance, Ops) through to senior stakeholders (CFOs, COOs), and stepping in early wherever you spot a health risk.

  • Drive value realisation, with a lighter expansion motion: Own Net Revenue Retention across your pool. Lead renewal conversations, secure multi-year extensions, and pass qualified upsell signal to Sales rather than running full commercial cycles yourself.

  • Build community and drive engagement at scale: Design and run customer events, webinars, roundtables, and digital programmes that keep your accounts engaged, informed, and connected to each other. Co-host with Marketing and Sales, and turn your best customers into reference champions.

  • Be the voice of the customer internally: Translate patterns across your accounts into product feedback for the roadmap, and into scalable plays and campaigns for Marketing and Sales. Help define the playbooks, tools, and processes for managing accounts at this scale: you're building this function as much as running it.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a book-of-business role. You work across a large, shared pool of accounts rather than owning a fixed set, so leverage through events, content, and digital touchpoints matters as much as one-to-one relationship-building.

  • The quota skews toward retention and value realisation, not expansion. Roughly 70% of what you own is keeping accounts healthy and renewed; the other 30% is expansion you spot and hand off or close.

title: Strategic Finance Intern
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

  • You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

  • Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey.

  • Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Review and reconcile our models: Work through our long-term investment model and multi-year business plan, check formula integrity and cross-sheet consistency, and reconcile both against our budget.

  • Find and resolve discrepancies: Keep a clear log of every mismatch you find, trace it to its cause, and work with the relevant teams to resolve it.

  • Document how the models fit together: Write clear handover documentation on how our models connect and where each input comes from, so the next person can pick them up quickly.

  • Build tools the team will use: Create dashboards and automations on top of the reconciled models to enable the business operations team and the rest of the business to quickly find answers to their finance questions.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Modelling experience: Hands-on financial modelling experience, ideally from investment banking, private equity, venture capital, transaction services, or a finance role at a startup.

  • Excel and spreadsheet fluency: You can trace logic through models someone else built, spot errors quickly, and suggest improvements. Experience with Excel macros or Google Apps Script is a plus.

  • Independent problem-solving: You structure a messy question, reason from the data in front of you, and work through blockers without needing step-by-step guidance.

  • Confidence to flag problems: You tell a team lead when their numbers don't tie, clearly and constructively, and own your mistakes when you make them.

  • AI-native: You use AI tools such as Claude to work faster and build better tools, not as a replacement for doing the thinking.

  • Startup mindset: Curious, proactive, and detail-oriented. You welcome feedback, enjoy working with others to help the team succeed, and are excited by fusion energy.

  • Availability: You can start immediately and commit to 2-3 months on-site in Munich. Fluent English is required; German is a plus.


Don't tick all the boxes? We would still like to hear from you!

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30 min)

  • Technical Interview, including a short modelling case (60 min)

  • Second Technical Interview (45 min)



*This role sits at "L1" of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don't look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Strategic Sales Manager (Paris)
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

We’re hiring a Strategic Sales Leader to build Dust’s go-to-market presence with its most important French customers. This is a pivotal opportunity to shape how we win and grow strategic accounts, from developing senior relationships and navigating complex buying groups to building a repeatable approach for large, high-impact opportunities.

You’ll act as the business lead for the strategic segment, with accountability for revenue. You’ll lead and coach the sales team while staying close to customers, account plans, and active deals. You’ll build a focused pipeline and a sales motion suited to organizations with complex needs, multiple stakeholders, and ambitious transformation goals.

You’ll also orchestrate the cross-functional support needed to grow strategic accounts. Working closely with BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, you’ll direct resources toward the accounts and opportunities where they can have the greatest impact.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow the Strategic sales team, including hiring, performance management, and day-to-day execution.

  • Own the segment’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Set clear priorities with the CRO, review progress, and address gaps early.

  • Develop a focused strategy for target accounts, including account plans, senior stakeholder relationships, and a clear view of customer priorities and decision processes.

  • Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first conversation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, close, handoff, and expansion.

  • Coach sellers on executive engagement, value-based selling, multi-threading, commercial strategy, and navigating complex buying groups.

  • Build a consistent, evidence-based strategic sales motion, refining qualification, messaging, and execution based on customer conversations and deal patterns.

  • Bring customer and market learning to Product, making clear recommendations on strategic customer needs, use cases, and opportunities.

  • Set pipeline priorities with BDR and Growth leaders, including targeted outbound and other channels suited to strategic accounts.

  • Partner with Field Marketing to prioritize executive events, campaigns, customer advocacy, and community programs that support strategic pipeline and revenue goals. Work within the marketing leadership’s standards and methods, and ensure programs are well executed and measured.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support strategic priorities, working with the Partnerships lead on account access, co-selling, and delivery opportunities.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to deliver credible evaluations, successful implementations, adoption, and expansion.

  • Share strategic account and market insights with the CRO and other segment leads, helping shape a coherent France go-to-market approach.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven B2B software sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help sellers succeed.

  • Experience leading Strategic or Enterprise sales, including complex, multi-stakeholder deals and relationships with senior executives.

  • A track record of owning a segment or market revenue number end to end, and building pipeline through teams and functions you did not directly manage.

  • Experience making practical decisions about where to focus capacity and budget, including the roles of direct sales, marketing, and partners.

  • Strong judgment in developing account strategies, coaching complex deal execution, and building a reliable forecast.

  • The ability to create a repeatable sales approach without treating every strategic customer as the same.

  • Strong collaboration skills across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, RevOps, and post-sales teams.

  • High EQ, clear communication, and a supportive but accountable leadership style.

  • Comfort building strategic sales practices in a scaling organization. French fluency and strong working English are important.

What success looks like

The Strategic segment has clear ownership, a focused pipeline, and measurable progress against its ARR goals. The team builds trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and executes complex sales cycles with discipline. Cross-functional resources are aligned to the accounts and opportunities that matter most, and learning from customers and deals helps Dust sharpen its strategic sales approach in France.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

title: Strategy & Operations - Transformation
descriptionHtml:
Deducta

Strategy & Operations - Transformation

Location: London, UK, near London Bridge. Hybrid, 3-4 in-person days a week.

Compensation: £90k-£110k base salary plus equity

Visa Sponsorship: Available for the right candidate

Start Date: As soon as possible

Why we exist

Every decision a business makes, from the suppliers it trusts to the risks it accepts, eventually shows up as spend. This makes spend data the most honest record of how a company operates. Not the strategy deck or the org chart: spend describes what really happened.

This record exists, but it's scattered across dozens of systems and decades of legacy technology. Companies spending billions a year still can't easily answer: Who are our suppliers? Where are we exposed? What are we paying for twice?

We believe a business that can't see itself clearly can't make great decisions. Deducta exists to give the world's most complex organisations a true picture of how they operate, and the intelligence to act on it. Our ambition is to become the category-defining platform for enterprise data intelligence.

We're well funded, growing fast, and have already processed more than £1 trillion of spend for some of the world's largest and most recognisable companies. Our partners use Deducta to deliver major business transformations orders of magnitude faster.

Why this role matters

Our customers are some of the world's largest companies, and every partnership depends on Deducta delivering the measurable outcomes we've committed to. This role owns delivery for a set of our enterprise accounts, from sales handover through implementation, adoption and ongoing value. You'll report to the Chief of Staff.

You'll work directly with senior leaders at our customers, run complex programmes end to end, and work closely with whoever leads our customer function. You'll have the autonomy to shape how Deducta delivers and help make that model repeatable.

What you'll do

  • Account delivery: Own delivery for a set of enterprise accounts end to end, from sales handover through implementation, adoption, value realisation and ongoing partnership.

  • Enterprise programmes: Translate customer objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners and dependencies, and keep complex programmes moving.

  • Senior relationships: Build trusted relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day programme leads through CPOs, CFOs and other executives.

  • Data and platform: Work directly with customer data and the Deducta platform, understanding each customer's business so our work produces meaningful insights and outcomes.

  • Implementation and adoption: Identify blockers early, coordinate the right resources across product and engineering, and make sure customer learnings shape how we improve the product.

  • Delivery playbook: Turn what works on your accounts into repeatable processes the wider customer team can use.

Success in this role means:

  • Trusted partner: Your customers see Deducta as a partner that consistently delivers against its commitments.

  • Predictable implementations: Implementations move quickly, with risks and blockers surfaced early rather than through firefighting.

  • Visible value: Customers adopt the platform, can articulate the value Deducta creates, and keep deepening how they use it.

  • Repeatable delivery: The processes you build make delivery faster and more consistent across accounts.

Who you are

We're looking for a high-agency operator with roughly three to four years in MBB or top-tier management consulting, ideally having reached Manager, with experience managing complex workstreams and confidence in front of senior clients. You should be as comfortable in the data as you are presenting to an executive. A background in procurement or enterprise software isn't required.

You might be the right fit if you have:

  • Client leadership: You build credibility quickly, manage demanding stakeholders and become a trusted partner to senior executives.

  • Programme leadership: You turn an ambitious objective into a structured plan and create accountability across stakeholders you don't control.

  • Analytical depth: You get into the data yourself, identify what matters and synthesise complex information into clear conclusions.

  • Problem solving: You diagnose why something isn't working, separate symptoms from underlying problems, and drive the team to a practical solution.

  • Executive communication: You take complex, messy work and communicate the answer clearly and confidently to senior stakeholders.

  • High agency: You create clarity where none exists and follow problems through to resolution.

  • Nice to have: Experience in enterprise software, data, analytics, AI, procurement, complex technology implementations, or a high-growth environment.

We care most about how you think, the quality of your work and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Previous startup experience isn't essential, but the pace, initiative and judgement to thrive in one are.

How we work

We believe in freedom and responsibility. We set clear priorities, share the context and trust people to decide how to deliver. You'll thrive here if you value:

  • Ownership: You own the outcome, not just the task. You deliver what you commit to, follow through when things get difficult, and own your mistakes.

  • Unreasonable hospitality: You treat prospects, clients and teammates with exceptional care as a default. You anticipate needs, communicate with clarity, and help others succeed.

  • Bias for action: We don’t have every answer upfront. You move things forward without waiting to be asked, take calculated risks, and adapt as you learn.

  • Craft: Moving quickly matters, but so does doing work that stays clear, reliable and useful as we grow.

  • System building: You create leverage beyond your own output, building processes, tools and documentation that others reuse and that keep working without you.

  • Candor: You tell the hard truth early, give and receive feedback thoughtfully, ask for help when you need it, and push back when priorities need to change.

  • Curiosity about AI: You’re excited by what applied AI makes possible, and you look for ways to use it in your own work.

As an early team member, you'll help shape our culture, our processes and where Deducta goes next. We're growing quickly, and this role will grow with us.

Hiring process

descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Neobank App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Technical Strategy Manager H/F
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Context

We are looking for hybrid profile, sitting at the intersection of strategy and engineering, able to rigorously evaluate the technology choices made by the R&D and innovation teams, audit our internal capabilities, and challenge product/tech trade-offs with a business lens. This is not a technical team management role, but a role of constructive counter-power and strategic alignment between engineering and business priorities.

You will ensure that our technological decisions (R&D, innovation, architecture choices, build vs buy, roadmap prioritization) are aligned with overall strategy, economically sound, and robust by actively challenging the relevant teams rather than rubber-stamping their proposals.

Role & Missions:

Strategic and technical challenge

  • Challenge the technical choices and roadmaps proposed by R&D and the Innovation team (architecture, stack, prioritization, build vs buy vs partner)

  • Question the underlying assumptions behind technical projects (feasibility, ROI, strategic alignment, technical debt incurred)

  • Produce well-argued, independent analyses not rubber-stamped validations

Technology and market watch

  • Run continuous technical and technology watch (competitors, emerging technologies, market trends, new tools, and platforms) to keep the company's decisions informed by the state of the art

  • Identify technologies or approaches that could create a competitive advantage, or expose the company to being left behind

  • Turn watch findings into actionable inputs for the R&D/Innovation roadmap and for COMEX-level strategic discussions

  • Build and maintain a structured watch process (sources, cadence, internal distribution) rather than ad hoc monitoring

Capability audit

  • Regularly map and assess the company's technical capabilities (skills, tools, infrastructure, external dependencies)

  • Identify areas of risk, over-investment, under-investment, or critical dependency

  • Benchmark our capabilities against the market and competitors

Technology strategy

  • Contribute to defining the company's technology strategy alongside the Strategy & Operations Director

  • Assess build, buy, partner, or acquisition opportunities on technology topics

  • Inform R&D resource allocation decisions with a strategic and financial lens

Reporting and governance

  • Produce syntheses and recommendations for COMEX on tech-strategy topics

  • Set up tracking indicators on technical execution vs. commitments made

  • Participate in R&D/Innovation committees as an independent strategic voice

Candidate profile

Experience

  • 5-6 years of overall experience, engineering background (degree in engineering or equivalent)

  • Ideal trajectory: 2-3 years of hands-on technical execution, followed by 2-3 years in a hybrid technical/business role e.g. Engineer → Technical Product Manager, Engineer → tech-focused strategy consulting, or Engineer → Chief of Staff to a CTO/VP Engineering

  • Profiles with only pure execution experience (no exposure to business trade-offs) or only early technical experience followed by years of generalist consulting (no longer technically credible) are not a fit for this role

  • Given the seniority level, the candidate should compensate for limited years of experience with either deep, recognized expertise in a specific technical domain (enough to be seen as a peer by R&D on that topic) or a strong, proven track record of challenging senior stakeholders from a strategy/consulting background.

Technical skills

  • Hands-on experience in a technical environment (dev, data, tech product, architecture, not consulting-only exposure)

  • Demonstrated ability to understand architecture choices and technical trade-offs, and to assess their relevance

  • Comfortable engaging as a peer with CTOs, tech leads, and senior engineers

  • Able to speak in concrete, specific terms about a real technical decision they challenged or questioned

Strategy / business skills

  • Ability to translate technical issues into business implications, and vice versa

Critical soft skills

  • Strong critical thinking and independence of judgment

  • Able to distinguish a genuine technical risk from a mere communication gap

  • Natural credibility: earns legitimacy through the rigor of the analysis, not through hierarchy

Success indicators (by month 12)

  • Technical capability map completed and kept up to date

  • A structured technology watch process in place, with regular outputs reaching R&D/Innovation and COMEX

  • Number of R&D/Innovation decisions meaningfully redirected following a well-argued challenge

  • Perceived quality of recommendations by COMEX and by the technical teams themselves

  • Measurable reduction in the gap between technical roadmap and strategic priorities

title: Tools Developer (Rust / Linux)
descriptionHtml:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

About the Software organisation at Fractile

Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing.


About the team and role

The tools built by the Developer Experience team are how engineers — both inside Fractile and at our customers — see, control and understand the Fractile inference accelerator. That means the command-line utilities used to discover, configure and health-check devices; the diagnostics used during hardware bring-up and in the datacentre; and the profiling, tracing and debugging tools that show where the time goes across the host, the driver and the silicon.

As a Tools Developer you will design and build these tools in Rust, running on Linux hosts from a single developer workstation against large datacentre deployments. You will work closely with the hardware, firmware, kernel driver, runtime and Developer Experience teams to understand what they need, and turn that into fast, reliable and well-designed tools that fit naturally into existing Linux workflows. This is largely greenfield work, with real scope to shape how our tooling is architected and how it is used.


About you

You enjoy building tools that other engineers rely on every day, and you care about getting the details right: clear output, sensible defaults, good error messages and behaviour you can script against. You are at home on Linux, comfortable working anywhere from the shell down to sysfs, ioctls and the kernel/userspace boundary, and you know how to find out what a system is actually doing when it misbehaves. You are self-driven, able to identify tooling opportunities for yourself, and happy to work autonomously in areas of ambiguity.


Key Requirements

  • Strong Rust skills, with experience shipping production-quality tools or libraries

  • Knowledge of Linux from a developer's perspective: processes, memory, filesystems, sysfs/procfs, device files and ioctls, systemd and the kernel/userspace interface

  • Experience designing command-line tools and APIs that are easy to learn, script and automate

  • Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience writing tools for PCIe-attached devices, GPUs or other ML accelerators

  • Experience using CUDA, ROCm, Vulkan Compute, or similar

  • Familiarity with tracing and telemetry formats or systems such as Perfetto, Chrome trace format, OpenTelemetry or Prometheus

  • Experience exposing Rust libraries to Python (e.g. PyO3) or C

  • Experience with Bazel, CI/CD or packaging software for Linux distributions

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We’ve recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us!

 

Export controls

Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

title: Werkstudent Bewerbermanagement (mind. 15h/Woche)
descriptionHtml:
Wir haben ambitionierte Ziele.

Werde ein Teil davon.

Von 0 auf 40 Teammitglieder in fünf Jahren. Wir gehören als Mix aus Strategieberatung und Kreativagentur zu den am schnellsten wachsenden inhabergeführten Beratungsunternehmen Süddeutschlands und möchten unseren Weg auch in Zukunft erfolgreich fortsetzen.

Hinter unserem „wir“ steht dabei ein Kollektiv aus engagierten Persönlichkeiten, was vielseitiger nicht sein könnte. Von ehemaligen Unternehmensberatern renommierter internationaler Unternehmen wie Ernst & Young oder Porsche Consulting über kreative Designprofis und Content-Experten bis zur TikTok Influencerin oder dem studierten Videografen, wir sind in unseren Fähigkeiten unterschiedlich, haben aber doch eine große Gemeinsamkeit: den Anspruch, uns kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und herausragende Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Wenn du Lust hast, in einem dynamischen und gleichermaßen etablierten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs mitzuarbeiten und Teil eines jungen, ambitionierten und freundschaftlichen Teams zu werden, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Aufgaben

Dein Part in unserem Team.

In dieser Rolle bist du ein zentraler Teil unseres Recruiting-Setups für mittelständische Kunden. Der Schwerpunkt liegt klar im Bewerbermanagement. Du sorgst dafür, dass Prozesse sauber laufen, Bewerbungen zeitschnell weitergeleitet werden und unsere Kunden schnell und strukturiert über eingehende Bewerbungen entscheiden können.

Deine Tätigkeiten im Überblick:

  • Du kümmerst dich um das administrative Bewerbermanagement für unsere Kunden

  • Du pflegst und schaltest Stellenanzeigen auf verschiedenen Portalen und Websites

  • Du bist im engen Austausch mit den Geschäftsführern oder verantwortlichen Personalern unserer Kunden

  • Du führst eine saubere Bewerberübersicht, trackst Status, hältst Timings nach und stellst sicher, dass nichts liegen bleibt.

  • Du kommunizierst professionell und verbindlich mit Kandidaten, schriftlich und telefonisch.

Qualifikation

Was wir uns von dir wünschen.

Wir interessieren uns vor allem für dich als Menschen und prüfen immer individuell, ob deine Erwartungen, deine Skills und dein Drive zu uns passen. Eigenschaften wie selbstständiges Arbeiten, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber Neuem solltest du dabei auf jeden Fall mitbringen.

Zusätzlich sind folgende Punkte für die Stelle relevant:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Student und kannst mindestens 15 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten

  • Du hast Lust auf strukturierte, verlässliche Arbeit mit klarer Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft

  • Du kommunizierst sauber, freundlich und professionell, auch wenn es schnell gehen muss

  • Du arbeitest sorgfältig und dir ist Genauigkeit wichtig

  • Du kannst unterhalb der Woche deine Arbeitszeit flexibel auf mehrere Tage verteilen

Benefits

Warum wir kein normaler Arbeitgeber sind.

Ja, wir fordern einiges von unseren Teammitgliedern, dafür haben wir aber auch einiges zu bieten. Wir vertrauen den Menschen, mit denen wir zusammenarbeiten und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem sich jeder gemäß seinen individuellen Stärken und Schwächen weiterentwickeln kann. Wer hoch hinaus möchte, bekommt früh viel Verantwortung und Entwicklungschancen, wer sich noch unsicher ist, wo es hingehen soll, wird an die Hand genommen und erhält Orientierung. Wir sind keine Chefs, Mitarbeiter und Praktikanten, wir sind ein eingeschworenes Team, das zusammen an einem Strang zieht.

Darüber hinaus kannst du dich bei uns auf die folgenden Punkte freuen:

  • Attraktiver Stundenlohn von 15 €

  • Arbeit mit Impact: Du bist nah an echten Entscheidungen und bekommst Einblicke, wie mittelständische Unternehmen Recruiting pragmatisch und wirksam steuern

  • Struktur und Verantwortung: Du bekommst einen klaren Aufgabenbereich, in dem du schnell eigenständig wirst

  • Lernkurve mit Praxisbezug: Du lernst saubere Recruiting-Prozesse und professionelle Kandidaten- /Kundenkommunikation.

  • Flexibilität im Alltag: Hybrid-Arbeit und eine Planung, die sich mit deinem Studium realistisch kombinieren lässt.

  • Starkes Setup: Moderne Ausstattung und ein Team, das Tempo und Qualität ernst nimmt.

Jetzt bist du dran.

Schicke uns deine Bewerbung über das digitale Bewerbungsformular und lerne uns persönlich kennen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

title: Werkstudent Customer Success (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst wissen, wie moderne Industrieunternehmen wirklich arbeiten? Bei uns digitalisierst du einen Kernprozess mit ihnen.

nextAudit digitalisiert Audit-, Prüf- und Compliance-Prozesse – mit KI-gestützter Software, die Menschen tatsächlich gerne benutzen. Unsere Kunden sind globale Konzerne, Hidden Champions und Mittelständler, die faszinierende Dinge produzieren: von Bauteilen, die in Flugzeugen landen, bis zu Produkten, die du täglich in der Hand hältst.

Im Customer Success bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen diesen Kunden und unserer Entwicklung. Heißt konkret: Du sorgst mit dafür, dass nicht nur unsere Kunden großartige Dinge herstellen – sondern wir auch.

Aufgaben

Du unterstützt erfahrene Kolleg:innen, wächst in Themen hinein und übernimmst Stück für Stück eigene Pakete:

  • Kunden erfolgreich machen – du unterstützt bei unseren standardisierten Onboardings und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer gekauften Software ein messbarer Mehrwert wird
  • KI-gestützte Prozesse leben– du setzt unsere KI-Playbooks beim Kunden ein, um Normen, Fragenkataloge und Auditdaten aufzubereiten und entwickelst sie weiter
  • Kommunizieren und nachhalten – du übernimmst die schriftliche und mündliche B2B-Kommunikation und hältst Feedback so fest, dass wir daraus etwas machen können
  • Uns besser machen – du testest neue Funktionen, bringst Kundenstimmen ins Produktmanagement ein und verbesserst unsere Customer-Success-Prozesse mit

Qualifikation

  • Fortgeschrittenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium – z. B. Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL oder technisch mit Prozessbezug
  • Du kommunizierst gerne und sicher: Deutsch fließend, Englisch gut (unsere Kunden sind international unterwegs)
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst mit und fragst nach, wenn etwas unklar ist
  • Du hast Lust auf Startup und willst dich mit uns weiterentwickeln
  • Du hast dafür 16-20 Stunden Zeit / Woche

Benefits

  • 15–19 € pro Stunde plus anteiligen Urlaub, abhängig von Erfahrung und Studienfortschritt
  • Dein Studium gibt den Takt vor: In Klausurphasen und während deiner Abschlussarbeit reduzierst du Stunden oder pausierst – ohne Diskussion. In den Semesterferien darfst du dafür gerne aufstocken, wenn du magst.
  • Ein Mentor an deiner Seite: Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen, sondern hast von Tag eins eine feste Ansprechperson für dein Onboarding.
  • Diese Stelle hat ein offenes Ende: Wir besetzen diese Stelle mit der Absicht, dass du bleibst. Wer bei uns Kunden live bringt, kennt unser Produkt irgendwann besser, als jede Bewerbung es zeigen könnte.
  • Homeoffice – auch aus dem EU-Ausland: Semesterferien bei Familie oder Freunden in Europa? Kein Problem.
  • Echter Kundenkontakt statt Zuarbeit: Du sprichst mit Qualitätsmanager:innen internationaler Konzerne und lernst dabei viele unterschiedliche Branchen kennen.
  • Ein Büro, in das man gerne kommt: Bohnen der Rösterei Plum an der Siebträgermaschine, Obstkorb, Teamevents – und Mario-Kart-Runden, in denen der blaue Panzer keine Hierarchien kennt, zentral im Herzen von Aachen.

Klingt nach dir?

Wir suchen kein perfektes Anschreiben, sondern Persönlichkeiten mit Neugier und Antrieb. Teile uns gerne in ein paar Sätzen mit, was dich motiviert, wo du hinwillst und was du in deiner Freizeit magst. Was du von uns wissen möchtest, klären wir entspannt in einem persönlichen Gespräch.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich !

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Das bewegst du:

Als Werkstudent Media (Mensch) magst du große Datenmengen und möchtest aktiv dazu beitragen, die Performance unseres Kunden zu optimieren.

  • Fundierte Analysen & Reportings: Du unterstützt uns bei der Erstellung aussagekräftiger Analysen und Reportings, die als wichtige Entscheidungsgrundlage dienen.
  • Performance-Tracking: Die Aufbereitung und Analyse von kampagnenbezogenen Wochen- und Monatsauswertungen zur Erfolgsmessung gehört zu deinen Kernaufgaben.

Das zeichnet dich aus:

  • Dein Studienhintergrund: Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in (m/w/d), idealerweise in den Bereichen Marketing, Medien, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Informatik.

Find, hire and retain the best talent.

title: Working Student AI Solutions Architect – Generative AI & Data Platforms
descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT Application note

Please apply only through this job portal. Kindly do not send applications or recruitment messages by email or LinkedIn. Only applications submitted through the portal will be considered. Thank you.

About AgentixLake

AgentixLake GmbH is a Data and AI engineering consultancy based in Hamburg, Germany. We design, build and operate production-grade data platforms and AI systems in our customers’ cloud accounts or on-premises environments. We are an AWS Services Partner and a Certified Services Partner in Anthropic’s Claude Partner Network. Our commercial focus is DACH and the Gulf region, alongside selected international opportunities.

Your role

Design the path from a business requirement to a working data and AI system. You will work directly with our founders and engineers to turn discovery findings into architecture decisions, implementation plans and tested components.

Our architecture and advisory work connects enterprise data platforms with generative AI, AI agents and business applications. Depending on the engagement, solutions run on AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Google Cloud or customer-managed infrastructure.

What you will do

Translate business workflows, existing systems and data constraints into clear solution designs, with explicit assumptions and acceptance criteria.

Design data flows connecting ingestion, storage, retrieval, model inference, APIs and downstream enterprise systems.

Evaluate trade-offs across cloud services, open-source components and on-premises deployment, including security, reliability, cost and maintainability.

Create architecture diagrams, technical decision records and delivery estimates; contribute to discovery workshops and design reviews.

Validate important assumptions with Python, SQL, API integrations or infrastructure prototypes, then work with engineers on implementation.

Specify access controls, evaluation, observability and human approval steps for enterprise RAG and agentic workflows.

What you bring

Current university enrollment in a relevant technical discipline, combined with substantial hands-on experience building software or data systems.

Evidence that you have delivered systems used by others and can explain your own design choices, implementation and operational lessons.

Strong Python and SQL skills, practical cloud experience and an understanding of APIs, data modeling and deployment.

Applied understanding of large language models, retrieval-augmented generation and the data foundations these systems require.

The judgement to own a defined workstream, surface risks early and communicate technical decisions clearly in English.

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, Terraform, Lakehouse architecture or technical discovery with business stakeholders is valuable. Depth in one relevant environment matters more than familiarity with every platform.

What you can expect

You will contribute to customer-facing architecture and implementation, work closely with the founders and receive substantive design and code review. Your part-time scope and schedule will be planned around your studies.

How to apply

Use the Apply button on this page to submit your CV, current study details, location and weekly availability. Include a short example of a system you helped design and build: the problem, your contribution and a trade-off you made. An anonymised explanation is welcome; please do not share confidential client material.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds. If the core responsibilities match your experience, we would like to hear from you.

Stay connected

Follow AgentixLake on LinkedIn for practical engineering insights, project updates and future opportunities. Following is optional and does not influence recruitment decisions.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentixlakegmbh/

Website: https://agentixlake.com/

About the role:

As a Working Student, you will be a key part of our Product Management Team to work on the entire product life cycle that includes first idea, development, go-to-market and continuous support. You’ll push boundaries of unmanned ground vehicle technologies together with the UGV Product Manager.

You will be working closely with stakeholders from the R&D, Production, Maintenance, Marketing, Sales and/or Supply Chain departments to bring our products forward - your mission will have a powerful impact.

What is your Day to Day Mission

  • Ensure progress of product related initiatives

  • Develop product documentation

  • Gather customer feedback and incorporate it into the product roadmap

  • Create operational scenarios, mission workflows, and user journeys

  • Analyze user needs and derive operational and product requirements

  • Support customer workshops, field trials, and preparation of technical briefings.


What you bring to the team:

  • You have completed a degree/apprenticeship in the field of engineering or economics.

  • You are privately interested in technology, robotics, or unmanned ground systems.

  • Due to your open, communicative, friendly, and competent attitude, it is easy for you to be considered an internal expert.

  • You are highly self-motivated and drive your area of responsibility independently.

  • Communication in English is a matter of course for you.

Why Quantum-Systems:

We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus.

We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary.

We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data.

We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth.

Our benefits:

Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance.

Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working.

Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership.

Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia.

Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together.

Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored.

Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Laim in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday.

About us:

Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

Our commitment:

We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success.

At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. We pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment where all employees can reach their full potential.
