title: Working Student QA in Mobile App Development (m|w|d)
descriptionHtml:
Great shopping experiences start with great quality. Join our Mobile Application Development team as a Working Student in QA and help us deliver reliable, user-friendly Android and iOS apps. From testing new features to identifying bugs and supporting test automation, you'll play an active role in making idealo's mobile experience better every day.

About your new role

  • You will become part of our working student QA team, collaborating closely with designers, product managers, and software developers to ensure the quality of idealo’s Android and iOS apps.

  • You will test new features and bug fixes, verify that requirements are correctly implemented, and help identify issues before they reach our users.

  • Through functional, integration, and regression testing, you will contribute to delivering reliable and high-quality mobile applications.

  • You will also support our growing test automation initiative, helping us automate repetitive testing tasks and continuously improve our QA processes.

  • You will work independently, investigate issues, and proactively collaborate with your colleagues to find solutions and maintain our quality standards.


Skills & Requirements

  • You are studying computer science, business informatics, software engineering, or a related field and will remain enrolled for at least another 1.5 years.

  • You have already gained practical experience in a professional software development, QA, or IT-related environment, for example through a previous working student position or internship.

  • You have a basic understanding of how modern web and mobile applications work, including the interaction between frontend, backend, and APIs.

  • You enjoy investigating technical issues, can systematically reproduce problems, and communicate your findings clearly.

  • You have an analytical mindset, an eye for detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving.

At idealo you can expect

  • You want to further your education? We take your personal development goals seriously and, in addition to our idealo Learning Hub, eLearning offerings (e.g., Udemy), coaching & mediation, we also offer you the opportunity to benefit individually from additional learning and development budget.

  • And what about the office? Our office in the heart of Berlin offers free organic breakfast, excellent free lunch (vegan and vegetarian), as well as free coffee, lemonades and after-work beer, in addition to the "standard foosball". It also has a fabulous rooftop terrace with view of the whole of berlin where you can network with colleagues from our group of companies.

  • You want full flexibility on your way to work and beyond? No problem with a Deutschlandticket - and it's environmentally friendly, too!

  • Want to keep yourself fit? We offer many different fitness and sports options, such as an Urban Sports or Gympass membership, to suit your personal needs.

  • And what else is there? Of course, success must be celebrated! In addition to team events, you can also expect big company events and other moments of organized connection with others in the company and your team throughout the year!

title: Workplace Experience Associate - Front of House - Amsterdam
descriptionHtml:
About the Company:

Industrious is the largest premium workplace-as-a-service provider and home to the highest-rated workplaces in the industry. Everything we do comes down to creating great days for teams of all sizes and stages, including our own. We believe that what makes a great day at work is the people on your team and the problems you get to solve together. We’re looking for people who love thinking outside the box and thrive in a truly collaborative setting. As teammates, we encourage new ideas and toast every win. We’re excited about having a meaningful impact on people’s workplace experience.

Great days also start when everyone can be their authentic self at work. Diversity of backgrounds, thoughts, and ideas is critical to our success in delivering great workplace experiences, both for our members and for each other. Industrious is committed to creating an inclusive, respectful environment that embraces your individuality and quirkiness. You are valued for who YOU are. We celebrate our people as individuals who can accomplish great things when we work together as one team.

To learn more, visit www.industriousoffice.com/careers.

About the Role:

This is an in-person hospitality role, based on site 5 days a week. Candidates must live within an easy commute of the city listed for this role.

As the Workplace Experience Associate, you will serve as the premier ambassador for the building, orchestrating a world-class "Front of House" experience. Your role is to bridge the gap between our vibrant Industrious community and the overall building tenants, ensuring a seamless, hospitality-driven environment for every person who walks through our doors.

Core Responsibilities

  • Front of House Leadership: Own the reception experience, maintaining a high-energy, sophisticated, and welcoming lobby environment.

  • Stakeholder Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for both Industrious members and traditional building tenants, balancing diverse needs with professional grace.

  • Operational Excellence: Oversee visitor management, mail logistics, and facility standards to ensure the building operates at peak performance.

  • Community Integration: Drive engagement by managing shared amenities and building-wide programming that fosters a unified professional community.

  • System Administration: You add new members into multiple systems so their first day in their office is seamless and memorable.

Industrious helps companies of all sizes find their office home so that they can do their best work. Our team is rewriting the book on productivity by creating a new workplace experience. Right now it’s more important than ever that our Member Experience Associates are passionate about building relationships and community. You can effortlessly connect with your members. You know that the most meaningful interactions are rooted in trust and shared values.

We are Industrious.

We’re building a team of considerate collaborators who create great days. Come join us.

You’re a great fit for this role if:

  • No member request is too big or too small for you to handle.

  • You’re energized by meeting people and work well in a team because you like supporting and assisting to help a larger plan come together

  • You can create order out of chaos and are always planning ahead. You come up with solutions before anyone knows there is a problem

  • You’re resilient. You know the value of having a routine, but you’re ready for the bumps too

  • You’re willing to get your hands dirty and realize the behind the scenes work is not always glamorous

  • You always look to improve and make things more efficient because staying busy is your happy speed

This position is part time, 25h/week, 5 hours per day and 5 days a week.

Base salary is just one component of Industrious’ total compensation package that may be available to employees. Other great employee perks and benefits include: Employee Assistance Programme, professional Development Grants, Transport allowance, Pension, Team events.
